text.description: 所罗门镇长的信让我感到心痛。但显然他并不知道西部荒野的战事也很吃紧——或者他知道，但不得不抱着一丝希望来寻求我们的帮助。如果不是暴风城对西部荒野的人民不闻不问的话，我们也不会需要建立民兵组织的。$b$b将这封回信带给你在赤脊山的主人吧，$c。请转告他，我的心情也因为那么多勇士的牺牲而变得十分沉重。
text.progress: 人民军团能派来援军来吗?斯托曼大人是怎么说的?
text.completion: 我得说，这样的情况实在是太不妙了，我确实不知道那边的情况也是如同湖畔镇一样糟糕。到底是什么原因导致暴风城的军队无暇顾及他们的人民呢?唉，我不该大声谈论这种事的。$B$B拿着，信差。你为湖畔镇做了这么多事，请收下这些钱吧。我可能还会需要你的帮助。

english.title: Messenger to Westfall
english.objectives: Return to Magistrate Solomon with Gryan Stoutmantle's response.
english.description: Magistrate Solomon's note pains me to read.  But it is obvious he knows not the war which is waged in Westfall or else he would know better than to expect aid from the Militia.  If Stormwind had not deserted us as well, we would not have the need for the Militia.$b$bTake this response to your master in Redridge, $c.  And let him know that my heart is heavy with the loss of good men.
english.progress: Shall we expect the People's Militia soon?  Does Lord Stoutmantle's news bode well?
english.completion: I do say, this is not good at all.  I did not realize that Stoutmantle's situation was not unlike ours here in Lakeshire.  What action is so important that it calls the Stormwind Army away from its people?  Bah, I should not ponder aloud. Here, messenger.  Accept these coins in exchange for your service to the Township.  I might call upon you again.

text.title: 送往夜色镇的信
text.objectives: 所罗门镇长要求你给夜色镇的艾尔罗·埃伯洛克公爵送一封信。
text.description: 看来我又得有事麻烦你了。我写一了封信给艾尔罗·埃伯洛克公爵，请求他从他的精锐部队——暮色森林守夜人——中抽出一些人来协助湖畔镇的防务。这封信必须马上呈送给他，而且你在旅途中要多加小心。埃伯洛克公爵是夜色镇的行政官，那座小镇就在暮色森林中，小心不要迷路了。
text.progress: 看来你是千里迢迢赶到这里来的，$C。你到夜色镇来有什么事吗?
text.completion: 感谢你不远千里送信过来。这确实是个非常重要的消息。

english.title: Messenger to Darkshire
english.objectives: Magistrate Solomon wants you to take a letter to Lord Ebonlocke in Darkshire.
english.description: I require your assistance once again.  I have written to Lord Ebonlocke, requesting that he sends his trained guards, the Night Watch, to help with Lakeshire's defense.  It is imperative this message makes it to him swiftly.  You must exercise extreme caution.  Ebonlocke is the mayor of Darkshire, in the heart of Duskwood.  Do not stray from the roads.
english.progress: You appear to have traveled from afar, $C.  What business do you have here in Darkshire?
english.completion: Thank you for making the long journey here.  This is indeed important information.

text.title: 送往夜色镇的信
text.objectives: 将埃伯洛克公爵的回信带给所罗门镇长。
text.description: 如果我不是和所罗门镇长私交甚密的话，我一定会以为他是个疯子的。因为暴风城拒绝出兵援助，就让我们把守夜人部队派去湖畔镇？守夜人部队就是因为这里被邪恶的魔法所影响才建立起来的。如果我把他们派离这里的话，恐怕还没等到他们走出森林，这里就会被邪恶的势力彻底吞没。$B$B把这封回信带给你在湖畔镇的主人吧。
text.progress: 啊，很高兴看到你回来，信差。我是不是该通知我的治安官说，守夜人部队已经上路向这边来了?
text.completion: 圣光啊!暴风城的军队已经从西部荒野撤离了，现在他们竟然也放弃了夜色镇?这简直是背信忘义的举动!他们怎么能这么做?$B$B哦，我忘记了该给你的酬劳，$C。拿着这些钱吧，恕我失陪。暴风城里一定发生了什么事，我一定要把这一切弄清楚!

english.title: Messenger to Darkshire
english.objectives: Return to Magistrate Solomon with Lord Ebonlocke's letter of response.
english.description: If I did not know Magistrate Solomon personally, I would say the man has gone mad.  Send the Night Watch to Lakeshire because Stormwind refuses aid?  The Night Watch was formed because Stormwind left us when this foul magic seeped into the land.  If I sent my Night Watch, this town would be overrun by evil before the guards even reached the forest's edge.$b$bTake this letter of response to your Master in Lakeshire.
english.progress: Ah, good to see you back, messenger.  Shall I inform the Marshal that the Night Watch is on its way from Darkshire?
english.completion: By the Light!  The Stormwind Army retreated from Westfall.  And the Guard no longer protects Darkshire?  There is some treachery abound.  How could this be so? $B$BOh I forgot to reward your service, $C.  Here are some coins.  Now excuse me.  Something is amiss in Stormwind and I must get to the bottom of it.

text.title: 猎杀收货人
text.objectives: 找到“收货人”并杀掉他，然后带着收货人的戒指回来见治安官帕特尔森。
text.description: 如果这个“收货人”是私自从我们的矿洞里开采黄金的话，那么他就是在偷窃王国的金库！把他就地正法，然后把他的交易日程表上提到的戒指给我带来。也许这枚戒指能告诉我们这个“收货人”是在为谁工作……$B$B那张交易日程表上说“收货人”就藏在布莱克威尔南瓜田里，你应该到那儿去找他。
text.progress: 你找到收货人了吗?查出他为谁工作了吗?
text.completion: 你找到他了?干得好，$N。从此他再也不能偷盗王国的黄金了!$B$B你找到的这枚戒指挺有意思……这是暴风城石匠行业协会的会员戒指。这么一个卑贱的小偷怎么会有工匠协会的戒指?迪菲亚盗贼为什么要从我们的矿坑里偷黄金?$B$B真是一团乱麻，希望有一天我们能找到答案。
text.completed: Return to Marshal McCree at the Eastvale Logging Camp in Elwynn Forest.

english.title: Manhunt
english.objectives: Find and kill "the Collector"  then return to Marshal McCree with The Collector's Ring.
english.description: If the "Collector" is taking gold from our mines then he's stealing from the kingdom!  Bring the Collector to justice, and bring me the ring mentioned in the pickup schedule you gave me.  It may tell us whom the Collector is working for...$B$BThat Pickup Schedule says the Collector is hiding out at the Brackwell Pumpkin Patch.  You should search for him there.
english.progress: Did you find the Collector?  Did you discover whom he's working for?
english.completion: You found him?  Well done, $n.  He won't be "collecting" from the Elwynn Mines again! And this ring you found is interesting... it's a membership ring for the old Stonemason's Guild in Stormwind. I haven't seen one of these in years, since back in the days when the Defias Brotherhood used to infest this land.
english.completed: Return to Marshal McCree at the Eastvale Logging Camp in Elwynn Forest.

text.title: 来自夜色镇的货物
text.objectives: 去和伊瓦夫人谈一谈。
text.description: 哦，一个可怜的老人家还能做点什么呢？我需要从夜色镇拿点东西过来，不过路途太遥远，我又太老了……实在是走不动啊。$B$B你能去夜色镇给我拿点幽灵的发丝回来吗？你可以向伊瓦夫人要这东西，她的家就在夜色镇的广场旁。
text.completion: 啊，你要的是鬼魂的发丝，是吗?我已经没有存货了，不过如果你能提供鬼魂的头发的话，我可以做一些给你……

english.title: Supplies from Darkshire
english.objectives: Speak with Madame Eva.
english.description: Oh, what is a poor old man to do?  I need some supplies from Darkshire, but the village is so far away and I am so old and feeble...I would never make the trip.$B$BCan you go to Darkshire and bring me back some Ghost Hair Thread?  You can get it from Madame Eva at her home on the Darkshire square.
english.completion: Ah, Ghost Hair Thread is what you need, is it?  I'm afraid I have none in stock, but I can make some for you...if you can supply the ghost hair.

text.title: 幽灵的发丝
text.objectives: 把鬼梳带给盲眼玛丽。
text.description: 有个可怜的亡魂叫盲眼玛丽，她总是在夜色镇南部小山上的农宅里出没。$B$B拿着这把鬼梳，让盲眼玛丽用它梳头。然后再把梳子拿回来，我可以从上面收集到需要的幽灵的头发。$B$B小心点，那个屋子里潜伏着一些可怕的东西……
text.progress:
<哭泣>哦，不要，不要看着我!我自己把眼睛挖掉了，但是我还是能感觉到你在看我!$B$B我长得很丑陋!
很丑陋!求求你，把脸转过去吧!!
text.completion: 这是什么?梳子?太可爱了!它滑过我的头发，好像它们不再那么僵硬可怕了。$B$B唉，要是有面镜子该多好……

english.title: Ghost Hair Thread
english.objectives: Bring the Spectral Comb to Blind Mary.
english.description: There is a poor, sad spirit, Blind Mary, who haunts an old farm house in the hills south of Darkshire.$B$BHere, take this Spectral Comb and ask Blind Mary to comb her hair.  Then bring back the comb and I will glean from it the Ghost Hair I'll need for the thread.$B$BAnd take care, for dark things now lurk near that house...
english.progress: Oh please, don't look at me!  I tore out these eyes with my own hands, but I can still feel your gaze! I'm hideous!  Hideous!  Please, look away!!
english.completion: What is this?  A comb?  It's lovely!  And it glides through my hair as if it weren't the stiff, stringy horror that it is. Oh, if only I had a mirror...

text.title: 鱼人偷猎者
text.objectives: 给湖畔镇的码头管理员巴伦带回8片鱼人的鳍。
text.description: 鱼人们如今也成了一个问题。大群的鱼人渔民在止水湖沿岸下锚撒网，都快把湖里的鱼捞光了！我们得在他们把湖里的鱼都吃光之前把他们赶走！$B$B去猎杀那些鱼人！给我带回8片鱼人的鳍来，我会奖励你的。
text.progress: 把鳍带来了没?动作快点，我们一定得把这群鱼人赶出湖去!
text.completion: 做得好，$N。我希望这些鱼人没给你造成太大的麻烦。$B$B他们大老远的从海里跑到赤脊山来真是让人纳闷。我在想他们是不是在躲避什么……
text.completed: Return to Dockmaster Baren at Lakeshire in Redridge Mountains.

english.title: Murloc Poachers
english.objectives: Bring 8 Murloc Fins to Dockmaster Baren in Lakeshire.
english.description: Murlocs are becoming a problem.  Larger groups of the fishmen are dropping anchor along the shores of Lake Everstill and fishing up a storm!  We need them gone before they eat all the fish in the lake!$B$BHunt murlocs!  Bring me eight of their fins and I might have something for you...
english.progress: Do you have those fins?  Hurry, we need those murlocs driven from the lake!
english.completion: Well done, $n.  I hope you didn't have too much trouble with those murlocs.$B$BIt's strange seeing them so far from the sea.  I wonder if they're here because they're running from something...
english.completed: Return to Dockmaster Baren at Lakeshire in Redridge Mountains.

text.title: 老马布兰契
text.objectives: 西部荒野的弗娜·法布隆要求你带给她8捧燕麦。
text.description: 可怜的老马布兰契呀！我们让它干的活儿实在是太多了，看来它已经要累垮了。虽然我在离开农场以前就喂过了它，可谁会料到马车会在半路上坏掉呢？如果你能从田里替它取来几捧燕麦的话，我会对你感激不尽的。我想，你可以在田边找到足够的燕麦，不过你首先要将周围那些可怕的机器人先干掉。
text.progress: 老布兰契已经快累死了。你找到给它吃的燕麦了吗?
text.completion: 太感谢你了，$N!可怜的老布兰契一定会非常高兴的!
text.completed: 到西部荒野的傑生農場找弗娜·法布隆。

english.title: Poor Old Blanchy
english.objectives: Verna Furlbrow in Westfall wants you to bring her 8 Handfuls of Oats.
english.description: Poor Old Blanchy!  Such a tired beast after all the work we put her through. I fed her before we left the farm, but we weren't expecting the wagon to break on us. If you could bring her a few handfuls of oats from the fields, I'd be grateful.$B$BI bet you could find some around all of the farms in Westfall, if you can steer clear of those horrific machines that have taken over. There are several farms southwest of here.
english.progress: Old Blanchy is on her last leg.  Did you happen to find any oats for her?
english.completion: Thank you so much, $n!  Poor Old Blanchy will be so happy!
english.completed: Return to Verna Furlbrow at the Jansen Stead in Westfall.

text.title: 清理海岸
text.objectives: 杀死7只鱼人潮行者、7只鱼人战士、7只鱼人智者，还有7只鱼人滩行者，然后向西部荒野灯塔中的葛瑞森船长复命。
text.description: 你或许已经注意到了，海岸线上有许多船只的残骸。无尽之海确实是非常凶险，我们必须确保西部荒野海岸线上没有那些该死的鱼人到处徘徊，只有这样水手们才能安全地找到靠港的路线。$b$b去杀死7只鱼人潮行者、7只鱼人战士、7只鱼人智者，还有7只鱼人滩行者，完成任务之后到我这里来领取奖赏。
text.progress: 去杀死7名鱼人猎潮者、7名鱼人战士、7名鱼人神谕者，还有7名鱼人滩行者，完成任务之后到我这里来领取你的报酬。
text.completion: 做得好，$N。你的战斗能力非常不错。由于你的努力，西部荒野的海岸变的更安全了。
text.completed: Return to Captain Grayson at the Westfall Lighthouse in Westfall.

english.title: The Coast Isn't Clear
english.objectives: Kill 7 Tidehunters, 7 Warriors, 7 Oracles and 7 Coastrunners and return to Captain Grayson at the Westfall Lighthouse.
english.description: You probably noticed all of the shipwrecks along the coast.  The Great Sea is treacherous indeed.  The coast of Westfall needs to be kept clear, so that if sailors find their way to our beaches, they are safe.  The Murlocs are trouble though.$b$bKill 7 Tidehunters, 7 Warriors, 7 Oracles and 7 Coastrunners and I will see to it that you are rewarded.
english.progress: Kill 7 Tidehunters, 7 Warriors, 7 Oracles and 7 Coastrunners and I will see to it that you are rewarded.
english.completion: Well done, $n.  You have quite a knack for combat.  Thanks to you the Coast of Westfall is a safer place.
english.completed: Return to Captain Grayson at the Westfall Lighthouse in Westfall.

text.title: 红色皮质面罩
text.objectives: 给哨兵岭的哨兵加里安带回15条红色皮质面罩。
text.description: 我们与迪菲亚兄弟会的战局总是瞬息万变。最近我一直在监视着他们的活动，根据长期观察的结果，我发现他们的成员都戴着一种特殊的红色皮质面罩。$b$b给我带15条这种面罩回来吧，我会给你奖励的。
text.progress: 帮我拿15条红色皮头巾来，我就付给你可观的酬劳。
text.completion: 做得漂亮，$r。请挑选一件物品做为报酬吧，这是你应得的。
text.completed: Return to Scout Galiaan at Sentinel Hill in Westfall.

english.title: Red Leather Bandanas
english.objectives: Bring 15 Red Leather Bandanas to Scout Galiaan at Sentinel Hill.
english.description: The Defias Front is constantly shifting.  I've been following their movements for quite some time now.  On a side note, I've ascertained that many members of the gang can be tracked by the Red Leather Bandanas they wear.$b$bBring me 15 of these Bandanas and I'll see to it you are rewarded.
english.progress: Bring me 15 red leather bandanas and I'll pay you well.
english.completion: Nice work, $r.  Please accept one of these items as payment for all your hard work.
english.completed: Return to Scout Galiaan at Sentinel Hill in Westfall.

text.title: 归还梳子
text.objectives: 把幽灵的梳子拿回去交给夜色镇的伊瓦夫人。
text.description: 不！！！！！$B$B快把这个梳子拿走！$B$B我是个怪物，不会再有人说我好看了！
text.progress: 我想你已经见过盲眼玛丽了，你拿到梳子了吗?
text.completion: 我可以用这些做一个鬼魂发丝的线轴给你，还能剩下几个备用。这些就当做跟你买这些线的费用吧。

english.title: Return the Comb
english.objectives: Return the Ghost Hair Comb to Madame Eva in Darkshire.
english.description: NO!!!!!$B$BTake it, take this comb away from me!$B$BI'm a monster, and no one will ever think me lovely again!
english.progress: I sense that you have seen Blind Mary.  You have my Comb...?
english.completion: I can make a spool of Ghost Hair Thread with this, and have a few strands to spare.  Here are some coins for those extra strands.

text.title: 迪菲亚兄弟会
text.objectives: 护送迪菲亚叛徒前往迪菲亚兄弟会的秘密藏身处。迪菲亚叛徒把你带到范克里夫和他的手下的巢穴之后，尽快回去向格里安·斯托曼汇报相关信息。
text.description: 这么说，斯托曼就派了你这么一个芦柴棒一样的家伙来保护我？希望你能行，当然如果你再叫上几个朋友帮忙就好了。$B$B你知道你要做些什么吧？我会把你带到迪菲亚盗贼的巢穴去，而你呢，就得保护好我。当然，你最好离我近点，越近越好。现在全迪菲亚兄弟会的人都想要我的脑袋呢。要是他们看见我和你在一起，一定会来把咱们都宰了的。$B$B等你和你的朋友准备好之后，就来跟我说一声吧。
text.progress: 有事吗?
text.completion: 非常好，$N!即然知道他藏在那里，范克里夫就跟落入我们手中没两样了!
text.end: 护送迪菲亚叛徒，以找出范克里夫的藏身地点。
text.completed: Return to Gryan Stoutmantle at Sentinel Hill in Westfall.

english.title: The Defias Brotherhood
english.objectives: Escort the Defias Traitor to the secret hideout of the Defias Brotherhood.  Once the Defias Traitor shows you where VanCleef and his men are hiding out, return to Gryan Stoutmantle with the information.
english.description: So Stoutmantle sends a scrawny $r like you to protect me?  Guess you'll have to do.  Better bring some friends too. $b$bYou know the deal, right?  You watch my back and I'll take you to the Defias hideout.  But you better be close by my side.  The Defias gang wants my head now.  If they see me with you, they'll try to kill me.$b$bLet me know when you and any friends you can round up are ready to go.
english.progress: What business do you have with me? I am a very busy man...
english.completion: Most excellent, $n!  VanCleef is as good as ours now that we know where he is hiding.
english.end: Escort The Defias Traitor to discover where VanCleef is hiding
english.completed: Return to Gryan Stoutmantle at Sentinel Hill in Westfall.

text.title: 收集腐败之花
text.objectives: 收集8个腐败之花，交给夜色镇的旅店店主斯密茨。
text.description: 如果你能给我找些腐败之花来，我就可以酿造很多僵尸酒。$B$B这种花很难找到，听说在恐怖骸骨和骸骨魔的头骨里可以找到这种花……不过至今我还没有亲眼见过！$B$B乌鸦岭墓地和静谧花园里都有很多这样的骷髅，你可以在寻找腐败之花的时候顺便把他们干掉，夜色镇的人民会感激你的。
text.progress: 你好，$N。你帮我找到腐败之花了吗?
text.completion: 很好，你拿到腐败之花了。我会告诉守夜人奥瑟.埃伯洛克你杀了不少骷髅。$B$B守夜人的职责就是保卫夜色镇人民的安全，他们会很高兴知道还有其它人在帮他们打击暮色森林里的邪恶势力。
text.completed: Return to Tavernkeep Smitts at Darkshire in Duskwood.

english.title: Gather Rot Blossoms
english.objectives: Gather 8 Rot Blossoms and bring them to Tavernkeep Smitts in Darkshire.
english.description: If you bring me some rot blossoms then I can brew you up a batch of zombie juice.$B$BRot blossoms grow in strange places.  In particular, I hear you can find them inside the skulls of Skeletal Horrors and Skeletal Fiends... not that I've gotten close enough to look!$B$BThe Raven Hill Cemetery is lousy with those skeletons.  You may as well get rid of them while you're looking for rot blossoms.  The town of Darkshire would be grateful.
english.progress: Hi, $n.  Do you have those rot blossoms for me yet?
english.completion: Good,  you got the rot blossoms.  And I'll tell Althea Ebonlocke of the Night Watch that you were killing skeletons. Keeping the people of Darkshire safe is a grim burden for the Night Watch, and news that others are helping stem the tide of fiends in Duskwood is welcome news indeed.
english.completed: Return to Tavernkeep Smitts at Darkshire in Duskwood.

text.title: 幽灵的发丝
text.objectives: 把幽灵的发丝交给亚伯克隆比，他住在乌鸦岭墓地北边的房子里。
text.description: 这是你要的线，$n。它有很多种用途，比如用来束缚邪恶的亡魂，或者给没有生命的东西注入生命。
text.progress: 我要把鬼魂的发丝挂在门窗上，来阻绝那些该死的亡魂。你替我拿来发丝了吗?
text.completion: 真令人高兴!这对我太有用了……$B$B请拿着这个，$N，做为我对你可敬的帮助的报酬。

english.title: Deliver the Thread
english.objectives: Bring the Ghost Hair Thread to Abercrombie, in his shack north of the Raven Hill Cemetery.
english.description: Here is your thread, $n.  It has a thousand uses, from binding evil spirits to sewing life into inanimate objects.
english.progress: I need to string the Ghost Hair Thread along my door and my windows to keep out unwanted spirits.  Did you get it for me?
english.completion: Delightful!  This will do splendidly... Here, good $n, take this as payment for your honorable deed.

text.title: 僵尸
text.objectives: 去和旅店店主斯密茨谈一谈。
text.description: 我需要一瓶叫做僵尸酒的饮料。夜色镇血鸦旅店的店主斯密茨应该有些存货。$B$B最近晚上寒风刺骨，我得来点僵尸酒，好让我的血液重新沸腾起来。
text.completion: 你想要些僵尸汁?嗯…这东西味道很呛—很少有人点它。

english.title: Zombie Juice
english.objectives: Speak with Tavernkeep Smitts.
english.description: I need a bottle of a certain liquor - Zombie Juice.  Tavernkeep Smitts at the Scarlet Raven Tavern in Darkshire should have some.$B$BAnd please hurry, $n.  These nights get cold, and I need that drink to put fire in my veins again!
english.completion: You need some Zombie Juice, do you?  Hmm...that's some strong stuff - I don't usually get requests for it.

text.title: 僵尸酒
text.objectives: 把僵尸酒交给乌鸦岭墓地北方小屋里的亚伯克隆比。
text.description: 这是你要的僵尸酒……$B$B不过要小心一点，这酒烈得足以把死人给呛活过来。
text.progress: 我需要喝些僵尸汁在寒冷的夜里保持暖和。你替我拿僵尸汁来了吗?
text.completion: 真是太感谢你了，$N。你用你的愚蠢—我是说……你的善良―温暖了一个老人的心!$B$B拿着，这代表我的感激之情。

english.title: Juice Delivery
english.objectives: Bring the Zombie Juice to Abercrombie at his shack.
english.description: Here's your Zombie Juice...$B$B...and be careful with this stuff.  It's strong enough to raise the dead!
english.progress: I need that Zombie Juice to keep me warm on these cold, dark nights.  Did you get it for me?
english.completion: A thousand thanks, $n.  You warm an old man's heart with your foolish-...I mean...with your kindness! Here you are, friend.  Take this as a token of my gratitude.

text.title: 给镇长的信
text.objectives: 把亚伯克隆比的信交给夜色镇的艾尔罗·埃伯洛克镇长。
text.description: 请把这封信交给夜色镇的艾尔罗·埃伯洛克镇长。$B$B我和他是老朋友了……我敢说，当他读完信，并且知道了你为我做的事情……他一定会和我一样高兴的！哈哈哈哈！
text.progress: 亚伯克隆比……?我不认识这个人。你是说这个人有封信给我?$B$B哦，那我就收下好了……
text.completion: <艾罗看着信……>$B$B这信上写的是什么?看起来是种古老的语言……我看不懂。

english.title: Note to the Mayor
english.objectives: Bring Abercrombie's Letter to Ello Ebonlocke, Mayor of Darkshire.
english.description: Take this note to Ello Ebonlocke, the Mayor of Darkshire.$B$BHe and I are old friends...and when he reads it and discovers what you did for me...I'm sure he'll be just as happy as I am!  Hahahaha!
english.progress: Abercrombie...?  I don't know a person of that name.  You say you have a letter for me from this Abercrombie fellow? Well let's have it then...
english.completion: What language is this?  It looks ancient...I can't read it.

text.title: 水坝危机
text.objectives: 主工程师辛德维尔七世要你把怪味粉末交给丹莫德的炸药专家阿什兰·暗石。
text.description: 如果我的猜测没错的话，这是某种火药粉末。应该找个爆破专家来分析一下这到底是什么东西。阿什兰·暗石就在丹莫德和萨多尔大桥一带负责那里的警戒工作，我需要你尽快去找他，这是一段重要而危险的旅程，$N。$B$B走过奥加兹大门，沿着穿过湿地的大路一直到丹莫德去找爆破专家阿什兰·暗石。留心我的建议：沿着大路走，不要停留！
text.progress: 你说什麽，$G小兄弟:小姑娘;?除了我耳朵里的嗡嗡声之外，我什麽都听不见。说吧，你手里拿着的那是什麽?
text.completion: 嗯，老辛德尔的担心是有道理的。$B

english.title: A Dark Threat Looms
english.objectives: Chief Engineer Hinderweir wants you to take the strange smelling powder to Ashlan Stonesmirk, the explosives expert at the Mo'grosh Camp.
english.description: If my suspicions are correct, this is some type of explosive powder. This must be analyzed by an explosives expert so we know just what we're dealing with here.$B$BThere's only one man for the job. Ashlan Stonesmirk was assigned to monitoring the ogres at the Mo'grosh Stronghold to the east. Head that direction and locate him so that he can shed some light on what this substance is.
english.progress: You say somethin', sonny?  Can't hear a bloody thing besides the ringin' in me ears.  Say, what's that you got there?
english.completion: Ah, well Ol' Hinderweir is wise to be worried.

text.title: 异种蝎的威胁
text.objectives: 把报告带给达纳苏斯的格拉希娜·灵风。
text.description: 我希望你尽快把这份报告送到对处理此类事件有经验的人手里。$B$B我知道有一位名叫格拉希娜·灵风的暗夜精灵学者，她致力于研究卡利姆多大陆上那些与艾泽拉斯的普通生物截然不同的生物形态，她简直就是一本活的生物书！如果你想要知道我们面临的是怎样的威胁，以及如何解决这个威胁，那就把这份报告交给她吧，我们现在急需她的帮助。$B$B我听说她住在达纳苏斯的月亮神庙里。
text.progress: 你好，陌生的$C，愿安宁和平与你同在。你找我有什么事吗?
text.completion: 这个报告……我们夜精灵已经知道里面提到的威胁了。菲兹杜瑟让你把这份报告送到我这里来是很明智的。$B$B这些生物会迅速吞噬塔纳利斯的沙漠，它们将是我们所要面对的有史以来最大的威胁。$N，请记住它们的名字:异种蝎。报告里提到的这些昆虫就是异种蝎，它们对于部落和联盟来说都是一个威胁。$B$B除非我们能够早点意识到它的危害程度，否则后果不堪设想。

english.title: Rise of the Silithid
english.objectives: Take the Insect Analysis Report to Gracina Spiritmight in Darnassus.
english.description: I urge you to take this report to someone who has working knowledge in this kind of thing.$B$BI know this night elf scholar named Gracina Spiritmight.  She's spent a lot of time studying life forms that are unique to the ecology of Azeroth; she's a historian to boot!  If you want someone to help figure out what exactly this threat is, and more importantly how to stop it, give her the report.  We'll need the help.$B$BLast I heard, she was residing in the Temple of the Moon, located in Darnassus.
english.progress: Peace and tranquility be upon you, stranger.  Why have you sought me out this day?
english.completion: This report... we night elves know of the terror mentioned here.  Fizzledowser was wise to send this, and you, to me. These creatures will consume the Tanaris desert rapidly; they are nothing short of one of the greatest menaces we all will ever face.  Familiarize yourself with this name, $n: silithid.  The insects mentioned here are the silithid, and they are the tools of one of the greatest threats that both the Horde and Alliance face. If only we were smart enough to see that before.

text.title: 乌鸦岭
text.objectives: 查出是什么东西在乌鸦岭神出鬼没。
text.description: 乌鸦岭出了点问题，$n。卡洛尔说那边的房子里有什么人——或者怪物——出没。有两个晚上，他发现有个身影在活动，第三天晚上，某扇窗户里还射出了灯光。$b$b你如果真的关心暮色森林的安危，就去查一查，看看是什么样的怪物在乌鸦岭出没。
text.progress: 啊，$N！回来的这么快？你肯定又被野兽追了吧？别在意你经历的那些周折，终究它们会让你更强大！$B$B……至少，你也没变得更差
text.completion: 不要!请不要杀我!是我…基特斯……它们到处都是，我躲也躲不了!乌鸦岭有怪物?不，不…不可能。只有不会伤人的基特斯……

english.title: Raven Hill
english.objectives: Find out what is haunting Raven Hill.
english.description: Something's amiss at Raven Hill, $n. Calor swears that someone--or something--is haunting the buildings there. Two nights running he's noticed the shadows moving, and the third before that he says he saw light in one of the windows.$b$bIf, as you say, you care about the safety of Duskwood, find out what monster haunts in Raven Hill.
english.progress: Ah, $n! Back so soon? No doubt you've been at the hunt again? Don't worry if you've had some setbacks, in the long run it will make you better!$B$B...You couldn't get much worse, anyway...
english.completion: No! Please don't kill me! It's just me... Jitters!! They're everywhere... I can't escape them! Monsters in Raven Hill? N-n-n-o... couldn't be. Only harmless Jitters.

text.title: 斯温的货物
text.objectives: 把补给物资带给斯温。
text.description: 你认识斯温吗？谢天谢地，终于有人能帮我了！斯温和他的同伴在暮色森林的西北边有个营地。$b$b不幸的是，他们的人手太少了，少到派不出人回镇里来取一些必需的补给品。你能把这些物资带给斯温吗？
text.progress: 你看起来挺健壮的，$C。你是来帮我们战斗的吗?
text.completion: 这些物资很有用，我们对克尔文系列的帮助感激不尽。这是给你的一点小报酬。

english.title: Deliveries to Sven
english.objectives: Deliver the supplies to Sven.
english.description: Do you know Sven? Now, there is a man who does the work of the Light! He and his followers keep a camp at the northwestern edge of Duskwood.$b$bUnfortunately, because they are so few, they cannot even spare a man to fetch supplies from town. Will you deliver these supplies to him?
english.progress: You look a sturdy type, $c. Have you come to join our fight?
english.completion: These supplies will be most useful. The aid of the Carevin family is always appreciated. Here is a little something for your trouble.

text.title: 隐士
text.objectives: 去乌鸦岭墓地附近的小屋查看老人的情况。
text.description: 有个老人经常到镇里来买东西，不过我已经有些日子没见过他了。如果我没记错的话，他就住在一个可以俯视乌鸦岭墓地的小屋里。你能不能去看一看出什么事了？
text.completion: 伊莲.克尔文?呵呵，是的……当然，克尔文家的。不不不，我没什么事，只是现在要去镇上很困难。路上太危险了，而我已经不再年轻。你能帮帮我这个老头子吗?

english.title: The Hermit
english.objectives: Check on the old man in the shack near Raven Hill cemetery.
english.description: There was an old man who used to come into town to buy supplies rather frequently, but I haven't seen him for quite some time now. He lives out in a shack overlooking Raven Hill cemetery, if I remember correctly. Perhaps you should go see if something is amiss.
english.completion: Elaine Carevin? Hehe, oh yes... of course, the Carevins. No, nothing's wrong but it is hard for me to go into town now. The roads are dangerous and I'm not getting any younger. Maybe you can do an old man some favors?

text.title: 迪菲亚兄弟会
text.objectives: 杀死艾德温·范克里夫，把他的头交给格里安·斯托曼。
text.description: 这里恐怕还有最后一个任务需要你来完成。我们必须派人去除掉艾德温·范克里夫。说实话，就这样对一个活生生的人宣判死刑，这实在令我非常痛心，但为了西部荒野人民的利益，我不得不让范克里夫永远安息。把范克里夫干掉之后，提他的头来见我。
text.progress: 猎杀艾德温.范克里夫的事情进展如何了?
text.completion: $N，你的英雄壮举将长存于我们的心中。人民军将会对你为西部荒野人民所做的一切感激不尽。范克里夫一死，迪菲亚兄弟会的命运也开始走向灭亡。希望在不久之后的某一天，和平会重新降临到这片美丽的土地上。$B$B我向你致敬，$g先生:女士;!
text.completed: Return to Gryan Stoutmantle at Sentinel Hill in Westfall.

english.title: The Defias Brotherhood
english.objectives: Kill Edwin VanCleef and bring his head to Gryan Stoutmantle.
english.description: There is but one task left for you to complete.  Edwin VanCleef must be assassinated.  While it saddens me to condemn any man to a death sentence, it is for the greater good of the people of Westfall that VanCleef is laid to rest once and for all.  Bring me the villain's head once the deed is done.
english.progress: How goes the hunt for Edwin VanCleef?
english.completion: $n, your bravery is remarkable.  The People's Militia thanks you for your service to the people of Westfall.  With VanCleef dead, this marks the beginning of the end for the Defias Brotherhood.  Hopefully some day soon peace will once again grace the plains of this fair land. I salute you, Sir!
english.completed: Return to Gryan Stoutmantle at Sentinel Hill in Westfall.

text.title: 我的兄弟……
text.objectives: 将工头希斯耐特的探险者协会徽章交给暴风城的维尔德·蓟草。
text.description: 那时我们正在一个大矿洞中工作，就是那个隐藏在西部荒野月溪镇中的谷仓下面的矿洞……没人知道当时到底是怎么回事，总之矿道突然坍塌了，我逃了出来……可其他人就没那么好运了……我是说，从那以后我就再没听到过其他人的消息了。$b$b看上去你的运气可能会比我们好一点。如果你能帮我找到弟弟的话，我会非常感谢你的。他总是戴着一块探险者协会徽章，所以如果你找不到他的话，至少那块徽章能给我带来一些安慰……
text.progress: 你找到有关我弟弟的线索了吗?经过这么久的时间还有任何希望吗?
text.completion: 看来我的猜测没错。我可怜的弟弟……好吧，谢谢你让我知道了结果，尽管这结果令我非常难过。
text.completed: Return to Wilder Thistlenettle in Stormwind City.

english.title: Oh Brother. . .
english.objectives: Bring Foreman Thistlenettle's Explorers' League Badge to Wilder Thistlenettle in Stormwind.
english.description: We were deep in a vast mine in Westfall, hidden beneath a barn in Moonbrook. No clue where these stinkin' thieving types came from. Anyway, the mine tunnel collapsed on us. I got out but the others... well... the others haven't been heard from.$b$bYou look like you might have better luck in there. If you could look for my brother, I'd be thankful.  He always carried his Explorers' League Badge. If you can't find him, that badge would at least give me some peace of mind.
english.progress: Did you find any sign of my brother?  Is there any hope after all this time?
english.completion: My suspicions were correct.  My poor brother.... Well, thank you for bringing some conclusion to this mystery, even if the conclusion was grim.
english.completed: Return to Wilder Thistlenettle in Stormwind City.

text.title: 收集记忆
text.objectives: 给暴风城的维尔德·蓟草带回4张矿业工会会员卡。
text.description: 在那个可怕的日子，我的许多朋友都被埋在了矿洞里。如果你在冒险中正好路过月溪镇的那处矿洞的话，请帮忙留意一下有没有什么可以辨认他们身份的标志物品。如果你能找到他们的矿业工会会员卡的话，请一定要带给我，我好知道他们的结局，并与他们的家人谈谈如何为这次恐怖的事故善后。
text.progress: 你找回我那些老同事们的矿业工会会员卡了吗?
text.completion: 感谢你找回这些东西，$N。你的努力一定能使这些不幸死于事故的矿工们得到安息。我会马上通知他们的家人。
text.completed: Return to Wilder Thistlenettle in Stormwind City.

english.title: Collecting Memories
english.objectives: Retrieve 4 Miners' Union Cards and return them to Wilder Thistlenettle in Stormwind.
english.description: Many of my friends perished that horrible day when the mine tunnel caved in.  If your adventures happen to bring you into that wing of the mine in Moonbrook, please keep an eye out for any sign which might identify them.  If you come across any of their Miners' Union Cards, bring them back to me and I'll make sure their families get some resolution from this horrible accident.
english.progress: Were you able to retrieve any of my old co-worker's Miners' Union Cards?
english.completion: Thank you for collecting these, $n.  Your efforts will help bring peace to the dead in the wake of this tragedy.  I will see to it that the families are notified.
english.completed: Return to Wilder Thistlenettle in Stormwind City.

text.title: 通缉：加塞尔佐格
text.objectives: 杀死加塞尔佐格并取下他的徽记，向湖畔镇的所罗门镇长复命。
text.description: 悬赏！加塞尔佐格是黑石氏族袭击石堡和多次劫掠湖畔镇等行动的领导者。$b$b他是个十分危险的家伙。根据线报，他最近就躲藏在刚刚被他们攻陷的要塞中，谋划着黑石氏族的下一次劫掠行动。我们必须不惜一切代价把这些在我们的国土上横行的兽人镇压下去。如果谁能把加塞尔佐格的徽记带到所罗门镇长面前的话，他将会得到重赏。
text.progress: 有什么事吗，$C?
text.completion: 这实在是太棒了，$N!加塞尔佐格带着那帮畜牲为祸四方，杀了不少无辜的人。正义终究还是获胜了，这也是为暴风王国夺回要塞的第一步!
text.completed: Return to Magistrate Solomon at Lakeshire in Redridge Mountains.

english.title: Wanted: Gath'Ilzogg
english.objectives: Kill Gath'Ilzogg and bring his head to Magistrate Solomon in Lakeshire for the reward.
english.description: Wanted! Gath'Ilzogg, Leader of the Blackrock attacks on Stonewatch Keep and raids against the township of Lakeshire. $b$bGath'Ilzogg is extremely dangerous.  He is reportedly holed up in the recently conquered keep plotting the Blackrock clan's further crimes against humanity.  The orc infestation must be quelled at all costs.  A gracious reward will be given to whatever brave soul can deliver the head of Gath'Ilzogg to Magistrate Solomon.
english.progress: What do you have there, $r?
english.completion: Fantastic work, $n!  Gath'Ilzogg led those brutes into battle, killing many innocent humans.  Vindication is ours.  This is the first step in reclaiming the keep for the kingdom of Stormwind!
english.completed: Return to Magistrate Solomon at Lakeshire in Redridge Mountains.

text.title: 新的威胁
text.objectives: 巴尔林·霜锤让你去杀死6个石腭穴居人和6个壮实的石腭怪。
text.description: 我希望你能帮我们一把，$C。在上一次穴居人袭击之后，我们的人手就明显不够了。$B$B我听说他们现在已经遍布我们的国土，看来寒脊山谷也不能避免。东南部的山区和湖畔已经到处都是穴居人的身影了。$B$B糟糕的事情还不仅仅是这些，几天前，他们袭击并占领了我们西边的营地！$B$B我们这儿有些人手不足，$G孩子:姑娘;，我们需要强大的军队帮助我们赶走这些家伙。
text.progress: 这些穴居人真是烦人啊!
text.completion: 如果我们的土地上到处都是我们遇到的这些讨厌的家伙，以麦格尼胡须的名义，那我们就有大麻烦了!我只能盼望国王和参议院能尽快着手解决石腭怪带来的问题。
text.completed: Return to Balir Frosthammer at Coldridge Valley in Dun Morogh.

english.title: A New Threat
english.objectives: Balir Frosthammer wants you to kill 6 Rockjaw Troggs and 6 Burly Rockjaw Troggs.
english.description: I hope you're here to lend us a hand, $c. After the last trogg attack, we could use all the help we can get.$b$bI hear the buggers have been popping up all across the lands, and it seems Coldridge Valley is no exception. They've been spotted all over the hills to the southeast and near the frozen lake.$b$bAnd that's not all, just a few nights ago, they attacked and overran our camp to the west! $b$bWe're a bit shorthanded here, $g lad : lass;, and we need strong arms to help drive the troggs back.
english.progress: Tenacious little buggers, aren't they?
english.completion: If the problems we've had here are indicative of what is happening elsewhere in our lands, by Magni's beard, we have some troubles ahead of us! I can only hope that the king and Senate are taking steps to deal with the threat the troggs pose.
english.completed: Return to Balir Frosthammer at Coldridge Valley in Dun Morogh.

text.title: 联盟孤儿的看护者
text.objectives: 从克拉格·摇塞那里购买泡沫塑料剑架，然后将你的孤儿送回暴风城孤儿院，同教堂区的孤儿监护员奈丁加尔交谈，送你的孤儿回家。
text.description: 你对我真好，$n。我从来没有想过会在儿童周得到如此多的乐趣，谢谢你。$B$B真希望所有孤儿都会像我这样幸运，体验和我们一样的精彩经历。你觉得我们能不能再找到克拉格·摇塞，从他那里弄到一副泡沫塑料的剑架？我想，他应该还在贸易区外面的运河边上推他的小车子。这样，孤儿院的孩子们也能和我一起分享乐趣了！$B$B然后，我就要回家了。
text.progress: 很高兴再见到你，$N。你有没有在儿童周中完成自己的义务?
text.completion: 愿上天保佑你，$N。你已经为兰迪斯做了太多别人想不到的事情。感谢你―你是照耀着联盟的一颗璀璨的星星。$B$B如果你有时间的话，请再回来看看我们。我知道兰迪斯会期待着你的到来，我也会欢迎你。$B$B兰迪斯和你相处的很愉快，$N。他想给你一只他最爱的宠物让你时时想着他。
text.completed: Return to Orphan Matron Nightingale in Stormwind City.

english.title: A Warden of the Alliance
english.objectives: Purchase a Foam Sword Rack from Craggle Wobbletop and then return your ward to the Stormwind orphanage by speaking to Orphan Matron Nightingale in the Cathedral District.
english.description: You have been so very kind to me, $n.  I never dreamed that I'd have so much fun during Children's Week.  Thank you.$B$BI wish all the orphans were lucky enough to get to do the stuff we did. Do you think we could find Craggle Wobbletop again and get a foam sword rack from him? I think he's still pushing that cart in the Canals outside the Trade District. That way, everyone else at the orphanage could do something fun too!$B$BAfter that, it'll be time for me to go home.
english.progress: It is a pleasure to see you again, $n.  Have you attended to the duties you've volunteered for during Children's Week?
english.completion: What's this? A gift for all the orphans! May the heavens bless you, $n.  You've done more for Randis than most would ever think of doing for him.  Thank you - you're a shining star in the skies of the Alliance. Randis had so much fun with you, $n.  He wanted to give you one of his favorite pets to remember him by.
english.completed: Return to Orphan Matron Nightingale in Stormwind City.

text.title: 儿童周
text.objectives: 使用兽人孤儿哨与你即将在儿童周期间照顾的孩子进行对话。
text.description: 你愿意帮助我们的孤儿院？太感谢你了，我的朋友。感谢你愿意在儿童周的这段时间内为我们提供帮助。$B$B拿着这只哨子，你只能在儿童周的这7天内使用它。当你使用它的时候，就可以和那些由你负责照看的孩子进行对话，再次使用就可以解散那个孩子。$B$B不管怎么样，$n——使用这个口哨，见一见你的小朋友！我相信孩子们一定很想见到你。
text.completion: 啧啧!我的名字叫葛兰斯，我想你是来照看我的吧?你是一个冒险者，就像我爸爸妈妈一样。我很高兴能遇到你。$B$B我希望我们之间能相处融洽。我有些事情想要做，而孤儿院院长说你在这个星期里会像大$G哥哥:姐姐;一样照顾我。我真是太高兴了。

english.title: Children's Week
english.objectives: Use the Orcish Orphan Whistle to talk with the child you will be looking after during Children's Week.
english.description: You're willing to help us here at the orphanage?  Bless you, friend; your aid during Children's Week will be invaluable.$B$BTake this whistle.  You will only be able to use it for a short amount of time - typically not longer than Children's Week itself.  When you use it, you will be able to talk with the child you've agreed to look after.  Using it again will dismiss the child.$B$BBy all means $n - use the whistle and meet your ward!  I'm sure the child will be most eager to meet you.
english.completion: Zug zug!  My name is Grunth, and I guess you're looking after me?  You're an adventurer, like my mom and dad were.  My matron says that they died with honor in battle.  I'm happy to meet you. I hope we'll do plenty of things together.  I have some things I'd like to do, and the matron says you'll be like a big brother to me during this week.  I'd like that a whole bunch.

text.title: 森林里的狼人
text.objectives: 为夜色镇的卡洛尔杀掉6个夜行织影狼人。
text.description: 黑暗的势力正在笼罩暮色森林，而卡尔文主人正在努力驱除邪恶，保护夜色镇人民的安全是我们的职责。$b$b你觉得自己有能力加入我们吗？$b$b我以前也跟你想的一样，因为对哨所的安逸悠闲感到绝望，我投靠了卡尔文主人。如果你想要证明自己的实力，不是只靠嘴皮子说说就可以的。$b$b去找夜行织影狼人较量较量吧，他们经常在阳光树林——阳光，哈！——和烂果园出没。
text.progress: $N，你干得如何了?
text.completion: 很不错，$N。看来你完全有能力应付他们，也许还可以做得更好。$B$B真的很奇怪……狼人们似乎都是凭空冒出来的，随后又有许多其它奇怪的东西进入了我们的土地，想必狼人也只不过是众多麻烦中的一个罢了。
text.completed: Return to Calor at Darkshire in Duskwood.

english.title: Worgen in the Woods
english.objectives: Kill 6 Nightbane Shadow Weaver worgen for Calor in Darkshire.
english.description: Darkness seems drawn inexorably to Duskwood. Master Carevin's quest is the expulsion of evil and heresy. Through our efforts are the people of Darkshire kept safe.$b$bYou believe yourself worthy to join us?$b$bI once thought as you. Disillusioned by the complacency of the Watch, I joined Master Carevin. If you wish to prove yourself, it will not be through words.$b$bTest your skills against the Nightbane Shadow Weaver worgen in Brightwood Grove--bright, hah!--and the Rotting Orchard.
english.progress: $n, how fares the hunt?
english.completion: Impressive, $n. It would seem that you are capable enough to handle yourself. Perhaps a more suitable challenge could be found for one of your abilities.$B$BIt is curious though... The worgen seemed to just appear out of thin air. But then, with all the other strange creatures that have moved across our borders, I suppose it's only one of many concerns.
english.completed: Return to Calor at Darkshire in Duskwood.

text.title: [DEPRECATED] 仰望星空
text.objectives: 夜色镇的维克托·安特拉斯要你给他找一根青铜管。
text.description: 我的侏儒朋友考格说过要帮我制造一个可以用来观察星空的装置。我相信除了魔法之外，还有别的理由可以解释发生在这片森林中的奇怪变化。$b$b根据考格的设计图，首先要去找一个手艺高超的技师，让他帮忙造一根青铜管。
text.progress: 你找到可以制造青铜管的工程师了吗?
text.completion: 太完美了，$N。第一步已经完成了!$B
text.completed: Return to Viktori Prism'Antras at Darkshire in Duskwood.

english.title: [DEPRECATED]Look To The Stars
english.objectives: Viktori Prism'Antras of Darkshire wants you to bring him a bronze tube.
english.description: My Gnomish friend, Cog, has promised to help me build a device which will let me peer towards the stars.  A truth exists, beyond magic, that can explain the strange transformation in the forest.$b$bBring to me a bronze tube made by a skilled engineer.  That is the first step, according to Cog's blueprint.
english.progress: Have you found a skilled engineer to create a bronze tube yet?
english.completion: This is perfect, $n.  The first step is complete!
english.completed: Return to Viktori Prism'Antras at Darkshire in Duskwood.

text.title: [DEPRECATED] 仰望星空
text.objectives: 找到玛丽，说服她借给你一个反光镜，用于维克托的计划。
text.description: 根据考格的设计图，现在我还需要一个东西来反射光线。我记得有个叫玛丽的女人因为总是戴着一副眼镜而在这一带人人皆知，你可以去找找她，向她借一个反光镜。我记得她曾经住在暮色森林南部……
text.completion: 哦，当然，我以前是有只单眼透镜。$B

english.title: [DEPRECATED]Look To The Stars
english.objectives: Locate Mary and persuade her to give up a reflective surface for Viktori's project.
english.description: According to Cog's blueprint, what I need now is a way to reflect light.  I remember a woman by the name of Mary who became well known around these parts for always carrying a looking glass.  Perhaps you can track Mary down and see if she might lend us a reflective surface for this project?  I believe she once resided in southern Duskwood. . .
english.completion: Why yes, I used to own a looking glass.

text.title: 通缉：霍格
text.objectives: 杀死豺狼人霍格，然后去见治安官杜汉。
text.description: 通缉：霍格$B$B巨型豺狼人霍格，现正在艾尔文森林西南部的树林里游荡。他成功地对抗了目前为止所有追捕他的行动。$B$B暴风城已经为除去这只豺狼人设下了酬金，想得到酬金的猎手必须进入那片丛林，消灭那头怪兽。
text.progress: 没错，霍格一直让我们倍感头疼。你有关于他的消息?
text.completion: 哈!干得好!我还以为没人能干掉那个怪物呢!$B$B拿着这个，$N。谢谢你―这只豺狼人给我带来的麻烦足有黑石塔那么大!
text.completed: 到艾爾文森林的閃金鎮找治安官杜漢。

english.title: Wanted:  "Hogger"
english.objectives: Deal with "The Hogger Situation" and return to Marshal Dughan.
english.description: Wanted: Hogger$B$BA huge gnoll, Hogger, is prowling the woods in southwestern Elwynn.  He has overpowered all attempts at his capture.$B$BThe Stormwind Army has placed a generous bounty on the Gnoll.  To earn the reward, bounty hunters should venture into the woods and deal with the beast.
english.progress: Yes, Hogger has been a real pain for me and my men. You have something to report about the beast?
english.completion: He did WHAT? Great, now we have a bloodthirsty beast right beneath the streets of Stormwind, with a whole army of gnolls at his command.  Definitely an improvement, I feel safer already. Here's your reward, $n.  But promise me you'll check in with the Stockades guards in Stormwind at some point, just to ensure that things are going smoothly.
english.completed: Return to Marshal Dughan at Goldshire in Elwynn Forest.

text.title: [DEPRECATED] 仰望星空
text.objectives: 从疯狂的食尸鬼那里拿回盲眼玛丽的眼镜，把它交给夜色镇的维克托。
text.description: 那副眼镜是我最珍贵的宝物，不过在发生了一件事情之后……我就把它丢在谷仓后面了。有个疯狂的食尸鬼曾经在那一带徘徊，可能是它把东西给捡走了。有人说那个邪恶的家伙住在静谧花园墓场出现。
text.progress: 考格看过我们的观星机器的雏形之后非常满意。你找到合适的反光镜了吗?
text.completion: 太棒了!这面反光镜很有用，非常感谢你!$B
text.completed: Return to Viktori Prism'Antras at Darkshire in Duskwood.

english.title: [DEPRECATED]Look To The Stars
english.objectives: Retrieve Blind Mary's Looking Glass from the Insane Ghoul and give it to Viktori in Darkshire.
english.description: The looking glass was one of my finest treasures until. . .the incident.  After that happened, I discarded it behind the barn.  There was an Insane Ghoul who used to roam back there.  Perhaps he picked it up.  Rumor has it the devilish beast resides in the Tranquil Gardens Cemetery.
english.progress: I showed Cog the beginnings of our star-viewing machine.  He was impressed.  Did you happen to find a reflective device?
english.completion: Most superb!  This will work perfectly.  Many thanks!
english.completed: Return to Viktori Prism'Antras at Darkshire in Duskwood.

text.title: 塞欧克瑞图斯的坠饰
text.objectives: 将不再发光的暗皮坠饰带给艾尔文森林中阿祖拉之塔的法师塞欧克瑞图斯。
text.description: <你听到了某种飘渺的声音>$B$B可别被吓着。我是塞欧克瑞图斯，艾尔文森林的阿祖拉之塔里的高阶法师。你手上拿着的饰物是暗皮豺狼人和他们的主子莫甘斯用来联络的工具。$B$B根据这几个月的研究，我也已经掌握了使用这些饰物进行通信的方法。如果你能听到我所说的话，就证明我的法术成功了。$B$B把这个饰物带给我，我会给你酬劳的。
text.progress: 你说我透过一个队子和你说话?快给我，我好研究研究它。
text.completion: 太感谢你了，$N。几周前我也曾尝试过对影皮坠饰送出同样的讯息，但是没有收到任何回应。不过这个法术似乎对某些坠子还是能够发挥效果，虽然延迟了非常久。$B$B接下来我要研究怎样通过这些饰物进行攻击，来麻痹所有把带着这东西的豺狼人。$B$B不过要完成这件事情，我恐怕得花很长的时间来研究它。

english.title: Theocritus' Retrieval
english.objectives: Bring the Faded Shadowhide Pendant to Theocritus the Mage at the Tower of Azora in Elwynn Forest.
english.description: <You hear a disembodied voice...>$B$BDo not be alarmed.  I am Theocritus, High Mage of Tower Azora in Elwynn Forest.  The pendant you are holding is a method of communication between the Shadowhide Gnolls and their master, Morganth.$B$BThrough months of research, I believe I too can communicate through these pendants.  If you can hear this message, then my spell was a success.$B$BBring me this pendant and I will reward you for the service.
english.progress: I spoke to you through a pendant, you say?  Hmm...give it to me, so that I might study it.
english.completion: You have my gratitude, $n.  I sent that message to the Shadowhide Pendants weeks ago and had believed it a failure.  But it seems the spell did reach at least some pendants, after a significant delay.$B$BIn time I hope to learn how to send an attack through the pendants, to immobilize any Shadowhide Gnolls who wear them.$B$BBut before that is possible, I'm afraid that much more research is required.

text.title: 矮人的交易
text.objectives: 斯登·粗臂想要8块硬狼肉。
text.description: 嘿，你是新来的吧？看来你需要些暖手的东西，对吗？$b$b我想你应该想要一副保暖的手套。我是个热心肠，很愿意给你一副手套，不过我有个条件。$b$b你帮我弄些狼肉来，我保证你不会被冻掉手指头。你觉得怎么样？
text.progress: 那些狼好对付吗?它们的狂牙利爪没有伤到你吧?
text.completion: 啊，太棒了!狼肉一定不错。哦，别着急，$N。我没有忘记当初的承诺，你看中了哪件就拿哪件吧。
text.completed: Return to Sten Stoutarm at Coldridge Valley in Dun Morogh.

english.title: Dwarven Outfitters
english.objectives: Sten Stoutarm would like 8 pieces of Tough Wolf Meat.
english.description: What do we have here? You look as though you might need something to keep your hands warm, hm?$b$bI'll tell you what would help: a pair of nice, warm gloves. And, being the kind soul that I am, I'd be more than happy to provide you with a suitable pair. I've one condition, however.$b$bI need you to go get me some wolf meat. Nice arrangement, hm? You bring me some wolf meat, and I'll make sure you don't lose any digits to frostbite. Well, what do you say?
english.progress: Wolves giving you a bit of trouble? You'd do well to avoid the fangs and claws and other sharp bits, yes?
english.completion: Ah! Wonderful. The wolf meat should do nicely. Oh, don't worry, $n, I wouldn't forget my part of the bargain. Here, one of these should fit you.
english.completed: Return to Sten Stoutarm at Coldridge Valley in Dun Morogh.

text.title: 通缉：范高雷中尉
text.objectives: 杀死范高雷并将他的手掌割下，向湖畔镇的所罗门镇长复命。
text.description: 悬赏：范高雷$b$b恶行累累的豺狼人头目范高雷在湖畔镇及王国的敌人莫甘斯的指使下，带着暗皮豺狼人氏族到处为非作歹。镇长所罗门下了命令，悬赏杀死这个万恶的东西。将他的手掌割下来拿给镇长，以此证明他的死亡。
text.progress: 你有什么事吗?
text.completion: 邪恶的范高雷中尉终于死了?对这个歹毒的家伙来说，这也算是个解脱吧。你很勇敢，$C。我代表湖畔镇的人民对你的帮助表示感谢。
text.completed: Return to Magistrate Solomon at Lakeshire in Redridge Mountains.

english.title: Wanted: Lieutenant Fangore
english.objectives: Kill Lieutenant Fangore and return to Magistrate Solomon in Lakeshire with his paw.
english.description: Wanted: Lieutenant Fangore$b$bKnown leader of the Shadowhide Gnoll Clan, working under the enemy of the Township and Kingdom, Morganth.  By mandate of Magistrate Solomon, this vile betrayer of Stormwind is wanted dead.  Show his paw to the Magistrate as proof of his death.
english.progress: What news do you bring before the Court?
english.completion: So the evil Lieutenant Fangore is dead?  Good riddance to that foul creature.  You are very brave, $c.  The Township of Lakeshire thanks you for your aid.
english.completed: Return to Magistrate Solomon at Lakeshire in Redridge Mountains.

text.title: [DEPRECATED] 仰望星空
text.objectives: 在暮色森林南部的食人魔土丘上找到扎克乌尔，把他的单片眼镜带回夜色镇交给维克托。
text.description: 根据考格的设计图，现在我们还需要一种透镜来完成整个装置。我知道什么地方有合适的透镜，不过很难拿到。$B$B有个叫扎克乌尔的食人魔住在暮色森林南部的土丘上，如果可以的话，你去把他的单片眼镜拿来吧，我可以用它做透镜。
text.progress: 你有没有说服札克乌尔把他的单片眼镜借给我们做实验?
text.completion: 观星工具终于完成了!谢谢你，$N。现在我可以继续我的研究了……
text.completed: Return to Viktori Prism'Antras at Darkshire in Duskwood.

english.title: [DEPRECATED]Look To The Stars
english.objectives: Locate Zzarc'Vul in the southern ogre mound in Duskwood and return his monocle to Viktori in Darkshire.
english.description: Now there is just one more item needed to complete this device.  Cog's blueprint calls for a lens of some sort.  The only lens I know of that would be large enough will be very difficult to acquire.$b$bThere is an ogre by the name of Zzarc'Vul who resides in the mound in southern Duskwood.  If you can, bring to me his monocle and I will use that as our lens!
english.progress: Were you able to convince Zzarc'Vul to lend us his monocle for our experiment?
english.completion: At last!  The stargazing device is complete!  Thank you, $n.  Now I can continue my research. . .
english.completed: Return to Viktori Prism'Antras at Darkshire in Duskwood.

text.title: 巨魔的威胁
text.objectives: 杀死10个霜鬃巨魔新兵。
text.description: 巨魔越来越活跃了。要我说的话，是比通常更活跃。我们也不是没见过他们成群结伙地出战，但这一次……不太一样。$b$b不过，最重要的是保证安威玛尔的安全。我可不能让这些巨魔趁着安威玛尔全力应付石腭怪的时候，对它造成什么伤害。去削减他们的数量，让他们知道，我们并不是毫无防御能力。
text.progress: 据我所知，这些巨魔来自于霜鬃氏族。$N，恐怕我没有什么其他的资讯可以告诉你了。
text.completion: 啊!那些天杀的巨魔!$B$B<他深吸了几口气，似乎想平静下来……>$B$B一伙巨魔趁着夜色溜了进来，把我的日记给偷走了!我就知道我那没用的学……
text.completed: Return to Grelin Whitebeard in Dun Morogh.

english.title: The Troll Menace
english.objectives: Kill 10 Frostmane Troll Whelps.
english.description: The trolls're acting up.  More than usual, I'd say.  We've seen them put together war parties before, but this time it's... different.$b$bWhat matters most, however, is the continued protection of Anvilmar.  I've no intention to let these trolls flank Anvilmar while its attention is turned towards troggs.  Go thin their ranks a bit.  They need to know that we're still not without defenses.
english.progress: From what I've learned, these trolls hail from the Frostmane clan. I'm afraid I don't know much else about them that would be of any use to you, $n.
english.completion: Hopefully that did the trick.  Anvilmar will be safe from trolls for the time being.  Now, to find out what it is that has the trolls so agitated.
english.completed: Return to Grelin Whitebeard in Dun Morogh.

text.title: 猎杀野猪
text.objectives: 塔林·锐眼让你去杀掉12只小型峭壁野猪。
text.description: 没什么能比得上用一整天的时间去打野猪更让人愉快的了，对吧？不过，寒脊山谷里的野猪太多了，你几乎已经不可能在那里再感受到狩猎的乐趣。你根本不需要去激怒它们，因为它们早就是怒气冲天，随时准备用獠牙把你拱上天了！事实上，这些过剩的野猪已经对我的日常狩猎形成了威胁。$B$B长话短说吧，如果你能帮我杀掉些野猪，我真的会非常感激你的。
text.progress: 捕猎进行得如何啦?
text.completion: 太好了!我现在又能回到当初那从容而快乐的狩猎生活了。谢谢你，$N。
text.completed: Return to Talin Keeneye at Coldridge Valley in Dun Morogh.

english.title: The Boar Hunter
english.objectives: Talin Keeneye would like you to kill 12 Small Crag Boars.
english.description: Nothing like a day of boar hunting, eh?$b$bThough, here in Coldridge Valley, there are so many boars it almost takes the fun out of it. No need to get them charging. They're all angry and ready without any help. In fact, recently, there've been so many boars in the area, it's become dangerous for me to do my daily hunting.$b$bLong story short, if you could help me kill some of the boars, I would appreciate it.
english.progress: How goes the hunt?
english.completion: Excellent! I can go back to my... leisurely... hunting now. Thank you, $n.
english.completed: Return to Talin Keeneye at Coldridge Valley in Dun Morogh.

text.title: 法布隆的地契
text.objectives: 把法布隆的地契带到西部荒野的贾森农场去。
text.description: 这是一张位于西部荒野的农田旧地契，由西奥多·法布隆和他的妻子弗娜·法布隆联名签署。地契背面还有潦草的字样：$B$B“我们到法布隆家里走了一遭，弄到了他的地契。我们觉得你可以很轻易地照着这张样本给自己也造出几份地契来。$B$B法布隆家的人不会找我们的麻烦，我最后一次看到他们的时候，他们的马车坏在了离开西部荒野的路上。”$B$B你觉得法布隆夫妻俩可能正在到处找这张地契……
text.progress: 你有我的农场的地契??真是太好了!几天前有几个恶棍把它给偷走了……我还以为再也找不回来了!$B$B请把它还给我吧。我们正要离开西部荒野，短期内不会回来了，不过万一日后我们又要再回来的话，我们就会需要这些文件。
text.completion: 太感谢你了，$N。如同我所说的，这一带已经不再适合老实人住了，不过当情况好转的时候，我们就可以用这张地契来收回我们的土地。$B$B我没什么东西可以给你，但请收下这个。

english.title: Furlbrow's Deed
english.objectives: Bring Furlbrow's Deed to the Jansen Stead in Westfall.
english.description: This is an old deed to an expanse of farmlands within Westfall.  It is signed by a Theodore Furlbrow and cosigned by his wife, Verna.  And on the back of the deed are hastily scrawled words:$B$B"We leaned on Furlbrow and got his deed.  Thought it might be handy if you wanted to forge one of these for your own place.$B$BThe Furlbrows won't give us trouble.  Last I saw them they were on their way out of Westfall, stuck with a broken wagon."$B$BYou think the Furlbrows might want their deed back...
english.progress: We don't need any civilian vigilante types getting involved, kid. Leave this one to the professionals.
english.completion: This is useless. Look at the date on this letter. The Furlbrows have been squatting on the Jansen Steed for five years. They never could quite get their wagon... fixed.

text.title: 捕杀猛虎
text.objectives: 猎杀10只荆棘谷猛虎幼崽。
text.description: 当我还只是个小女孩的时候，我的父亲就开始训练我捕猎老虎。$b$b一般来说，你会发现虎崽是非常容易追踪和猎杀的，在探险队的营地附近很容易就能找到虎崽。$b$b让我们来测试一下你的追踪技巧，看看你是否能猎杀这些野兽。到南边，靠近我们营地的地方去练练手吧。
text.progress: 在你证明你有足够的技巧来猎杀小猛虎前，我并没有信心能将你训练得更好。
text.completion: 干得不错，$N。你已经可以进行下一步了。
text.completed: Return to Ajeck Rouack at Nesingwary's Expedition in Northern Stranglethorn.

english.title: Tiger Hunting
english.objectives: Hunt 10 Young Stranglethorn Tigers.
english.description: When I was but a young girl, my father trained me in the art of tiger hunting.$b$bYou'll find the young felines much easier to track and slay.  One can often find young tigers near the expedition camp.$b$bTest your tracking skills and see if you can hunt some of the beasts down.  Start your hunt near our camp, to the south.
english.progress: I don't feel confident in training you further, $n, until you have proven yourself skilled in slaying the youngest of the tigers first.
english.completion: You have finished with the young tigers... but the thrill of the hunt still holds you captive.
english.completed: Return to Ajeck Rouack at Nesingwary's Expedition in Northern Stranglethorn.

text.title: 追踪猛虎
text.objectives: 猎杀10只荆棘谷猛虎。
text.description: 虎崽是一回事，成年的猛虎则是另一回事。在荆棘谷猎杀成年的猛虎就更有挑战性了。$b$b成年虎主要在河东边的库尔森的营地南边一带活动。
text.progress: 如果你想要接受更大的挑战，就必须要先完成我交付给你的任务来证明你的实力。杀死10只荆棘谷猛虎后再回来找我。
text.completion: 你让我印象很深刻，$C。你进展的非常顺利。
text.completed: Return to Ajeck Rouack at Nesingwary's Expedition in Northern Stranglethorn.

english.title: Tiger Stalking
english.objectives: Hunt 10 Stranglethorn Tigers.
english.description: Young tigers are one thing.  Fully-grown cats are another.  Hunting the grown Stranglethorn tigers will prove an even greater challenge.$b$bThe adult cats normally spend their days south of Kurzen's Compound, east of the river.
english.progress: If you strive for greater challenges you must first prove yourself with the task at hand. Return to me after you've killed 10 Stranglethorn Tigers.
english.completion: Tiger blood coats your hands, your weapons, and your $c garb.  Yet still you crave more.
english.completed: Return to Ajeck Rouack at Nesingwary's Expedition in Northern Stranglethorn.

text.title: 勇斗猛虎
text.objectives: 猎杀5只老年荆棘谷猛虎。
text.description: 老年的荆棘谷猛虎是最强壮的老虎。不止一个$r$c丧命于这些尖牙利爪的猛兽。$B$B如果艾耶克得知你击败了这些猛虎，一定会非常兴奋的。大批的老年猛虎聚集在在南边的地陷裂口附近，就在与荆棘谷海角的交界处。
text.progress: 在面对最后的挑战之前，你必须先杀死10只老年荆棘谷猛虎，否则你是没资格成为一位真正的猎虎大师的。
text.completion: 你给我留下了深刻的印象，我相信你已经准备好面对最后的挑战了。
text.completed: Return to Ajeck Rouack at Nesingwary's Expedition in Northern Stranglethorn.

english.title: Tiger Prowess
english.objectives: Hunt 5 Elder Stranglethorn Tigers.
english.description: Elder Stranglethorn tigers are the strongest of the bunch.  More than one $r $c has seen $g his: her; own demise at the tip of those razor-sharp teeth and heavy claws.$b$bAjeck will be thrilled to know that you have bested them.  The largest pack of these elders can be found to the south, near the Sundering, on the border of the Cape of Stranglethorn.
english.progress: You must kill 10 Elder Stranglethorn Tigers before I give you the final challenge that will determine if you are a true tiger hunting master.
english.completion: You have defeated the strongest tigers in Stranglethorn.  You have become a great tiger hunter, and have every right to stop your hunt right here and now. Something tells you, however, that a stronger cat still waits for you within that jungle...
english.completed: Return to Ajeck Rouack at Nesingwary's Expedition in Northern Stranglethorn.

text.title: 制服猛虎
text.objectives: 猎杀辛达尔，并带回它的爪子。
text.description: 传说中，有一只神秘的母虎……它强大到足以令老年的雄虎相形见绌。奈辛瓦里远征队的猎人曾经尝试猎杀它，但总是无功而返。他们中有许多人死于它的利爪，尸首留在格罗姆高北边的山脚下。$B$B他们称它为辛达尔。$B$B你决定做一件从来没有$r做到过的事：猎杀辛达尔，将它的爪子作为战利品。
text.progress: 猎杀辛达尔的事情进行得如何啦?
text.completion: 我得说，你真是太出色了!你现在是一位真正的猎虎大师了，$N!
text.completed: Return to Ajeck Rouack at Nesingwary's Expedition in Northern Stranglethorn.
text.giverWindow: 它喜欢在自己的山头上俯视其它弱小的老虎。

english.title: Tiger Mastery
english.objectives: Hunt Sin'Dall and return with her paw.
english.description: Legends speak of an elusive tigress... a feline so powerful that she dwarfs even the elder males.  The hunters at Nesingwary's Expedition have hunted for her without success.  Many of them have fallen prey to her raking claws, their bodies now decaying at the foot of her hill, north of Grom'gol.$b$bThey call the beast Sin'Dall.$b$bYou resolve to do what no $r has done before: hunt, kill, and claim the paw of Sin'Dall.
english.progress: How goes the hunt?
english.completion: Most impressive, I do say!  I send you out to defeat the kittens, and you return with a paw the size of a gnome!  You are a true Master Tiger Hunter, $n!
english.completed: Return to Ajeck Rouack at Nesingwary's Expedition in Northern Stranglethorn.
english.giverWindow: She prefers to look down upon the weaker tigers from atop her hill.

text.title: 血顶巨魔的耳朵
text.objectives: 给藏宝海湾的科博克带回15只血顶巨魔的耳朵。
text.description: 该死的巨魔！他们杀死了我们派到丛林里去的人！我已经在和他们的冲突中损失太多优秀的护卫了。血债必须血来偿！这让我怎么向大财主里维加兹解释呀？$b$b是该做决定的时候了……想想看，科博克……你可不是被派到这里来整日无所事事的……啊，有啦！你……你就是$n，是不是？你是来帮助我的，是不是？这份工作的奖励可是很丰厚的哦！$b$b嗯嗯，给我带15只血顶巨魔的耳朵来，我就重重地酬谢你，如何？
text.progress: 你成功了吗?这里遍地都是巨魔，这群丑陋的魔鬼。$B$B哦，对了，这倒提醒了我，记得把这件事告诉你的同伴，好吗?我们还需要更多的帮手!
text.completion: 喔，太棒了，实在是太棒了。这一阵子情况至少会好一点点……$B$B<他的声音变轻了，嘟囔着花费和报酬……>$B$B什么?你怎么还在这儿?报酬?噢，对……当然，拿着吧……绝对是只多不少的。
text.completed: Return to Kebok at Booty Bay in Stranglethorn Vale.

english.title: Bloodscalp Ears
english.objectives: Acquire 15 Bloodscalp Ears and return them to Kebok in Booty Bay.
english.description: Damn trolls! They've been killing off our agents in the jungle! I've already lost a good number of my best guards to skirmishes with them. The costs are piling up! How will I explain this to Baron Revilgaz?$b$bDecisive action... Think, Kebok... you weren't assigned to the post you have today for sitting around... I've got it! You... $n, is it? You'll help me, won't you? There's money to be had!$b$bHere's the deal... you bring me the ears of fifteen Bloodscalp Trolls, and I'll compensate you well.
english.progress: You've had success I hope? All over the place, those trolls. Filthy devils. Oh yes, that reminds me! Be sure to tell your friends, yes? We could use much assistance!
english.completion: Oh excellent, excellent. That'll help a little, for the present... What? You're still here? Reward? Oh, right... of course, here, take this... it should be more than enough.
english.completed: Return to Kebok at Booty Bay in Stranglethorn Vale.

text.title: 捕杀猎豹
text.objectives: 猎杀10只猎豹幼崽。
text.description: 如果你也想加入这个由赫米特先生组建的最强狩猎队，就必须先证明自己是一个能干的猎豹高手。放心，一开始不会太难的，千万别轻言放弃。你先去猎杀一些猎豹幼崽热热身吧。当你有了一些狩猎经验之后，自然会遇到更加危险的猎物。$B$B从东边开始吧。等你成为捕杀猎豹的行家之后再回来找我吧。
text.progress: 一名真正的猎豹高手应该在荒野中搜寻猎物。尽力去完成你的目标，$C，然后再回来。
text.completion: 这是个不错的开始，$N!
text.completed: Return to Sir S. J. Erlgadin at Nesingwary's Expedition in Northern Stranglethorn.

english.title: Panther Hunting
english.objectives: Hunt 10 Young Panthers.
english.description: If you want to be a part of the hunt with this crack group under Hemet Jr.'s leadership, you're going to need to prove yourself an able panther hunter.  You should start out easy: just focus on the young panthers for now.  As you improve and gain experience as a hunter, you will undoubtedly find increasingly dangerous quarry.$b$bStart by heading east.  Return to me when you are a master panther hunter.
english.progress: A true panther hunter would be out in the fields, trying to stalk his prey. Show some commitment to your goal, $c, and get back out there.
english.completion: You feel more experienced already.  Perhaps it's time to move on to bigger prey.
english.completed: Return to Sir S. J. Erlgadin at Nesingwary's Expedition in Northern Stranglethorn.

text.title: 追踪猎豹
text.objectives: 猎杀10只黑豹。
text.description: 猎豹的幼崽对你来说不成问题。然而成年的猎豹显然更加强壮迅捷，它们可不比之前的猎豹幼崽那么好杀。$B$B到西边去寻找它们吧。
text.progress: 去猎杀十只黑豹!给我们看看你的战利品!
text.completion: 你做得太完美了，$N!
text.completed: Return to Sir S. J. Erlgadin at Nesingwary's Expedition in Northern Stranglethorn.

english.title: Panther Stalking
english.objectives: Hunt 10 Panthers.
english.description: The youngest panthers fell easily before you.  Panthers that have come of age will naturally be stronger, and quicker, and more difficult to defeat.$b$bLarger panther tracks lead to the west.
english.progress: Bhag'thera can prove to be an elusive beast. How fairs the hunt?
english.completion: You take a moment to silently congratulate yourself on your panther hunting so far.
english.completed: Return to Sir S. J. Erlgadin at Nesingwary's Expedition in Northern Stranglethorn.

text.title: 勇斗猎豹
text.objectives: 猎杀5只深喉猎豹。
text.description: 接下来的部分可就比较困难了。当猎豹生存得够久时，它们就会变得非常狡猾，会将自己隐匿在周边的环境中，很难发现。这些狡诈的猎豹就是“深喉猎豹”，它们会从暗处突然跳出来……张开血盆大口袭击你。$B$B如果你想证明自己的猎豹能力，就拿深喉猎豹来试试看吧。它们在东南方的河对岸游荡。
text.progress: 你还在这里做什么呢，$N?你应该正在丛林里试着猎杀十只深喉猎豹才对。难道你不想成为一名伟大的猎人了吗?
text.completion: 你做得很好，$N!
text.completed: Return to Sir S. J. Erlgadin at Nesingwary's Expedition in Northern Stranglethorn.

english.title: Panther Prowess
english.objectives: Hunt 5 Shadowmaw Panthers.
english.description: Now the hard part.  As panthers grow older, they become more wily, blending in with their environment and becoming difficult to spot.  These cunning panthers are known by the name "shadowmaw", for their tendency to suddenly appear out of the darkness... with a waiting mouth full of teeth.$b$bIf you want to prove yourself as a true panther hunter, shadowmaws are the only way to do so.  They prowl to the southeast, across the river.
english.progress: Bhag'thera can prove to be an elusive beast. How fairs the hunt?
english.completion: The shadowmaw panthers proved no match for your skills as a hunter.  Only one task remains.
english.completed: Return to Sir S. J. Erlgadin at Nesingwary's Expedition in Northern Stranglethorn.

text.title: 制服猎豹
text.objectives: 获得巴尔瑟拉的牙。
text.description: 你几乎已经证明自己是一位优秀的猎豹能手了。但是仍有一只强大的豹子没有被你征服。$B$B它叫巴尔瑟拉。使出你的浑身解数，去试试猎杀这头猛兽吧。$b$b将巴尔瑟拉的牙齿带回来交给埃尔加丁，以此证明你是一位出色的猎豹能手。
text.progress: 巴尔瑟拉是这片丛林里最狡猾的野兽，你捕猎到它了吗?
text.completion: 你杀死了巴尔瑟拉!恭喜你，$N。你果然是一位优秀的$C!
text.completed: Return to Sir S. J. Erlgadin at Nesingwary's Expedition in Northern Stranglethorn.

english.title: Panther Mastery
english.objectives: Obtain the Fang of Bhag'thera.
english.description: You've almost proven yourself to be a master hunter of panthers.  Yet there is one panther which has eluded your grasp.$b$bSongs are sung about a mighty panther by the name of Bhag'thera.  You will see if you can use your skills to kill the great beast.$b$bBringing the Fang of Bhag'thera to Erlgadin should be proof enough that you are a master panther hunter.
english.progress: You're still alive!  Excellent!  How fares the hunt?
english.completion: Off to a good start, $n!
english.completed: Return to Sir S. J. Erlgadin at Nesingwary's Expedition in Northern Stranglethorn.

text.title: 捕杀迅猛龙
text.objectives: 猎杀10只荆棘谷迅猛龙。
text.description: 你觉得你的狩猎技术是最顶尖的？我马上就检验一下，看看你是不是在骗人。到丛林里去杀十只荆棘谷迅猛龙，这样一来我们就知道你是不是所谓的王牌猎人了。$b$b当然，我是绝对不会告诉你在哪里才能找到它们的！追踪野兽本身就是挑战的一部分。$B$B好了，去西边吧。
text.progress: 我从没见过猎人站在营火旁边也能打到猎物的 - 呃，除了我父亲。你是打算杀死荆棘谷迅猛龙还是等那些猎物老死?
text.completion: 干得漂亮，$g哥们:小姐;!
text.completed: Return to Hemet Nesingwary Jr. at Nesingwary's Expedition in Northern Stranglethorn.

english.title: Raptor Hunting
english.objectives: Hunt 10 Stranglethorn Raptors.
english.description: So you think your hunting skills are in tip-top shape?  I can put them to the test in a jiffy.  Head out into that jungle and kill ten Stranglethorn raptors.  We'll see just how much of a big game hunter you are.$b$bAnd no, I won't tell you where you can find them!  Locating the beasts is half the challenge.$b$bOkay, go west.
english.progress: I never met a hunter who got any kills by standing around the campfire - well, except for my father. Were you planning on killing those Stranglethorn Raptors or were you hoping they would die of old age?
english.completion: Stranglethorn raptors were not a problem for a wily $c like you.
english.completed: Return to Hemet Nesingwary Jr. at Nesingwary's Expedition in Northern Stranglethorn.

text.title: 追踪迅猛龙
text.objectives: 猎杀10只鞭尾迅猛龙。
text.description: 现在让我们来看看你能不能应付更大的挑战吧。杀进丛林里去，干掉十只鞭尾迅猛龙。显然，它们比你之前干掉的那些迅猛龙更加强壮。$b$b鞭尾迅猛龙主要在这里的东南方，卡莱废墟附近。
text.progress: 一位真正的猎人脑中总是想着他的猎物。而你呢，我的朋友，你似乎更喜欢在营火旁边谈天说地。好了，快离开这里，你最好赶在我把这些鞭尾迅猛龙全部杀光前猎杀10只回来。
text.completion: 现在你可以在家里的壁炉上挂上一两只恐龙脑袋当战利品啦!做得好，$N!
text.completed: Return to Hemet Nesingwary Jr. at Nesingwary's Expedition in Northern Stranglethorn.

english.title: Raptor Stalking
english.objectives: Hunt 10 Lashtail Raptors.
english.description: It is time to step up the challenge.  Venturing into the jungle and bagging 10 lashtail raptors should be sufficient.  They will certainly be stronger than the raptors you have already disposed of.$b$bThe lashtail raptors mainly stay southeast of here, near the Kal'ai Ruins.
english.progress: A true hunter sets his focus on his prey. You, my friend, seem more concerned with chit-chatting around the campfire. Now get out there and kill 10 Lashtails before I go and rid the entire bloody jungle of them in one hunt.
english.completion: Hemet Nesingwary Jr. doubted you, but his doubts were unfounded.  You are absolutely destroying these raptors.
english.completed: Return to Hemet Nesingwary Jr. at Nesingwary's Expedition in Northern Stranglethorn.

text.title: 勇斗迅猛龙
text.objectives: 猎杀10只丛林捕猎者。
text.description: 这里的南边，跨过河水的地方，栖息着一种非常狡猾的迅猛龙，当地人叫它“丛林捕猎者”。它们远比你之前捕猎的目标更难追踪和猎杀。$B$B去干掉这些丛林捕猎者，你就可以成为营地里的话题人物了……
text.progress: 喂!你还在这儿闲晃什么，$N?真正的王牌猎人绝对不会把他的猎物彻底抛到脑后去，而且那些丛林潜猎者可不会自己跳进这堆营火去自杀的，笨$g小子:丫头;!
text.completion: 呵呵!!这下我们这儿有个真正的恐龙杀手啦!干得漂亮，$g小伙子:小姑娘;!
text.completed: Return to Hemet Nesingwary Jr. at Nesingwary's Expedition in Northern Stranglethorn.

english.title: Raptor Prowess
english.objectives: Hunt 10 Jungle Stalkers.
english.description: A particularly cagey brand of raptor, known by locals as the "Jungle Stalker", prowls the forests to the south, across the river.  They are far more difficult to track down and kill than the other breeds you've been trying your luck at.$b$bKilling these Jungle Stalkers will undoubtedly make for a good tale around the fire.
english.progress: Bah! What are you doing standing around, $n! A true big game hunter never gives up once his prey is in his sights. Those Jungle Stalkers aren't going to come running up to this campfire and throw themselves in it. Silly bloke.
english.completion: You are no longer just a raptor hunter.  You are an honest-to-goodness raptor SLAYER. Though one fabled raptor still eludes you...
english.completed: Return to Hemet Nesingwary Jr. at Nesingwary's Expedition in Northern Stranglethorn.

text.title: 制服迅猛龙
text.objectives: 猎杀泰希斯。
text.description: 在返回奈辛瓦里远征队营地之前，你必须完成一项极其艰巨的任务：猎杀一头从来都没人抓住过的迅猛龙，它叫泰希斯，在北荆棘谷的东南角作威作福。$B$B把泰希斯的爪子交给那个矮人，应该足以证明你不是普通的$r了。
text.progress: 猎杀泰希斯的事进行得怎么样了?你找到它的老窝了吗?
text.completion: $G大师:女主人;$N，恐龙杀手!$B$B听起来很不错吧?
text.completed: Return to Hemet Nesingwary Jr. at Nesingwary's Expedition in Northern Stranglethorn.
text.giverWindow: 泰希斯只靠吃蓝莓和奈辛瓦里远征队的猎人就可以过活。

english.title: Raptor Mastery
english.objectives: Hunt Tethis.
english.description: Before returning to Nesingwary's Expedition, you will have to complete the impossible: hunt the raptor that no other hunter has been able to capture.  That beast goes by the name of Tethis, and he's been known to terrorize the southeastern corner of Northern Stranglethorn.$b$bBringing Tethis' talon back to that dwarf hunter should be proof that you are no ordinary $r.
english.progress: Ah, so you're hunting Tethis?  Tracked her all the way back to camp, did you?
english.completion: Master $n, the raptor slayer! Has a nice ring to it, eh?
english.completed: Return to Hemet Nesingwary Jr. at Nesingwary's Expedition in Northern Stranglethorn.
english.giverWindow: Tethis survives solely on a diet of blueberries and Nesingwary hunters.

text.title: 列兵索尔森的补给物资
text.objectives: 将杂七杂八的地精补给物资带给列兵索尔森。
text.description: 嗯。没错，我这里确实有些适合你做的事。目前部署在荆棘谷北部的多伦上尉和他的部下需要我们的定期补给。$b$b不过由于巨魔的伏击，他们一直没能得到补给，所以我得找人来帮我处理这件事。多伦的营地就在从暮色森林进入荆棘谷的道路的西北方，你只要把补给品交给列兵索尔森就行了，相信他会处理好的。$b$b你要记住，如果你失败了的话，就得赔偿我们的损失。$b$b当然，你也可能会死在路上……
text.progress: 是的?有什么事吗?哦，哥布尔送来的补给品。他们居然会让一个$r送过来，还真是奇怪，一般都是他们自己送来的。不管了……你没碰过里面的东西吧?很好，很好……我可不希望我们的地雷突然爆炸，绝对不想。
text.completion: 这些地雷可以用来帮助我们抵抗库森和他的部下的进攻。谢谢你将它们送过来，要是你还想找些别的工作的话，我想我可以找些事让你做。对了，你应该不需要和那群哥布尔打交道吧，嗯?
text.completed: Report to Private Thorsen in Stranglethorn Vale.

english.title: Supplies to Private Thorsen
english.objectives: Deliver the Miscellaneous Goblin Supplies to Private Thorsen.
english.description: Hmm. Yes, I do have something you could do, actually. Lieutenant Doren and his followers up in the north need their regular supplies from us.$b$bThey haven't been delivered, and with the trolls attacking, I'll need someone to do it. Doren's camp lies northwest of the road at the entrance to Stranglethorn from Duskwood. Give the supplies to Private Thorsen, if he's not in the camp, then he'll be patrolling south of it. He'll take care of them.$b$bMind you, if you fail, you'll owe me restitution.
english.progress: Yes? What do you want? Oh, supplies from the goblins. Strange seeing a $r delivering them, usually they send their own. No matter... you didn't touch them did you? Good good... we wouldn't want anything to happen to our mines, oh no.
english.completion: These land mines will help us defend ourselves from that animal Kurzen and his men. Thank you for bringing them. If you need further work, I can probably find something for you to do. And you won't have to deal with those goblins, hm?
english.completed: Report to Private Thorsen in Stranglethorn Vale.

text.title: 水坝危机
text.objectives: 回去见主工程师辛德维尔七世，把你找到的线索交给他。
text.description: 你取了些怪味粉末的样品。
text.progress: 你找到什么线索了吗，$N?
text.completion: 这绝对是一个令人担忧的发现!

english.title: A Dark Threat Looms
english.objectives: Return to Chief Engineer Hinderweir and show him the clue that you discovered.
english.description: You take a sample of the strange smelling powder.
english.progress: Did you happen to discover any clues, $n?
english.completion: This is an alarming discovery, to say the least!

text.title: 书呆子赫罗德
text.objectives: 找到书呆子赫罗德的档案。
text.description: 既然连库尔森都知道了这个秘密，那么他们一定也在我们这边安插了一个卧底。我们必须得搞明白这些机密内容是怎么泄露出去的！$B$B索尔森在那边的线人是书呆子赫罗德，他是库尔森的后勤官，了解库尔森的营地里的一切事务。如果你能搞到他的笔记或者档案什么的话，或许我们能分析出索尔森到底是怎么被发现的。$B$B当初，我们还跟库尔森一起共事的时候，书呆子的办公室是在营地里唯一一座两层房屋的二楼，他的档案应该还在那里。
text.completion: 这些是书呆子赫洛德的笔记和记录。$B$B其中有营地的补给品列表、库尔森上校的原料采购清单和一些其它的信件。
text.completed: Find Bookie Herod's Records in Stranglethorn Vale.

english.title: Bookie Herod
english.objectives: Find Bookie Herod's Records.
english.description: If Kurzen knows Thorsen's secret, then we have a spy in our midst.  We must determine how the secret was leaked!$B$BThorsen's contact within Kurzen's camp was Bookie Herod.  Herod is Kurzen's logistics officer and knows everything about the running of Kurzen's Compound.  If you can get Herod's notes or records, maybe we can find out how Thorsen was discovered.$B$BWhen we were still with Kurzen, Bookie's office was on the top floor of the camp's only two-story house.  His records are probably still there.
english.completion: These are Bookie Herod's notes and records.$B$BAmong them are: a list of supplies within the camp, material requests from Colonel Kurzen, and various letters and correspondences.
english.completed: Find Bookie Herod's Records in Stranglethorn Vale.

text.title: 调查营地
text.objectives: 找到猎人营地并向藏宝海湾的克拉兹克报告这个营地的位置。
text.description: 我收到一条报告说，有一群猎人在风险投资公司营地所在的纳菲瑞提湖的上游建立了一片营地。通常我根本不会在意这件事，但当我听说赫米特·奈辛瓦里二世也是那群猎人中的一员时，我改变了想法。那家伙可是个名声显赫的人物，如果你了解我的意思的话，就会不像现在这样无动于衷了。$b$b你为什么不去那片营地里侦察一下呢，$n？去看看他们到底想干点什么吧。
text.progress: 如何?你找到那个营地了吗?
text.completion: 嗯，看来我这次的情报是正确的，一如往常。真有趣。嗯，我并不认为他们会对我们的运作构成任何干扰的威胁，但或许他们需要我们所生产的出色产品。嗯……
text.completed: Return to Krazek at Booty Bay in Stranglethorn Vale.

english.title: Investigate the Camp
english.objectives: Find the hunters' camp and report its location to Krazek in Booty Bay.
english.description: I've gotten reports of a group of hunters that have set up camp upriver of the Venture Company mining camp on Lake Nazferiti.  Now, normally I wouldn't care, but improbably, I heard that Hemet Nesingwary Jr. was one of the hunters there.  He's certainly well-connected, if you catch my meaning, and you never can be too safe.$b$bWhy don't you go check out the camp, $n, see what they're about?
english.progress: Well?  Did you have any luck in locating the camp?
english.completion: Hmmm, so my information was correct, as usual.  Interesting.  Well, I don't suppose they pose any sort of threat of interference with our operation, but perhaps they have a need for some of our excellent manufactured products.  Hmmm...
english.completed: Return to Krazek at Booty Bay in Stranglethorn Vale.

text.title: 库尔森上校
text.objectives: 杀掉6名库尔森精英和4名库尔森副首领，并将库尔森的徽记交给反抗军营地里的多伦上尉。
text.description: 你一次又一次地证明了自己的能力，而你的足智多谋略似乎甚至能与库尔森媲美。如果……如果你愿意彻底投身到与库尔森斗争的事业中去的话……也许你将成为我们反抗军的救星！$B$B他就躲在那个名叫“储藏室”的洞穴深处发号施令。你必须进入那个洞穴，干掉他身边的保镖，最终把库尔森和他的副官们都给除掉。$B$B出发吧，$n。我们的生命与希望，如今都已经全部掌握在你的手中了。
text.progress: 你能将库尔森和他的保镖们都杀死么，$N?
text.completion: 我几乎有点不敢相信了，但你给我们带回了确实的证据……库尔森和他的副手们都已经被消灭了!你拯救了我们!$B$B这片丛林中有着无数隐藏着的威胁，但只有库尔森才是真正集残酷、邪恶和智慧于一身的敌人。现在他死了，我们都可以松一口气了。
text.completed: Return to Lieutenant Doren at Rebel Camp in Stranglethorn Vale.

english.title: Colonel Kurzen
english.objectives: Kill 6 Kurzen Elite, 4 Kurzen Subchiefs, and bring Kurzen's Head to Lieutenant Doren at the Rebel Camp.
english.description: You have proven yourself time and again, and your resourcefulness seems to rival even that of Kurzen himself.  You may be the salvation of our band of rebels...if you can pit yourself against Kurzen and prevail!$B$BHe commands his men from deep within the Stockpile.  You must enter that cave, brave through his defenders, and face Kurzen and his leaders.$B$BFarewell, $n.  My hope, and the fate of my men, go with you.
english.progress: Dare I hope that Kurzen and his defenders are dead, $n?
english.completion: I dared not believe the reports, but you bring us proof that...Kurzen and his leaders are defeated.  You have saved us! These jungles are filled with menaces of all types, but none had the cruel intellect of Kurzen.  We may all breathe easier now that he is gone.
english.completed: Return to Lieutenant Doren at Rebel Camp in Stranglethorn Vale.

text.title: 以彼之道还施彼身
text.objectives: 杀死15名库尔森丛林战士，然后向反抗军营地的尤瓦中士复命。
text.description: 我们正在与库尔森进行一场艰难的战斗。他是个非常优秀的战术大师，而且他的手下士兵的数量是我们的十倍！如果我们想要胜利的话，就必须使用他擅长的战术来对付他。$B$B到他在东边设立的营地里去，杀掉他的士兵，越多越好，然后在增援赶来之前撤退。
text.progress: 我希望你能在这次行动中获得成功，$N。要是没有你的帮助，我们真的没可能跟他抗衡这么久。
text.completion: 干得好!丛林战士的减员会帮我们减轻一些负担。$B$B不过，现在你也了解到那些与我们为敌的军队有多可怕了吧?你还想与我们并肩战斗到底吗?
text.completed: Return to Sergeant Yohwa at Rebel Camp in Stranglethorn Vale.

english.title: The Second Rebellion
english.objectives: Kill 15 Kurzen Jungle Fighters.$B$BReturn to Sergeant Yohwa at the Rebel Camp.
english.description: We're fighting a losing battle with Colonel Kurzen.  Not only is he a brilliant tactician, he outnumbers us at least 10 to 1!  To survive, we need to use his own, covert tactics against him.$B$BEnter his camp to the east and kill his men.  Lots of them.  And get out before reinforcements can close on you.
english.progress: I hope you've been successful in your hunting, $n. We won't last long against him without your help.
english.completion: Well done.  The loss of those Jungle Fighters will relieve some of the pressure on our camp.$B$BBut now that you've had a taste of the forces we're up against, do you still want to throw your lot in with us??
english.completed: Return to Sergeant Yohwa at Rebel Camp in Stranglethorn Vale.

text.title: 库尔森的药物
text.objectives: 给反抗军营地里的尤瓦中士带回7份密林药剂和1份毒草汁液。
text.description: 要想和库尔森搏上一搏，我们就必须削弱他们的医疗队伍。他在那里聚集了大批医疗人员，他们能用密林药剂治疗自己的部队，并用毒草汁液对我们的人下毒。$B$B我们要用这些药物来治疗我们自己的战士，同时我们也需要一份毒液的样本来研制解药。到库尔森的营地去把这两样东西找来吧，药品应该就在那些医疗人员和战士的身上，而毒草汁液大概是保存在营地中的一些物资箱里的。
text.progress: 我等着你取回那些药物与毒液，$N。
text.completion: 干得好，$N。这些药物会极大地提高我们在战场上的生存能力与战斗能力，而这些毒液将会帮助我们尽快制出解药。
text.completed: Return to Sergeant Yohwa at Rebel Camp in Stranglethorn Vale.

english.title: Bad Medicine
english.objectives: Bring 7 Jungle Remedies and 1 Venom Fern Extract to Sergeant Yohwa at the Rebel Camp.
english.description: To have a chance against Kurzen, we need his healing support neutralized.  He has gathered a large number of medicine men who heal his forces with jungle remedies and poison our fighters with venom fern extracts.$B$BWe need those remedies and extracts for our own.  Search the Kurzen Compound - his medicine men and jungle fighters will have the remedies, and the extracts are probably stowed in some of the camp's supply boxes.
english.progress: I'm waiting on those remedies and that extract, $n.
english.completion: Well done, $n.  These remedies will keep more of us alive and in fighting shape.  And the extracts will help us create our own remedies.
english.completed: Return to Sergeant Yohwa at Rebel Camp in Stranglethorn Vale.

text.title: 巨魔巫术
text.objectives: 给叛军营地的尼麦兹修士带回4只劈颅巨魔的神像。
text.description: 在我研究这些巨魔传说的时候，我希望你能帮我收集一些巨魔们施展邪恶魔法时必备的法器。到南边的那个劈颅巨魔部族的地盘上去，从他们的巫医和秘法师那里弄一些劈颅巨魔的神像回来吧。
text.progress: 你拿到神像了吗?那些东西里或许藏着库尔森堕落的秘密……我必须得搞清楚!
text.completion: 谢谢你。我现在就开始研究这些神像，看看这里面是否隐藏着库尔森堕落的秘密。
text.completed: Return to Brother Nimetz at Rebel Camp in Stranglethorn Vale.

english.title: Troll Witchery
english.objectives: Bring 4 Skullsplitter Fetishes to Brother Nimetz at the Rebel Camp.
english.description: While I study those legends you acquired, gather for me implements of evil troll magic.  Enter the territory of the Skullsplitter trolls, a second tribe to the distant south, and acquire Skullsplitter Fetishes from their Witchdoctors and Mystics.
english.progress: Do you have those fetishes, $n?  They might hold the secret to Kurzen's degradation...I must know!
english.completion: Thank you.  I will study these fetishes and see if they hold the secret of Kurzen's fall into evil.
english.completed: Return to Brother Nimetz at Rebel Camp in Stranglethorn Vale.

text.title: Mai'Zoth
text.objectives: 将心灵之眼交给反抗军营地里的尼麦兹修士。
text.description: 库尔森的确是该死，不过……到底是谁将他带上了这条邪恶的道路呢？通过研究，我已经找到了真相：是一个名叫麦佐斯的食人魔法师干的。他住在荆棘谷东部的食人魔山中，据说他擅长心灵控制魔法，我也确信正是他使得库尔森上校堕落的。$B$B如果麦佐斯继续活在这世上，他的邪恶法术就有可能影响到更多人，或许又会出现另一个库尔森上校。$B$B杀死他，把他的心灵之眼带回来，这正是他用来诱惑他人堕落的物品。
text.progress: 祝你成功，$N。麦佐斯非常邪恶，也非常强大。
text.completion: 哈哈!你做到了!你真厉害呀，$N，愿你的力量永在!$B$B我会好好研究这只心灵之眼，看看它是否能为光明所用。如果不能的话……那我就必须毁了它。
text.completed: Return to Brother Nimetz at Rebel Camp in Stranglethorn Vale.

english.title: Mai'Zoth
english.objectives: Bring the Mind's Eye to Brother Nimetz at the Rebel Camp.
english.description: Kurzen may be dead, but...that which drove him to evil still lives!  Through my studies I have discovered this: An Ogre Mage - Mai'Zoth - dwells in an Ogre Mound within the eastern mountains of Stranglethorn.  He is rumored to employ mind-controlling magic, and I am positive that he corrupted Kurzen.$B$BIf Mai'Zoth is allowed to live, then his evil may influence others, and may even cause another Kurzen to surface.$B$BKill him, and bring me his Mind's Eye, the artifact he uses to corrupt others.
english.progress: I give you my blessing.  Mai'Zoth's strength is matched only by his evil.
english.completion: Aha!  You've done it!  You are a great force for good, $n, and may your strength never fade! I will study this Mind's Eye and determine if it may be used for good.  If not...then it must be destroyed.
english.completed: Return to Brother Nimetz at Rebel Camp in Stranglethorn Vale.

text.title: 库尔森的秘密
text.objectives: 找到4块石板并将上面的内容带回去交给尼麦兹修士。
text.description: 库尔森上校曾是个伟大而高贵的人，我必须得找到让他堕落至此的原因！他一定是被巨魔的魔法给控制了。要想搞清楚这一点的话，我们就得先研究一下巨魔的传说故事。$B$B据说荆棘谷中的巨魔遗迹中隐藏着四块石板，我必须得看看这些石板上到底记述了些什么东西！你去给我拓一份这些石板上的文字来，把拓片都交给我。$B$B第一块石板在巴拉尔废墟里，第二块石板在暗礁海的海底，第三块和第四块应该都在祖昆达废墟里。
text.progress: $N!你找到这些巨魔的传说了吗?我必须得了解他们的秘密!
text.completion: 谢谢你，$N。我会仔细研究这些巨魔传说，找出巨魔到底是用什么样的邪恶魔法控制了库尔森上校!
text.completed: Return to Brother Nimetz at the Rebel Camp in Stranglethorn Vale.

english.title: Kurzen's Mystery
english.objectives: Find the 4 tablets and bring their legends back to Brother Nimetz.
english.description: Colonel Kurzen was once a great, noble man - I must find what caused his fall into depravity!  He may be under the sway of troll magic.  To confirm this, I must study some of their legends.$B$BThere are 4 tablets hidden within the troll ruins of Stranglethorn.  I must see what is written on these tablets!  Transcribe their markings and bring the transcriptions back to me.$B$BThe first tablet is in the Bal'lal Ruins, the second is in the Vile Reef, and the third and fourth are in the Ruins of Zul'Kunda.
english.progress: $n!  Do you have the troll legends?  I must know their secrets!
english.completion: Thank you, $n.  I will study these legends to see if there is some link between the trolls and the evil that has possessed Colonel Kurzen.
english.completed: Return to Brother Nimetz at the Rebel Camp in Stranglethorn Vale.

text.title: 王牌猎人
text.objectives: 猎杀白色的虎王邦加拉什，获得它的头颅。
text.description: $n，你现在已经成为了一位够格进入我们狩猎队的猎手了。无论是洛丹伦的战场还是危机四伏的丛林，我在哪里都没有见过有谁能像你这样拥有如此强大的战斗能力。$b$b你成功地杀死了凶残的辛达尔，狡猾的巴尔瑟拉和奸诈的泰希斯。但对于这片丛林中的猎人们来说，虎王邦加拉什的头才代表着至高无上的荣耀。这只白虎正是我来这里的原因……但是，它仍在南边的巢穴中嘲笑着我。如果你能杀死虎王邦加拉什，那么你无疑是这里最优秀的猎人。
text.progress: 我等着你回来，$g小伙子:姑娘;。虎王邦加拉西有好几次都让我狼狈地爬回营地，它的确是块难啃的骨头。
text.completion: 做得好啊!真是太出色了!恭喜你，$N，你终于做到了其它人从来都没能做到的事情。$B$B我很荣幸地欢迎你成为我们这支伟大的狩猎队的一员。再没有人会怀疑你优秀的狩猎和追踪技巧了!$B$B恭喜你!
text.completed: Return to Hemet Nesingwary Jr. at Nesingwary's Expedition in Northern Stranglethorn.
text.giverWindow: 它是这片丛林中最致命的猎手……除了你。

english.title: Big Game Hunter
english.objectives: Hunt for the head of King Bangalash, the great white tiger.
english.description: $n, you are a hunter worthy of our company.  From the battlefields of Lordaeron to the deepest jungle, I have rarely witnessed such prowess with weaponry as you have demonstrated.$b$bYou have killed the ferocious Sin'Dall, the elusive Bhag'thera, and the treacherous Tethis.  But the true prize is the head of King Bangalash.  That white tiger is the reason I am here... yet still, he taunts me from his roost to the south.  Kill King Bangalash and your hunting prowess is proven to be second to none.
english.progress: I see you're back, old bloke.  King Bangalash has caused me to come crawling back to camp many times.  Hang in there.
