english.completion: Very well, here is another power source.  I highly recommend you using it properly this time, unless you are eager to spend ten more water pouches for another water source.
english.completed: Return to Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle at Gadgetzan in Tanaris.

text.title: 十字路口征兵
text.objectives: 从卡加尔的前沿哨所往西走。$B$B在丁字路口往左拐，然后朝南走。$B$B在十字路口的道路交汇处找到瑟格拉·黑棘。
text.description: 把我签过字的募兵信拿到十字路口去。$B$B那里由瑟格拉·黑棘掌管，她是个恶心的萨满祭司，总喜欢在吩咐你去做正事之前跟你胡说一通，把你搞得头晕脑胀。萨尔觉得她是个人才，但我可不这么看。$B$B小子，接下来的事情还是你自己去解决吧……
text.progress: 哎呀，看看谁来了?卡加尔又帮我召募了个新兵吗?
text.completion: 好吧，$N。你想证明你对部落的价值?这里有一大堆事情可以让你做，仔细听好然后按照我说的去做。$B$B$g我知道你在想什么，别以为我会容忍你的傲慢。就连萨尔大人都说过，部落的女性和你们男性的地位是平等的。你若是再敢对我有一丁点的不敬，我就让你吃不完兜着走。:很高兴见到你，如果萨尔知道有越来越多像你我一样出色的女性正在为建设贫瘠之地出力，他一定会很高兴的。;$B$B

english.title: Crossroads Conscription
english.objectives: Deliver your signed recruitment letter to Sergra Darkthorn at the Crossroads. If you haven't already, you can hitch a ride there with the next caravan by talking to Halga Bloodeye at Far Watch Outpost.
english.description: <Kargal withdraws a battered recruitment letter from his vest and makes his mark on it. He hands it to you solemnly.>$B$BWell pup, you've proven yourself to be a formidable asset. Consider yourself drafted. We need your like at the Crossroads, assuming you can make it there alive. Just follow the road West of here, then South when you hit the junction. If you really want to help your new Horde, talk to Halga and hitch a ride with our next caravan. Deliver this letter to Sergra Darkthorn when you arrive.
english.progress: Well well well, what do we have here? Has Kargal deemed me worthy of another recruit?
english.completion: Alright, $n. You want to earn your keep with the Horde? Well there's plenty to do here, so listen close and do what you're told. I see that look in your eyes, do not think I will tolerate any insolence. Thrall himself has declared the Hordes females to be on equal footing with you men. Disrespect me in the slightest, and you will know true pain.

text.title: 加恩的报复
text.objectives: 加恩·石塔让你杀死15个巴尔丹挖掘者和5个巴尔丹工头。$b$b把卡兹戈姆的日记交给加恩·石塔。
text.description: 我一直在这里孤独地徘徊着。$b$b巴尔莫丹的矮人对我们的领土从来都没有半点尊重。烈性的炸药在地面上炸出了一个又一个深深的钻孔，嘈杂的机器切开了山丘和平原，曾经属于我们部族的美好家园现在成了那些破坏成性的矮人们的领地。$b$b我们曾希望通过外交途径与他们和解，但是一切努力最终都以失败告终。现在是做出决断的时候了。$b$b用武力将这些矮人从巴尔莫丹的挖掘场赶走，把他们的头儿勘察员卡兹戈姆的日记带来交给我。
text.progress: 巴尔莫丹矮人的到来让很多无辜的牛头人失去了生命，或者被迫离开了他们世代生活的家园。我们必须夺回自己的领地!
text.completion: 卡兹戈姆罪有应得，我对这个白痴的下场不会有丝毫的同情。他根本不属于这片土地。$B$B希望他的死能警告所有那些对我们的生活构成威胁的人。$B$B现在，让我来研究一下这个矮人的日记……
text.completed: Return to Gann Stonespire at the Southern Gold Road in the Barrens.

english.title: Gann's Reclamation
english.objectives: Gann Stonespire wants you to kill 15 Bael'dun Excavators and 5 Bael'dun Foremen.$b$bBring Khazgorm's Journal to Gann Stonespire.
english.description: In solitude I wander these roads.$b$bThe dwarves of Bael Modan show no respect for my land. Horrendous blasts drive holes deep into the ground as noisy machines rip apart the hills. Lands which once served as home and provider to my tribe are now riddled with destructive dwarves.$b$bAttempts at reaching a diplomatic resolution have failed. Now is the time for decisive action.$b$bDrive the dwarves from the Bael Modan excavation by force and bring to me the journal of their leader, Prospector Khazgorm.
english.progress: Many innocent tauren lost their lives or were forced off their ancestral birthplace when the dwarves of Bael Modan arrived. My land must be reclaimed!
english.completion: Khazgorm met the fate he earned. I feel no remorse for the fool. He was an infidel on these lands. May his death serve as a warning to all those who threaten to disrupt our way of life. Now let me take a moment to study the dwarf's journal....
english.completed: Return to Gann Stonespire at the Southern Gold Road in the Barrens.

text.title: 平原陆行鸟的威胁
text.objectives: 收集7个陆行鸟的喙。
text.description: 你对平原陆行鸟了解吗？没用的动物。不能飞，满地乱跑，脑子跟我的指头一样大，还经常撞上我们的货车。我已经被它们的硬脑壳撞坏好几根车轴了……有时候我都觉得是野猪人故意把它们派来挡我们的道，然后发动袭击。$B$B让我以你为荣吧，$c。清理道路，杀掉那些讨厌的平原陆行鸟，把它们的鸟喙给我带回来。
text.progress: 你收集到陆行鸟的喙了吗?你让它们血染贫瘠之地了吗?
text.completion: 干得很好，$N。没了这些可恶的陆行鸟，我们的食物补给线的压力就可以减轻不少了。希望你从这次猎杀行动中学到了足够的技巧，因为你的下一个目标可远比陆行鸟强大多了……
text.completed: Deliver the Beaks to Halga Bloodeye at Far Watch Post in North Barrens.

english.title: Plainstrider Menace
english.objectives: Collect 7 Plainstrider Beaks.
english.description: Are you familiar with plainstriders? Useless animals. Can't fly. Gamey. Brain the size of my knuckle. Too dim to get out of the way of a moving cart. I've broken more axles thanks to their thick skulls... Sometimes I think the quilboar intentionally frighten flocks of them into the path of our caravans just prior to an ambush.$B$BMake me proud, $c. Cut a swath through those filthy birds to keep the roads free, and bring me their beaks as proof.
english.progress: Have you collected the plainstrider beaks?
english.completion: Very good, $n. That's one less thing to worry about on the road.
english.completed: Deliver the Beaks to Halga Bloodeye at Far Watch Post in North Barrens.

text.title: 斑马的威胁
text.objectives: 杀死快步斑马并收集4只斑马蹄。
text.description: 如果你想为挚爱的部落效力，你需要去证明你的力量，孩子。猎杀斑马是个好方法。它们也许不是贫瘠之地最强大的野兽，但也能把你踢个口鼻窜血。$B$B去猎杀北边和南边的斑马，并且收集它们的蹄子。完成这个任务之后，也许你就可以去见识见识真正的猛兽了。
text.progress: 你杀掉多少角斑马了?
text.completion: 干得不错，$N。斑马的蹄子是非常危险的武器，只需一下就可以把一个健壮的牛头人给踢成重伤!$B$B你的能力似乎也很强，准备好接受真正的挑战了吗?
text.completed: Take the Hooves to Sergra Darkthorn at the Crossroads in North Barrens.

english.title: The Zhevra
english.objectives: Slay Zhevra Runners to collect 4 Zhevra Hooves.
english.description: If you wish to serve my beloved horde, you'll have to prove your strength to me, pup. You can cut your teeth by hunting zhevra. They may not be the strongest of beasts in the Barrens, but stay clear of their kick or you'll regret it.$B$BHunt the zhevra to the north and south, and collect their hooves.  Bring them to me and perhaps we'll next send you against something tougher.
english.progress: How many zhevra have you slain?
english.completion: Not bad, $n. Those zhevra hold a lot of strength in their legs. I've seen them knock even a tauren on its haunches! It looks like you have some strength in you too.
english.completed: Take the Hooves to Sergra Darkthorn at the Crossroads in North Barrens.

text.title: 加恩的报复
text.objectives: 加恩·石塔要你将6瓶硝化甘油、6份木浆和6份硝酸钠交给他。
text.description: 很显然，矮人们依靠炸药和那些吵闹的机械来进行挖掘，而且不久后他们肯定会再派一个新的工头来接手这里。$b$b我要让这些矮人自食其果。按照这日记上面写着的配方，只要把硝化甘油、木浆和硝酸钠混合起来，就能制造出一种强力的炸药。据我们所知，城堡中的火枪手、战士和军官都拥有这些物资。$b$b为我收集这些物资，我要制造出一种让矮人们永远都不会忘记的炸药！
text.progress: 你回来了，$N。$B$B卡兹戈姆的死也许会暂缓他们对这片土地的挖掘进程，但依然无法完全制止他们。$B$B为了保护挖掘场的安全，矮人军队也在不断进驻巴尔莫丹城堡，这已经对我们构成了严重的威胁。$B$B如果你找到了我需要的原料，我就能制造出威力强大的炸药来，让那些草率的矮人重新考虑一下他们在贫瘠之地的行动。
text.completion: 你做得很好，$C。$B$B毫无疑问地，我们很快就能给那些矮人一个恰当的惊喜了。
text.completed: Return to Gann Stonespire at the Southern Gold Road in the Barrens.

english.title: Revenge of Gann
english.objectives: Gann Stonespire wants you to bring him 6 vials of Nitroglycerin, 6 bundles of Wood Pulp, and 6 samples of Sodium Nitrate.
english.description: It is clear the prospector depended on explosives and those noisy vehicles to rip the ground apart. We can expect a new foreman to take over soon.$b$bI want to give the dwarves a taste of their own medicine. According to these plans if we combine nitroglycerin with wood pulp and sodium nitrate we can create an explosive charge. The rifleman, soldiers and officers in the Keep are known to have the supplies.$b$bCollect these items and bring them to me. I will fashion a charge that the dwarves won't forget!
english.progress: I see you are back, $n.$B$BWhile Khazgorm's death might delay the digging in my ancestral lands some, it will by no means bring a total end to the destruction.$B$BThe Keep at Bael Modan is an increasing military threat. Built to defend the dig site, it is now poised for offensive force as well.$B$BIf you have the ingredients I requested, I can fashion a charge that will make the hasty dwarves reconsider their actions here in the Barrens.
english.completion: I see you are quite industrious, $C.$B$BNo doubt we shall soon have a fitting surprise for those dwarves.
english.completed: Return to Gann Stonespire at the Southern Gold Road in the Barrens.

text.title: 迅猛龙的狡诈
text.objectives: 和托尔甘谈一谈。
text.description: 这……这力量……是托尔甘要显示给我的萨满祭司的力量吗？我不得不承认，这很有趣。告诉托尔甘他让我十分信服……至少是现在。我会对他要说的一切都洗耳恭听。
text.completion: 当那宝珠上的魔法退去之后，我会和戈莫尔谈谈的。感谢你帮助戈莫尔返回了这片充满生机的土地，我确信他也会非常感谢你的。

english.title: Guile of the Raptor
english.objectives: Speak with Tor'gan at Hammerfall in Arathi Highlands.
english.description: This... this power.... Is this the power of the shamans that Tor'gan tried to show me? I must say, it is interesting. Tell Tor'gan that he has convinced me... for the time being. I will listen to what he has to say.
english.completion: When the enchantment wears off, I will speak with Gor'mul. My thanks to you for your help in returning Gor'mul to the land of the living. I have no doubt he thanks you greatly as well.

text.title: 菌类孢子
text.objectives: 在遗忘之池收集5个菌类孢子。
text.description: 贫瘠之地的绿洲里隐藏着一个谜。生命的能量从绿洲之水中涌出，给那些汲取水分的动植物带来了勃勃生机。$B$B与此同时，这种能量也在慢慢地改变这些动植物。$B$B在西北的遗忘之池附近生长着一种蘑菇，我们这些洛丹伦的药剂师都认为这种蘑菇的孢子中包含有一些特殊的物质，它对我们非常有用。$B$B帮我带一些孢子回来，我们会非常感谢你的。
text.progress: $N，你找到这些孢子了吗?我必须制造一种药剂送给雷霆崖的同事，而这种药剂正需要这种孢子来配制……
text.completion: 啊，你找到的东西很不错。$B$B我们被遗忘者历来都是信守合约的。这是你的报酬，$N。
text.completed: Take the Spores to Apothecary Helbrim at the Crossroads in Northern Barrens.

english.title: Fungal Spores
english.objectives: Collect 5 Fungal Spores from mushrooms at the Forgotten Pools.
english.description: The oases of the Barrens hide a mystery. Life energy flows from their waters, invigorating the plants and beasts that drink it.$B$BInvigorating, and altering.$B$BThere is a mushroom that grows near the Forgotten Pools to the northwest. Its spores hold properties that we, the apothecaries of Lordaeron, find useful.$B$BBring me these spores and you will earn our gratitude.
english.progress: Do you have the spores, $n? My associates and I are eager to study this phenomenon...
english.completion: Ah, yes. These are good specimens. Potent. I am Forsaken, and we honor our contracts. Here is your reward, $n.
english.completed: Take the Spores to Apothecary Helbrim at the Crossroads in Northern Barrens.

text.title: 加恩的报复
text.objectives: 摧毁巴尔莫丹的飞行器，然后向加恩·石塔回复。
text.description: 按照卡兹戈姆的日记上所述的方法制造出来的炸药应该不会有问题。$B$B那么，我们开始吧。$B$B首先我有一项特殊的任务要交给你完成。拿上这只爆破筒，去炸掉巴尔莫丹的飞行器。$B$B这个飞行器不仅是巴尔莫丹军事设施的关键部分，也是一架可怕的杀戮机器。更重要的是，它是权力的象征，而它对我们的部族来说则代表着一段耻辱的回忆。$B$B我会为你的成功感到自豪，你也将得到丰厚的奖励。
text.progress: 矮人的飞行器被摧毁之后，我感到了一种极其甜美的复仇的快感。
text.completion: $N，你干得很好!雷霆崖的人们会视你为牛头人圣地的防卫者和部族的勇士。
text.completed: Return to Gann Stonespire at the Southern Gold Road in the Barrens.

english.title: Revenge of Gann
english.objectives: Destroy the flying machine at Bael Modan and return to Gann Stonespire.
english.description: Following Khazgorm's plans it should be no problem to fashion an explosive charge$b$bAh, there we go.$b$bNow, $n, I am going to entrust you with a special task. Take this explosive stick and use it to blow up the flying machine at Bael Modan.$b$bNot only is the flying machine a key part of the site's infrastructure it also serves as a weapon of war. More importantly it is an icon of power and an insult to the memory of my tribe.$b$bMake me proud by completing this heroic task and you shall be rewarded.
english.progress: Once the dwarven flying machine has been destroyed I will feel the sweet satisfaction of revenge.
english.completion: You have done well, $n! May you be revered in Thunder Bluff as a defender of sacred tauren lands and a champion of the lost tribe.
english.completed: Return to Gann Stonespire at the Southern Gold Road in the Barrens.

text.title: 科卡尔首领
text.objectives: 击败巴拉克，获得他的战利品。
text.description: 半人马的问题困扰着牛头人已经很多年了，最近，贫瘠之地的科卡尔半人马开始形成真正的威胁。通常他们散居在这片土地上，不过他们当中已经产生了新的首领，他把一盘散沙的半人马集合在一起。$B$B为了保护我们的家园，这些半人马领袖就必须要除掉。$B$B帮我带回巴拉克·科多班恩的战利品，他在西方的遗忘之池附近驻营。$B$B除掉他，然后再回到我这里。
text.progress: 你好，$N。你带巴拉克的头颅回来了吗?
text.completion: 做得好，$N。虽然半人马是群粗俗而且野蛮的家伙，却也不乏充满智慧和远见的领袖。他们才是最危险的。$B$B巴拉克就是这样一个半人马，还好他已经被干掉了。
text.completed: Bring Kodobane's Head to Telar Highstrider at the Forgotten Pools in Northern Barrens.

english.title: Kolkar Leaders
english.objectives: Slay Barak Kodobane and collect his head.
english.description: The centaurs have plagued the tauren for years. And recently, the Kolkar centaurs of the Barrens have grown into a real threat. Normally they were disorganized in these lands, but new leaders have risen among them. Rallying them.$B$BTo preserve our holdings here, these centaur leaders must be destroyed.$B$BBring me the head of Barak Kodobane. He camps west of these Forgotten Pools.$B$BDefeat him, then return to me.
english.progress: Hello, $n. Do you have Kodobane's head for me?
english.completion: Well done, $n. Kodobane is just one strand of a tangled thread - there are other Kolkar leaders to kill elsewhere in the Barrens. Seek out my companions at the other oases if you wish to press the assault.
english.completed: Bring Kodobane's Head to Telar Highstrider at the Forgotten Pools in Northern Barrens.

text.title: 狂热的维罗戈
text.objectives: 杀死维内斯，将维罗戈引出来。然后杀死他，获取他的徽记。
text.description: 要找到维罗戈也许很困难，但是根据你收集到的情报，他的配偶维内斯总是待在他的指挥帐篷里，就在这里的西边。如果我们杀掉她，维罗戈一定会冲出来的。$B$B雷戈萨派我们来执行侦察任务，但他也说了，我们要抓住一切可能的机会，破坏半人马的指挥系统。把维罗戈引出来干掉！
text.progress: $N，你找到维罗戈了吗?
text.completion: 很好。你一定激怒了那些半人马―我们的守卫注意到死水绿洲附近的动静，那应该就是你干的了。$B$B你应该为你所做的一切而感到自豪，$N。你是个非常勇敢的$r。
text.completed: Bring Verog's Head to Shoe at the Stagnant Oasis.

english.title: Verog the Dervish
english.objectives: Kill Wyneth in order to lure out Verog the Dervish, then slay him and grab his head.
english.description: Verog may be hard to find, but judging by the info you gathered, his mate Wyneth is always in his command tent just west of here. If we kill her, Verog will come running.$B$BRegthar sent us here to scout, but he also said we should seize any opportunity to upset the centaur chain of command if we can. Lure out Verog and kill him!
english.progress: Did you find Verog, $n?
english.completion: You did it! That'll really upset the balance of power down here. Verog left no clear successor, so I expect this crew of brutes will fall on each other like hungry dogs. I'll stay here and keep an eye on what happens next. Verog answered directly to the Kolkar Chief - killing him is a good start, but there's more work to be done.
english.completed: Bring Verog's Head to Shoe at the Stagnant Oasis.

text.title: 赫兹鲁尔·血印
text.objectives: 击败赫兹鲁尔，获得他的战利品。
text.description: 赫兹鲁尔·血印是贫瘠之地的科卡尔半人马的首领。他凶猛、残忍，诡计多端。消灭他就可以瓦解半人马部落，从而极大地削弱他们对我们的威胁。$B$B去杀了他。带回赫兹鲁尔的战利品。我会带着战利品示众，让他们知道我们的厉害。$B$B他和他的手下驻扎就在南方的甜水绿洲一带。
text.progress: $N，你打败赫兹卢尔了吗?
text.completion: 恭喜你，$N。这些半人马毫无组织性，不可能像兽人们一样团结起来，不过他们仍然凶猛无比。你已经通过击败他们而证明你的英勇。
text.completed: Bring Hezrul's Head to Regthar Deathgate at his outpost in Northern Barrens.

english.title: Hezrul Bloodmark
english.objectives: Slay Hezrul Bloodmark and collect his head.
english.description: Hezrul Bloodmark is the leader of the Kolkar centaurs in the Barrens. He is fierce, brutal and cunning. Defeating him would disrupt and fracture the Kolkars, greatly reducing their threat to us.$B$BSo kill him. Bring me Hezrul's Head, and I will mount it from this outpost, so that they may know fear.$B$BHezrul leads his people from the Lushwater Oasis, to the south.
english.progress: Is Hezrul defeated, $n?
english.completion: I commend you, $n. These centaur are undisciplined and cannot focus their rage as the orcs can, but they are fierce nonetheless.  In defeating them, your valor is proven.
english.completed: Bring Hezrul's Head to Regthar Deathgate at his outpost in Northern Barrens.

text.title: [DEPRICATED] Apothecary Zamah
text.objectives: 在药剂的效力消失之前，把提炼过的孢子交给雷霆崖的药剂师扎玛。
text.description: 我用你给我的孢子制成了药剂。现在我必须把它送给我的同事，药剂师扎玛。如果你愿意帮忙把这个带给她，她会拿一些我们存储下来的炼金术用品奖励你的。$B$B她就在预见之池里，那是一个位于雷霆崖下面的洞穴。通向洞穴的小路非常隐蔽，不过你可以在灵魂高地下面找到这条小路。$B$B快点出发吧，这种药剂的效力只能持续很短的一段时间，在这段时间里必须要送到扎玛那里。
text.progress: 你从药剂师赫布瑞姆那里给我带来了一些东西?快让我看看。
text.completion: 啊，是赫布瑞姆从贫瘠之地收集的孢子。他让你送过来的?很好。$B$B药剂仍然有效，看来你在路上没有耽搁时间。干得不错，$C。

english.title: [DEPRICATED] Apothecary Zamah
english.objectives: Bring the Rendered Spores to Apothecary Zamah in Thunder Bluff, before the time limit is up.
english.description: I have rendered the spores you gave me into an emulsion.  I must now send it to my associate, Apothecary Zamah.  If you were to carry this to her, she can offer you something from our stores of alchemical goods.$B$BShe is in the Pools of Vision, a cave beneath the shamans of Thunder Bluff.  The path to this cave is well hidden, but you may find it on the Spirit Rise bluff.$B$BDo hurry.  This emulsion will maintain its potency for only a short time, and must be resealed and processed before then.
english.progress: You have something from Apothecary Helbrim?
english.completion: Ah, the spores from the Barrens that Helbrim was gathering.  He garnered your aid in delivering them?  Good. And the emulsion is still potent, so you must have wasted no time in the delivery.  Well done, $c.

text.title: 十字路口之旅
text.objectives: 去十字路口和索克谈一谈。
text.description: 我已经预见到你会来找我，年轻的$C，虽然你可能已经并不是那么年轻了。$B$B我想，现在是时候让你深入这片土地了，我能感觉到你命中注定是要做一番大事业的人。$B$B你应该到十字路口去，因为我们和兽人的命运已经紧紧地联系在了一起，他们那儿需要帮助。沿着这条路往东走，然后向北就可以走到十字路口。到那里去找索克吧。
text.completion: 很高兴看到越来越多的$r盟友来帮助我们。十字路口需要更多帮助。在这里到处转转，和大家聊聊天，你就会发现这儿有很多事等着你去做。

english.title: Journey to the Crossroads
english.objectives: Speak with Thork at the Crossroads in the Barrens.
english.description: I have foreseen your arrival, young $c. Though perhaps you are not so young anymore.$B$BI think that it is time for you to move deeper into this land. I can sense that you are destined for great things.$B$BIt is the Crossroads that you must seek out, for our lives with the orcs have become intertwined and they need assistance. Continue down this road towards the east and follow it north to the Crossroads. Find Thork within its walls, he has the Earthmother's blessing.
english.completion: It is good to see that more of our $R allies have come to assist us from as far away as Thunder Bluff. Again, I welcome you.

text.title: 半人马护腕
text.objectives: 从科卡尔掠夺者和科卡尔风暴先知身上收集10个半人马护腕。
text.description: 半人马的领导依赖一群忠诚而又纪律严明的战士来压制其他人。如果我们削弱他们的数量，科卡尔半人马就无力兴风作浪了。为此，我会交给你一项赏金任务。$B$B到南边的甜水绿洲去，干掉科卡尔掠夺者和科卡尔风暴先知，收集他们的护腕。当你能带回足够多的护腕的时候，部落会奖赏你的。
text.progress: $N，你的任务完成了吗?
text.completion: 干得漂亮。我想你已经让那些苟活的半人马感受到了恐惧，$N。如果他们还有些理智的话，现在就应该冷静下来，停止他们的行动。$B$B但我恐怕他们不会那么做，真糟糕。$B$B这个糟糕……是对他们而言的。
text.completed: Take the Bracers to Regthar Deathgate at his post in Northern Barrens.

english.title: Centaur Bracers
english.objectives: Collect 10 Centaur Bracers from Kolkar Marauders and Stormseers.
english.description: The centaur leadership relies on a core of trusted, disciplined warriors to keep the others in line. If we reduce their numbers, the Kolkar will have no might with which to support their rage. And so, I have a bounty task for you.$B$BAround the Lushwater Oasis to the south, slay Kolkar Marauders and Stormseers to collect their bracers. Return when you have a heap of these trophies and the Horde will reward you well.
english.progress: How goes your hunting, $n?
english.completion: Nicely done. I'm sure you've struck fear into the surviving centaurs, $n. With their greatest warriors slain, they will either stop their advances or lash out at us in a foolhardy strike. I hope for the latter.
english.completed: Take the Bracers to Regthar Deathgate at his post in Northern Barrens.

text.title: <UNUSED>
text.objectives: Continue down the road from Camp Taurajo.$B$BTurn left at the T intersection and continue North.$B$BFollow the path to the Ancestral Sage outside the Crossroads.
text.description: Though you have reached the Barrens, your journey is not complete. You must continue on to the Crossroads, where you are needed most.$B$BFollow the road as you were, and turn left where the path gives you the choice. Follow it North until you see the walls of the Crossroads.$B$BJust before you enter, you should see the Ancestral Sage, he will have words of wisdom for you.

english.title: <UNUSED>
english.objectives: Continue down the road from Camp Taurajo.$B$BTurn left at the T intersection and continue North.$B$BFollow the path to the Ancestral Sage outside the Crossroads.
english.description: Though you have reached the Barrens, your journey is not complete. You must continue on to the Crossroads, where you are needed most.$B$BFollow the road as you were, and turn left where the path gives you the choice. Follow it North until you see the walls of the Crossroads.$B$BJust before you enter, you should see the Ancestral Sage, he will have words of wisdom for you.

text.title: 众月之泪
text.objectives: 被流放的费格雷要你取回他的众月之泪。
text.description: 那是我的宝贝！我的！我要把它夺回来！夺回来！$b$b那些肮脏的挖掘者发现了它……它是如此美丽，众月之泪是我们在巴尔莫丹的第一个重大发现。$b$b它本就该是我的！对，我的！我的宝贝！$b$b塔文布莱德将军嫉妒众月之泪带给我的力量，居然就把它锁在了城堡里。他说那是一个诅咒！这个蠢货！$b$b其他人想要夺走它，他们是不会得逞的！那个叫塔文布莱德的杂种把我赶了出来。$b$b我要夺回来！夺回我的宝贝！
text.progress: 众月之泪在哪儿?我需要它!很需要!
text.completion: 我的宝贝终于还是回来了!它是我的!我的!
text.completed: Return to Feegly the Exiled at Bael Modan in The Barrens.

english.title: The Tear of the Moons
english.objectives: Feegly the Exiled wants you to retrieve for him the Tear of the Moons.
english.description: The power was mine! In my very hands! And I want it back! Back I say!$b$bThose dirty excavators uncovered it... so beautiful it was. Deemed the Tear of the Moons, it was the first great discovery we made at Bael Modan.$b$bIt should have been mine! Mine I say!$b$bGeneral Twinbraid grew jealous of the power it gave me. He locked it away in the Keep. Called it cursed, he did! The fool!$b$bOthers wanted it and they had to be stopped! That fiend Twinbraid drove me off.$b$bNow I want it back. Back I say!
english.progress: Where is the Tear of the Moons? I need it now! Need I say!
english.completion: At last, the power is mine again! Mine I say!
english.completed: Return to Feegly the Exiled at Bael Modan in The Barrens.

text.title: 打火钥匙
text.objectives: 从鲁格维兹主管那里取得打火钥匙。
text.description: 你该不会是斯布特瓦夫派来的吧？我被困在这儿了。我在不知道需要钥匙才能启动伐木机的情况下就贸然跳了进来。更蠢的是，当另一台伐木机的操作员问我是否一切正常的时候，我居然慌了神！我没有告诉他我手里没钥匙，而只是说机器有些问题。$b$b我们要赶紧离开这里！到起重机上的控制室去，那里的鲁格维兹主管应该有这台伐木机的钥匙。$b$b帮我离开这儿！
text.progress: 快点，我们得在他们生疑之前逃出这里!
text.completion: 啊，好像就是这把钥匙!让我想想该怎么用……$B$B嗯……旋转控制……这是调节速度和稳定性的……手感不错。看看这个!我真不敢相信风险投资公司能造出比我们还先进的设备来。我要把这个带回棘齿城!
text.completed: Bring the key to Wizzlecrank's Shredder at the Sludge Fen in North Barrens.

english.title: Ignition
english.objectives: Get the Ignition Key from Supervisor Lugwizzle.
english.description: I don't suppose Sputtervalve sent you? I'm in a bind here. I hopped in without realizing that I need a key to unlock the shredder's movement column. One of the other shredder operators asked me if everything was okay, and I panicked! Instead of telling him that I was missing my key, I told him there was some sort of mechanical problem.$b$bWe need to get out of here on the double! Search the upper level of the derrick, Supervisor Lugwizzle should have a key for this shredder.$b$bHelp me out here!
english.progress: Quick, we need to get out of here before someone gets suspicious!
english.completion: Yep, this looks like the right key. Let me just make sure I know how to work this thing... Hmm... rotation control... This regulates speed and stability... fine arm movement control. Just look at this! I can't believe the Venture Company could design something this much better than ours. I've got to get this back to the outpost!
english.completed: Bring the key to Wizzlecrank's Shredder at the Sludge Fen in North Barrens.

text.title: 瑟格拉·黑棘
text.objectives: 和十字路口的瑟格拉·黑棘谈一谈。
text.description: 如果你想继续沿着猎人之道前行，就得到贫瘠之地去了。那儿的野兽强壮而凶猛，在那里打猎会让你学到很多东西，而你的意志力也会随之增强。$B$B去和瑟格拉·黑棘谈谈吧，她会是你在贫瘠之地的第一位向导。她就在十字路口，只要从血蹄村一直往东进入贫瘠之地，见到岔路口之后再往北走就可以到那里了。$B$B在贫瘠之地旅行的时候可得小心点，那是一个充满危险和挑战的地方。
text.completion: 你想在贫瘠之地打猎?$B$B从你的双眼中我可以看到朝气和热情。当你在这片干燥的平原上捕猎的时候，你也不会在烈日的强光之下闭上双眼。$B$B别担心，我们会使你变得更加强壮，更加坚强。而且我们还会让你知道，狩猎不仅仅只是找到并杀掉你的猎物。$B$B做好准备吧。真正的旅程现在才刚刚开始。

english.title: Sergra Darkthorn
english.objectives: Speak with Sergra Darkthorn at the Crossroads.
english.description: If you wish to walk the hunter's path, then your journey leads to the Barrens.  Its beasts are strong-willed and fierce.  You will learn much by hunting there, and your spirit will grow.$B$BSpeak with Sergra Darkthorn.  She will be your first guide in the Barrens.$B$BSergra is at the Crossroads.  To reach her, travel east from Bloodhoof Village into the Barrens, then north as the road forks.  And have care as you travel--the Barrens holds great danger for the unprepared and unwary.
english.completion: You want to hunt in the Barrens?$B$BYour eyes are eager, and young.  They're not yet squinted from tracking your prey across this land's dry plains.$B$BBut worry not. We'll toughen your body and your mind.  And we'll teach you that there is more to hunting than finding and killing your quarry.$B$BPrepare yourself.  Your journey begins.  Now.

text.title: 猎人之道
text.objectives: 收集4只平原徘徊者的爪子。
text.description: 我看得出来，你非常渴望探索。我也渴望到处漫游，至少曾经是这样……$B$B漫游，狩猎。狩猎是牛头人最高的荣誉。$B$B如果你真想走猎人这条路的话，就向我证明一下你的能力和决心。把莫高雷的平原徘徊者的爪子拿来给我看。平原徘徊者非常凶猛、狡猾——对于一个想要成为猎手的年轻$c来说再合适不过了。
text.progress: 你好，找我有事吗?
text.completion: 斯考恩.白云是个睿智的牛头人。他做了多年的猎人，虽然他的身体已经老了，可是他还是保持着旺盛的战斗精神。我们为他感到骄傲。$B$B既然斯考恩让你来找我，那你一定也具有猎人的精神。你还收集了这些爪子，来证明你快速增进的技能。$B$B也许你已经准备好要走这条路了。
text.completed: Return to Skorn Whitecloud at Camp Sungraze in Mulgore.

english.title: The Hunter's Way
english.objectives: Collect 4 Flatland Prowler Claws.
english.description: You are eager to explore, I can tell.  I too had the lust to wander, once...$B$BWander, and hunt.  For hunting is a tauren's greatest honor.$B$BIf you truly wish to follow the ways of the hunter, show me your skill and resolve. Bring me the claws of the flatland prowlers of Mulgore.  They are tough and cunning -- fitting prey for a young $c on the path of the hunt.
english.progress: How goes the hunt, $n?
english.completion: Well done, young one.
english.completed: Return to Skorn Whitecloud at Camp Sungraze in Mulgore.

text.title: 掘地鼠炖肉
text.objectives: 给十字路口的格拉布弄到8只掘地鼠。
text.description: 像你样一个$C在贫瘠之地肯定会饿得前心贴后背，你看我，我就已经饿了整整一天了。$B$B我跟你说吧，我可以为你做一道大餐，不过得要先弄一些掘地鼠来。$B$B那些可恶的巴尔莫丹矮人几乎把这里的掘地鼠都给吃光了！你到南边的巴尔莫丹去给我带一些掘地鼠回来吧。$B$B如果你连这都搞不定的话，就不要再自称是经验丰富的冒险家了！
text.progress: $N，找到足够多的掘地鼠了吗?
text.completion: 一般来说我不喜欢吃这些啮齿动物，我是说在它们还这么……这么新鲜的时候。要让它们先腐烂几周之后再吃，才能真正地享受到那独到的美味，不过你看起来好像是等不及了。$B$B我给你做些掘地鼠炖肉吧，现在就开始。$B$B做好了!尝尝吧!
text.completed: Return to Grub in The Barrens.

english.title: Dig Rat Stew
english.objectives: Bring 8 Dig Rats to Grub east of the Crossroads.
english.description: A $c like you must get pretty hungry out here in The Barrens. Me, I'm starving all day long.$b$bTell you what, I'll fix you up a nice stew. Just need a few dig rats.$b$bSeems those filthy dwarves at Bael Modan are overrun with everyone's favorite feast. Now head on down south to Bael Modan and bring me back some dig rats.$b$bYou can't call yourself a seasoned adventurer until you've spent some time killing rats! Haw!
english.progress: Whack enough dig rats yet, $n?
english.completion: Normally I don't like to eat these rodents when they're so.... so... ripe. Like to let them rot for a few weeks to really bring out the flavor. But you look so hungry. Let me fix you some Dig Rat Stew. Ah, there we go. Here you go!
english.completed: Return to Grub in The Barrens.

text.title: 逃跑
text.objectives: 保护维兹克兰克以及他搞到的地精伐木机离开淤泥沼泽。
text.description: 我想我要好好学学才行……应该不会很难。就这些按钮，一个操纵杆和两个……对了，你准备好要出发了吗？
text.progress: 我能帮你吗?
text.completion: 希望我们能从这被毁坏的伐木机雏形中找到一些有价值的东西……我的时间很有限!我要赶紧派一支抢修队到维兹克兰克那里去。$B$B哦，让我也为你提供些必要的帮助。
text.end: 护送维兹克兰克离开风险投资公司钻井工地
text.completed: 与北贫瘠之地诺兹波特的哨站的斯布特瓦夫交谈。

english.title: The Escape
english.objectives: Protect Wizzlecrank and the stolen goblin shredder on the way out of the Sludge Fens.
english.description: I suppose I'll learn as we go... Couldn't be too hard. Just some buttons here, and a lever or two... Well, are you ready to go?
english.progress: Can I help you?
english.completion: He wrecked it!? . Hopefully we'll be able to get something of value from the wrecked shredder prototype... my business depends on it! I'll start tearing that sucker apart and we'll see what makes it tick. Oh, let me give you something for your trouble, too.
english.end: Escort Wizzlecrank out of the Venture Co. drill site
english.completed: Talk to Sputtervalve at Nozzlepot's Outpost in Northern Barrens.

text.title: 向药剂师金格回报
text.objectives: 把实验工具包带给幽暗城的药剂师金格。
text.description: “搞定了，现在能量源已经被安全卸载，而你的数据也被完全保留下来了。好了，接下来就只有祝你一路顺风了，希望你的科学实验一切顺利。”$B$B那个地精转身开始继续做加基森水业公司的事情。你小心翼翼地把封好的实验工具包收起来，然后准备把它带回幽暗城。药剂师金格正在那里等着你向他进行回报。
text.progress: 欢迎回来。至少，如果你带回了我要的实验资料的话，我欢迎你回来。否则，我可不会浪费宝贵的时间来和你废话，你要做的就是尽快去完成我交给你的任务。
text.completion: 我会马上着手分析这些资料，也许基佛的神经错乱反而能够证明我的天才。$B$B你对我来说……还是很有用的，我会奖励像你这样有用的$C。收下这个东西，还有这些钱，还有我们对你的感谢。$B$B经常回来看看―我相信我们在这个项目上的合作还没有完结。

english.title: Return to Apothecary Zinge
english.objectives: Bring the Sealed Field Testing Kit to Apothecary Zinge in the Undercity.
english.description: "Here you go, the power source is safely removed and the data is preserved.  Well, safe journeys and all that.  Hope the nefarious science experiment worked out for you and all."$B$BThe goblin turns away from you to attend to the demands of the Gadgetzan Water Company.  You secure the sealed testing kit for the journey back to the Undercity.  Apothecary Zinge waits for you and the sealed field testing kit there.
english.progress: Welcome back.  At least, welcome back if you have returned with a sealed testing kit.  Otherwise, I will pretend not to notice your utter incompetence and spare my wrath from you until you do as you have been tasked and accomplish my task.
english.completion: I will analyze this data immediately.  Perhaps Keever's insanity will prove to be my genius after all. As for you...  you are useful to me, and I reward quite well those who remain useful.  Take this item, this coin, and most importantly my thanks along with them. Check back with me from time to time - I wager that our working together on this project is not at an end.

text.title: 一定是因为角
text.objectives: 获得镰爪之王的角。
text.description: 贫瘠之地的迅猛龙比其它地方的都要聪明。我想这份聪明劲就藏在它们的角里！要是这样的话，那我把它们的角磨成粉，做成“聪明剂”，我就发财了！$B$B你要干的事情是这样的：我要这附近最聪明的迅猛龙的角。“镰爪之王”是棘齿城北边悬崖上那些智能迅猛龙的头领。把他的角给我带来！别像我派去的其他人那样给扯成一条条的！
text.progress: $N，你弄到赤鳞镰爪龙的角了吗?那些角会让我大赚一笔!
text.completion: 好极了，就是它们!现在，我只需把它们磨成粉末，加一点点酒，然后……
text.completed: Take Reaperclaw's Horn to Mebok Mizzyrix at Ratchet in North Barrens.

english.title: It's Gotta be the Horn
english.objectives: Acquire King Reaperclaw's Horn.
english.description: The raptors of the Barrens are smarter than raptors in other lands. I think all those smarts are hiding in their horns! If so, then I could grind their horns into powder and use it to make "smart drinks." I'll make a fortune!$B$BHere's where you come in: I want the horn from the smartest raptor around. "King Reaperclaw" leads a whole pack of intelligent raptors up on the bluffs north of Ratchet. Bring me his horn! And don't get ripped to ribbons like everyone else I've sent!
english.progress: Did you get King Reaperclaw's horn, $n? I need to test my first smart drink!
english.completion: Great, you got it! Let's grind this up and mix it with some wine, and...
english.completed: Take Reaperclaw's Horn to Mebok Mizzyrix at Ratchet in North Barrens.

text.title: 根须样本
text.objectives: 在北贫瘠之地一带的草药上收集8份根须样本。
text.description: 贫瘠之地的草药似乎和其它地方的不大一样。它们的属性几乎相同，不过这里的绿洲之水却令它们发生了一些改变，使它们变得有那么一点点特别了。$B$B我想找出这些草药到底有什么特别之处……然后看看它们有没有利用价值！$B$B如果你精通草药的话，就帮我在贫瘠之地收集一些这种草药的根须样本吧。把这些样本交给我，这样一来，我就能比较一下它们与其它地区的草药之间的差异了。
text.progress: 你好，$N。找到那些草药的根须样本了吗?
text.completion: 没错没错，就是这个!我会用这些草药的根来培育一些草药样品，然后对它们进行研究。我希望从中能够发现一些新的属性，一些隐性的、但是很有价值的属性……$B$B别担心―只要成功了，我会第一个告诉你的，因为我需要一个能帮我收集更多草根的人!
text.completed: Bring the Samples to Mebok Mizzyrix at Ratchet in Northern Barrens.

english.title: Root Samples
english.objectives: Collect 8 Root Samples from herbs around North Barrens.
english.description: The herbs of the Barrens are not quite like herbs in other lands.  Their properties are mostly the same, but the oasis water here alters the plants; they are just slightly different.$B$BI want to study those differences... to see if they're exploitable!$B$BIf you are skilled in herbalism, then gather root samples off the herbs you find in the Barrens.  Bring back these samples so that I may compare them with herbs from other regions.
english.progress: Hello, $n.  Did you get those root samples?
english.completion: Yes yes, these are very nice!  I will grow specimens from these roots and study them.  I hope to find new properties from them.  Hidden, valuable properties...! And don't worry -- if I do then you'll be the first to know.  Because I'll need someone to gather more!
english.completed: Bring the Samples to Mebok Mizzyrix at Ratchet in Northern Barrens.

text.title: 鹰身强盗
text.objectives: 从巫翼鹰身人身上收集6只巫翼鹰身人的爪子。
text.description: $c，既然你在这里，就帮我们解决一个小问题吧。这些该死的鹰身人长期以来不停地攻击和掠夺我们的补给商队。现在我们要割断她们的喉咙，削减她们的数量。$B$B对付她们最有效的战术是首先破坏她们的底层指挥系统，然后再对她们的高层成员发动进攻。$B$B先去干掉那些在西北方出没的巫翼鹰身人，给我带6只巫翼鹰身人的爪子回来。这应该是一个不错的开始……
text.progress: 杀了足够多的鹰身人了吗?如果没有的话就继续和她们战斗，我要你给我带回来8只巫翼鹰身人的爪子。
text.completion: 哦，不错……真的很不错。$N，干得好。我期望未来能看到你做出更多的大事来。
text.completed: Bring the talons to Darsok Swiftdagger at his outpost in North Barrens.
text.turninWindow: 让这些肮脏的怪物少一点，我也能轻松一点。

english.title: Harpy Raiders
english.objectives: Collect 6 Witchwing Talons from Witchwing harpies.
english.description: Since you're here, $c, perhaps you can help me with a small problem. The blasted harpies have been ravaging our caravan supplies for too long. It's time we slit a few of their throats and diminished their numbers.$B$BThe most devastating attack will destroy a good section of their lower chain of command and then we can work our way to the top.$B$BTake out Witchwing harpies of any kind in the Northwest and bring me 6 Witchwing Talons. That should be a good start...
english.progress: Cut up enough of them yet? Keep slicing and taking trophies. I want 8 Witchwing talons.
english.completion: Oh, these are nice. Real nice... Good job, $n. I look forward to seeing more of your work in the future.
english.completed: Bring the talons to Darsok Swiftdagger at his outpost in North Barrens.
english.turninWindow: Give me a few less of those filthy creatures to worry about.

text.title: 蝎卵
text.objectives: 把12枚异种蝎卵和掘地爪交给十字路口的科兰。
text.description: 嘿，$n，奥格瑞玛城里的主人派我到十字路口来观察这片土地并记录这里所发生的一切。$B$B我的目标之一是在巨人旷野南方出现的昆虫状生物。我们对这种生物知之甚少，所以我把它作为我的主要研究课题，希望能发现点什么。它们似乎有超出一般生物的智能。$B$B拿着这个掘地铲，从土丘里收集一些它们的卵。不过你要当心，这些生物一旦收到同伴的警报，就会立刻蜂拥而至。
text.progress: 小心不要弄碎了你找到的卵，$N。如果它们破了的话就没用了。
text.completion: 感谢你的帮助，$N。这正是我需要的卵。$B$B这是给你的奖赏……
text.completed: Return to Korran in The Barrens.

english.title: Egg Hunt
english.objectives: Bring 12 Silithid Eggs and the Digging Claw to Korran at the Crossroads.
english.description: Hey, $n. I been sent to the Crossroads to watch over the land and take note of its happenings for my masters in Orgrimmar.$B$BOne object of my studies are the insect-like creatures found to the south in the Field of Giants. We know little of the creatures, so I be makin' it a point to discover more. They seem to have intelligence to them, more so than any normal animal.$B$BTake this digging claw and collect some of the creatures' eggs from their mounds, but be careful: if alerted, they will attack you.
english.progress: Be careful with the eggs you find, $n. If they break, they be no good to me.
english.completion: You please me, $n. The eggs and the tool. Well done.$B$BAnd for your reward...
english.completed: Return to Korran in The Barrens.

text.title: 追踪窃贼
text.objectives: 脚印一路延伸到了荆棘岭的东侧。跟着这串脚印，看看你能找到些什么。
text.description: 一片狼藉的现场到处都是动物的脚印，而且是某种巨大而尖锐的爪子留下的，看样子是迅猛龙的脚印。$B$B你的直觉告诉你，可能是某些骑着迅猛龙的劫匪扫荡了这辆货车，但感觉不是很笃定，而且现场也没有其他人的脚印。$B$B脚印一路延伸到东北面的荆棘岭东侧。这个谜团的答案一定就在那里。
text.progress: $N，你拿到那些迅猛龙的头了吗?
text.completion: 你干掉了那些迅猛龙!$B$B谢谢你，$N，你真是个优秀的$C。
text.completed: The tracks lead to the east side of Thorn Hill. Follow them and see what you find.

english.title: To Track a Thief
english.objectives: The tracks lead to the east side of Thorn Hill. Follow them and see what you find.
english.description: Animal tracks surround the wreckage, tracks made by enormous curved claws. They appear to be raptor tracks.$B$BYour first instinct is that raptor-riders assaulted the caravan, but the impressions aren't deep and there are no non-animal tracks to be seen.$B$BThe tracks head northeast of here toward the east side of Thorn Hill. The answer to this mystery must lie in its shadow.
english.progress: Do you have those heads, $n?
english.completion: Before you lies an entire community of raptors, ducking in and out of hovels, snarling at one another, and working together to construct primitive huts. Collections of shiny things surround their nests. Mystery solved!
english.completed: The tracks lead to the east side of Thorn Hill. Follow them and see what you find.

text.title: 遗忘之池
text.objectives: 搜索十字路口西北的遗忘之池的底部。
text.description: 你能感受到大地的震颤吗？某种力量将这块大地劈成了两半。但是我们德鲁伊却能感受到另一种震颤。$B$B生命正在这片曾经干涸死寂的土地下发芽。十字路口周围的绿洲突然繁茂起来了。我感觉到一股神秘的力量正在逐渐渗透出地表。可它是从哪儿来的呢？它是否和撕裂贫瘠之地的那场灾难有关呢？$B$B我们必须找到这股力量的源头，请到十字路口西北边的遗忘之池去一趟，在那里的湖水中搜寻力量的源泉，然后回到这里来。
text.progress: $N，你去过遗忘之池吗?有没有发现什么?
text.completion: 你找到一处地缝，气体从缝隙中喷涌而出?真奇怪。这也许是问题的答案，但我们现在还不能肯定。$B$B不过这是个很重要的线索，感谢你的努力。
text.completed: Report your findings back to Tonga Runetotem at the Crossroads in Northern Barrens.

english.title: The Forgotten Pools
english.objectives: Search the bottom of the Forgotten Pools northwest of the Crossroads.
english.description: Have you felt the tremors, $c? Something has cleaved this land in two. But we druids can sense other tremors, as well.$B$BLife is stirring in lands once dry and lifeless. The oases around the Crossroads are suddenly blooming. I can sense a power leaking its way to the surface, but from where? Is it related to the disaster that shattered the Barrens?$B$BWe must find the source. Travel to the Forgotten Pools, northwest of the Crossroads. Search its waters for a source of power, then return here.
english.completion: You found a fissure in the earth, with power emanating from it? Strange. Something is causing that oasis to bubble over suddenly with life. Come, $c - there is something else I'd like you to investigate with me.
english.end: Explore the waters of the Forgotten Pools
english.completed: Report your findings back to Tonga Runetotem at the Crossroads in Northern Barrens.

text.title: 保卫前沿哨所
text.objectives: 杀死8名钢鬃掠夺者和3名钢鬃猎手。
text.description: 所有的野猪人都是我们的敌人，$n。只不过其中有些比别的更讨厌。$B$B钢鬃部落一直在攻击从这里到奥格瑞玛的补给商队。我已经派斥候去寻找他们首领的位置，但在此之前，你能给这些肮脏的猪人造成多少打击，对我们来说都是好的。$B$B不妨从南部开始，他们经常侵袭我们在河边的营地。把它们找出来，杀掉它们。
text.progress: 野猪人的袭击行动越得不到遏制，我们就越难获得足够的补给。
text.completion: 做得不错，$N。那些傲慢的野猪人应该终于知道部落的权威是不容触犯的。
text.completed: Return to Kargal at Far Watch Post in Northern Barrens.

english.title: In Defense of Far Watch
english.objectives: Kill 8 Razormane Plunderers and 3 Razormane Hunters.
english.description: All the quilboars are our enemies, $n. Some just prove to be more of a nuisance than others.$B$BThe Razormane tribe has been attacking our supply caravans that roll through here from Orgrimmar. I have scouts seeking the leader of these raids, but until then, any losses you can inflict on the filthy pig men would aid us.$B$BStart just south of here, where they've been raiding our camps near the river. Seek them out, and slay them.
english.progress: The longer it takes to stop these attacks, the harder it will be to provide supplies for the people of the Crossroads.
english.completion: You have done well, $n. Those insolent quilboars will finally learn that the might of the Horde is not to be ignored.
english.completed: Return to Kargal at Far Watch Post in Northern Barrens.

text.title: 前沿哨所的进攻
text.objectives: 杀掉5名钢鬃防御者、5名钢鬃织棘者，以及克里尼格·糟鼻。拿到糟鼻的獠牙。
text.description: 那些猪头人杀进杜隆塔尔边境了？有我在就不行！就像他们说得那样，$n：最好的防御就是把对手统统碾死。$B$B我的斥候跟踪上次袭击商队的一个野猪人，得知了它们的所在。克里尼格·糟鼻指挥着它们沿着河边进行袭击。去除掉他，$c。打败他，消灭他的部队，就能阻止他们对营地发动攻击。$B$B到我们的兽栏南边，沿着河水找一个野猪人聚居的洞穴，那里就是你的目标。
text.progress: 只要杀了那些野猪人的头儿，他们就会立刻陷入混乱之中，$N。好好学着吧，这些手段对你的将来会大有帮助的。$B$B这些野猪人会像无头苍蝇一样到处乱撞，而那时我们就能趁机夺回贫瘠之地。
text.completion: 好样的，$N!克里尼格一死，野猪人对我们商队的威胁就大大减少了。$B$B你的同胞会为你感到骄傲的。
text.completed: Bring Kreenig Snarlsnout's Tusk to Kargal Battlescar at Far Watch Post in Northern Barrens.

english.title: The Far Watch Offensive
english.objectives: Kill 5 Razormane Defenders, 5 Razormane Thornweavers, and Kreenig Snarlsnout. Take Snarlsnout's Tusk.
english.description: Pigmen running amok right on the border of Durotar? Not on my watch! It is as they say, $n: The best defense is crushing all who oppose you.$B$BOne of my scouts followed the quilboar after the last caravan raid, so we know where to strike. Kreenig Snarlsnout is the mastermind behind the attacks along the river. Crush him, $c. Defeat him and disembowel his forces so that the attacks on this camp cease.$B$BSearch for a quilboar-infested cavern along the river, just south of our stables.
english.progress: Cut off the head of their leader, and chaos ensues, $n. Learn this lesson well. It will aid you in the future.
english.completion: Well done, $n. Without Kreenig to orchestrate the raids, my grunts should be able to keep Far Watch secure. Your people should be proud to count you among them.
english.completed: Bring Kreenig Snarlsnout's Tusk to Kargal Battlescar at Far Watch Post in Northern Barrens.

text.title: Isha Awak
text.objectives: 把依沙瓦克的心脏交给玛伦·星眼。
text.description: 依沙瓦克是这片水域的主宰，它力大无穷、威武庄严。海岸上的人类都怕它，因为已经有太多的人类被它杀死。$B$B但我不怕，因为它对我来说是一次很有价值的挑战，一个值得尊敬的猎物。$B$B如果你准备好了，那么就到海里去寻找海中的巨兽依沙瓦克吧。$B$B它的灵魂包容在他的心中，听着它跳动的声音，你就将看到自己的命运。
text.progress: 不要对大海有所畏惧，$r。
text.completion: 你现在已经和依沙瓦克融为一体了，$N。它的灵魂与你同在。我可以从你的双瞳中感觉到它的存在……$B$B总有一天，这双眼睛会让你看到一切的。
text.completed: Return to Mahren Skyseer at The Tidus Stair in The Barrens.

english.title: Isha Awak
english.objectives: Bring the Heart of Isha Awak to Mahren Skyseer.
english.description: The grand Isha Awak is lord of these waters.  Great is his strength, and solemn his pride.  The humans on the coast fear him, for he has consumed many of their number.$B$BBut I do not fear him.  I am grateful he is here.  He is a worthy challenge, and honorable prey.$B$BIf you are ready, then swim out and search for Isha Awak, the Deep Doom.$B$BHis spirit dwells in his heart, and to hear its beat is to know your fate.
english.progress: Fear not the waters, $r.
english.completion: You now are one with Isha Awak, $n.  His spirit is with you.  He lurks in your eyes... Eyes that, one day, will learn to see.
english.completed: Return to Mahren Skyseer at The Tidus Stair in The Barrens.

text.title: 玛伦·星眼
text.objectives: 和玛伦·星眼谈一谈。
text.description: 你已经猎杀了贫瘠之地的猛兽，在这个过程中你的精神力量也已经变得相当强大了。作为一个猎人，你应当时刻都作好准备，一个真正的猎手理应能在任何环境下追踪猎物。无论是山川还是沼泽都无法阻止$g他:她;。$B$B甚至连海洋都不能。$B$B去找到我的妹妹玛伦，她正在海岸边猎杀一种大型水兽，你可以从她那里学习更高深的狩猎之道。$B$B不过你找她的时候要当心，因为贫瘠之地的海岸一带是现在是被人类控制着的。
text.completion: 是我哥哥派你来的吗?那你一定已经在他面前证明了自己。如果你赢得了乔恩的尊重，那么你也就赢得了我的尊重。$B$B你准备好接受学习更进一步的猎人之道了吗?

english.title: Mahren Skyseer
english.objectives: Speak with Mahren Skyseer.
english.description: You have hunted the beasts of the Barrens.  Your spirit is strong.  But a hunter must always be prepared.  A true hunter can stalk prey down any path.  Mountains and swamps will not sway $ghim:her;.$B$BNot even the sea.$B$BFind my sister, Mahren.  She hunts the great water beasts along the coast.  She will be your teacher in their ways.$B$BBut be wary in your search for her, for the Barrens' coast is held by humans.
english.completion: My brother sent you, did he?  Then you must have proven yourself to him.  If you have earned the respect of Jorn, then you have my respect as well. Are you ready to tread farther down the hunter's path?

text.title: 鹰身人首领
text.objectives: 在北贫瘠之地的无水岭消灭6只巫翼杀戮者。
text.description: 阻止鹰身人袭击的唯一办法只能是摧毁她们的指挥锁链。这些鹰身人的首领是不知畏惧的巫翼杀戮者。如果干掉她们，其余的鹰身人就不足为惧了。$B$B到无水岭去，消灭那里的巫翼杀戮者。让她们尝尝失败的痛苦，$n。我们要让那些下贱的鹰身人知道，与部落为敌是多么愚蠢的行为。
text.progress: 你收集到6枚鹰身人首副官之戒了吗?她们频频袭击部落的恶行必须受到审判!
text.completion: 做得很好，我的朋友。我相信你一定会飞黄腾达的。
text.completed: Return to Darsok Swiftdagger at his outpost in Northern Barrens.
text.giverWindow: 让那些肮脏的怪物明白，部落不是好惹的。
text.turninWindow: 你是部落所倚仗的力量！

english.title: Harpy Lieutenants
english.objectives: Kill 6 Witchwing Slayers in the Dry Hills of the Northern Barrens.
english.description: The only way to stop the harpy raiders is to destroy their chain of command. The harpies are led by fearless lieutenants, Witchwing Slayers. If the Slayers fall, the rest will follow.$B$BGo to the Dry Hills and cut down the Witchwing Slayers. Make sure they die painfully, $n. We want those harpy wenches to know the idiocy of picking fights with the Horde.
english.progress: Do you have 6 Harpy Lieutenant Rings yet? Justice must be dealt to them for their vicious attacks on the Horde.
english.completion: Excellent work my friend. I think you'll go far within the Horde.
english.completed: Return to Darsok Swiftdagger at his outpost in Northern Barrens.
english.giverWindow: Show those foul creatures that the Horde are not to be trifled with.
english.turninWindow: You are a worthy member of the Horde!

text.title: 塞瑞娜·血羽
text.objectives: 杀掉塞瑞娜·血羽，获得她的徽记。
text.description: 你杀死的那些鹰身人提到了她们的主母——塞瑞娜·血羽。从她们对部落的恶毒憎恨来看，塞瑞娜·血羽一定对部落抱着某种深仇大恨。你决定消灭塞瑞娜·血羽，彻底为部落结束这一威胁。
text.progress: 除非我看到塞瑞娜的脑袋，不然你什么也得不到。
text.completion: 哈!干得不错，$N!干得漂亮……当初我怀疑你是否胜任这项任务，不过你已经用行动证明了一切。谢谢你帮我们战胜了这些该死的鹰身人，这是你的奖赏。
text.completed: Return to Darsok Swiftdagger in Northern Barrens.
text.giverWindow: 杀了她。别忘了她的脑袋。

english.title: Serena Bloodfeather
english.objectives: Slay Serena Bloodfeather and collect her head.
english.description: The harpies you've killed mentioned their matron, Serena Bloodfeather. Judging from their vile hatred toward the Horde, she must hold some kind of deep-seated grudge. You decide to hunt down Serena Bloodfeather and end matters once and for all.
english.progress: You're not getting anything until I see Serena's head.
english.completion: HA! Well done, $n! Very well done... I wasn't sure you were up to the task, but you've proved yourself quite the cut-throat. Thank you again for helping us suppress the Harpy epidemic. Here is your reward, use it well.
english.completed: Return to Darsok Swiftdagger in Northern Barrens.
english.giverWindow: Kill her. Don't forget her head.

text.title: 死水绿洲
text.objectives: 使用干枯的种子调查死水绿洲底部的裂隙。
text.description: 南边到底发生了些什么呢？根据你在遗忘之池的发现，那些绿洲可能是发现问题的关键。$B$B带上这些种子，它们已经失去生命的活力。把它们带到东南方的死水绿洲去，如果那里有地缝的话，就把这些种子放在里面……然后仔细地观察一下。把你的发现告诉十字路口的图加。
text.progress: 你去过死水绿洲了吗?在死水绿洲的湖水下有地缝吗?
text.completion: 你的发现真是让我惊讶!我给你的种子原本是已经干瘪而且没有任何生命的活力了。显然，绿洲下潜藏的神秘力量能够创造生命!$B$B我们应该再仔细地研究一下……
text.completed: Report your findings to Tonga Runetotem at the Crossroads in Northern Barrens.

english.title: The Stagnant Oasis
english.objectives: Use the dried seeds to investigate the fissures in the Stagnant Oasis.
english.description: Can what's happening to the south happen here? Judging by what you found at the Forgotten Pools, these oases may be the key. Let's perform an experiment.$B$BHere, take these seeds I've collected from the summit here. They are dead and infertile, but carry them down to the Stagnant Oasis just below us. If there is a fissure there, then place the seeds within it... and observe. Report your findings back to Tonga at the Crossroads.
english.progress: Have you been to the Stagnant Oasis? Was there a fissure beneath its waters?
english.completion: Your findings are amazing! Jerrik was wise to send you there. We now know that whatever rests under these oases can create life from nothing! No doubt this is causing the havoc to the south, but my primary concern right now is preserving the balance up here. We must study this more...
english.completed: Report your findings to Tonga Runetotem at the Crossroads in Northern Barrens.

text.title: 野猪人的内战
text.objectives: 杀掉6个刺背寻水者、12个刺背织棘者和12个刺背地卜师，然后到陶拉祖营地的碎牙那里复命。
text.description: 你必须杀了我的敌人。<猪哼声>你必须帮助碎牙，帮助钢鬃野猪人。我们的部族都非常依赖自己的精神领袖——他们可以召唤大地的力量，<猪哼声>使他们让野猪人的部族变得强大……<猪哼声>$B$B如果你想要知道是谁频繁对部落<猪哼声>发动袭击，那你就应该帮助碎牙！你去杀了刺背野猪人的精神领袖，削弱他们，这样钢鬃野猪人就可以打败他们，统治贫瘠之地了！
text.progress: 先去<猪哼声>杀了刺背部族中的那些精神领袖，然后我才会告诉你更多内幕，$r。<猪哼声>
text.completion: 很好……那帮刺背部族的家伙们终于<哼哼>品尝到了我们的痛苦，$r。我本应对此感到高兴，但是<哼哼>事实并不是这样。$B$B你帮助你的同胞，他们会尊敬你。碎牙帮助他的同胞，他们又会干什么?他们对我不闻不问，任由我在这笼子里腐烂!$B$B我被困在这里的时候仍然在想办法帮助他们，但他们根本就没打算来救我!
text.completed: Return to Mangletooth at Camp Taurajo in The Barrens.

english.title: Tribes at War
english.objectives: Kill 6 Bristleback Water Seekers, 12 Bristleback Thornweavers and 12 Bristleback Geomancers and return to Mangletooth at Camp Taurajo in the Barrens.
english.description: You must strike my enemies. <snort> You must help Mangletooth and the Razormane by weakening the Bristlebacks. Both tribes are very spiritual--tied to the earth and its power. <snort> It gives us strength in all things... especially war.$B$BIf you want to find out who really causes Thork <snort> and the Horde such anguish, then help Mangletooth! You attack the spiritual leaders of the Bristlebacks to the north; weaken them so the Razormanes can defeat them and rule the Barrens.
english.progress: More information <snort> for the Horde when you've killed the Bristleback's wise ones, $R. <snort> Not a moment earlier! Mangletooth is no fool.
english.completion: Yes, yes... filled with joy because finally <snort> the Bristleback know my tribe's pain, $R. That is how I should feel, but that  is not the case.$B$BYou aid your people and they honor you. Mangletooth aids his people, and what do they do? They turn their backs on him. They forget him and leave him to rot in cage!$B$BI aid them even from locked behind bars and they send no one to save me!
english.completed: Return to Mangletooth at Camp Taurajo in The Barrens.

text.title: 内奸
text.objectives: 杀掉纳克、卡兹和洛克·奥克班恩，把它们的徽记交给陶拉祖营地的碎牙。
text.description: 有三个来自剃刀沼泽的部族参与了对部落的袭击。<猪哼声>他们非常狡诈而无情，如果你打败了他们，不仅仅是十字路口，整个贫瘠之地都将迎来和平……<猪哼声>至少野猪人不会再对你们构成威胁了。<猪哼声>$B$B你要找的是纳克、卡兹和洛克·奥克班恩，他们就在贫瘠之地的最南边活动。他们中的一个是施法者，另一个是追踪者，他们的首领是个战士。<猪哼声>$B$B杀了他们，杀了这帮背叛我的家伙。
text.progress: $r，你的猎杀进行得如何了?<猪哼声>$B$B索克自以为他知道是谁领导了那些袭击行动，<猪哼声>但是你的成功会让他明白他是大错特错了。$B$B我的死亡是无可挽回的，但是你对我的敌人造成了巨大的创伤，所以我也就没什么可后悔的了。<猪哼声>
text.completion: 没有比这更好的结局啦。他们本应该<猪哼声>确认一下我是不是已经死了，而不是把我留在<猪哼声>这个被人遗忘的囚笼中。$B$B我还有最后一个任务要交给你，$r。
text.completed: Return to Mangletooth at Camp Taurajo in The Barrens.

english.title: Betrayal from Within
english.objectives: Kill Nak, Kuz, and Lok Orcbane and bring their skulls to Mangletooth at Camp Taurajo in the Barrens.
english.description: Three of my tribe came out of the Kraul to lead the raids against the Horde, $r. <snort> They are ruthless and cunning, and if you defeat them, then your Crossroads and even most of the Barrens will learn peace... <snort> at least from the Razormane tribe. <snort>$B$BNak, Kuz, and Lok Orcbane are the ones you seek. They are far to the south  of the Barrens. One is a spell caster, another a tracker, and their leader, the one called Orcbane, <snort> a warrior. Kill them, $r, like they have killed me.
english.progress: How goes your hunt, $R? $B$BThork thinks he knows the truth about who leads the raids against his people,  but he shall learn how wrong he is if you are successful.$B$BMy death is inescapable, but you have caused great pain to my enemies, so Mangletooth regrets nothing.
english.completion: It is done then. Better it ends this way, says Mangletooth. <snort> They should have <snort> made sure I was dead when they turned their backs on me instead of leaving <snort> me here in this forsaken cage.$B$BThere is but one task left for you to finish, $R.
english.completed: Return to Mangletooth at Camp Taurajo in The Barrens.

text.title: 变异的生物
text.objectives: 从死水绿洲的钳嘴龟那里收集6块变异的钳嘴龟壳。
text.description: 研究那些被绿洲和你发现的异常能量所影响的植物和动物是件很重要的事。死水绿洲是一种钳嘴龟的家园。最近它们的数量激增。更严重的是，那些平素温和的动物却变得狂躁起来，看。$B$B<杰瑞克举起一根包着绷带的手指。>$B$B我怀疑它们被绿洲影响了。收集它们的甲壳然后带给十字路口的图加来进行进一步研究。
text.progress: 你拿到龟壳了吗?
text.completion: 谢谢你，$N。研究一个地区的兽类能够更好地了解这个地区本身的特性。让我们来看看这些龟壳能告诉我们些什么。$B$B请接受我对你所提供的帮助的感谢……也许这些银币对你有用，我想我并不需要它们。
text.completed: Bring the Shells to Tonga Runetotem at the Crossroads in Northern Barrens.

english.title: Altered Beings
english.objectives: Collect 6 Altered Snapjaw Shells from Snapjaws in the Stagnant Oasis.
english.description: It will be important to study both plant and animal life impacted by the oases and the unusual energies you've discovered. The Stagnant Oasis below us is home to a species of snapjaw turtles. Recently their population has exploded. Moreover, the once peaceful animals are growing aggressive, as I learned the hard way before trekking up here.$B$B<Jerrik holds up a bandaged finger.>$B$BI suspect they've been altered by the oases. Collect their shells and take them to Tonga at Crossroads for further study.
english.progress: What else have you brought me?
english.completion: Thank you, $n. Studying the beasts of an area can tell much about the area itself. We shall see what tale these shells tell, and possibly unravel the mystery of what's happening in the barrens. Please accept my gratitude for your aid... and perhaps you can use these coins. I find that I do not need them.
english.completed: Bring the Shells to Tonga Runetotem at the Crossroads in Northern Barrens.

text.title: 埃其亚基
text.objectives: 在埃其亚基的巢穴外吹响号角，然后杀死或制服它。
text.description: 白雾，也就是我们牛头人所说的埃其亚基，是草原狮的首领。它在捕食猎物时悄无声息地行动，就像大地上浮起的一层薄薄的白雾。它每次出击都是一击毙命，它的猎物甚至来不及恐惧和痛苦就已魂飞魄散。$B$B牛头人说，它是慈悲与死亡的混合体。$B$B$n，现在我派你去猎杀埃其亚基。它的巢穴就在这里的西北方，一座小山丘的北面，在那些巨大的科多兽骨附近。$B$B去吧，当你走到它的巢穴附近时，就吹响这个号角，它会出现的。
text.progress: 那只狮王在召唤你，$N。
text.completion: 你击败了埃其亚基。虽然它不能再捕猎了，但它的灵魂会一直伴随着你。它会让你了解到什么是柔弱中的刚强，仁慈中的尊严。$B$B你的路还很长，年轻的$C。大步向前走吧。
text.completed: Return to Sergra Darkthorn at the Crossroads in Northern Barrens.

english.title: Echeyakee
english.objectives: Blow your horn at Echeyakee's lair to summon him. Slay or subdue him.
english.description: Whitemist, or 'Echeyakee' in the tauren tongue, is the king of the savannah cats. He hunts with such stealth, they say he's like a thin, white mist on the earth. He kills so fast his prey have no time for fear or pain.$B$BThe tauren say he is both mercy and death.$B$B$n, I now set you on the path to hunt Echeyakee. His lair is just northwest of here, on the north side of a small mountain, among the bones of giant Kodo.$B$BGo. Blow this horn when you reach his lair. Blow the horn, and he will come.
english.progress: The great cat calls to you, $n.
english.completion: You've beaten Echeyakee, and though his days of hunting are over... his spirit is with you. He will show you the strength found in subtlety, and the honor in mercy. I underestimated you, $c. The Horde is fortunate to have you in its ranks.
english.completed: Return to Sergra Darkthorn at the Crossroads in Northern Barrens.

text.title: 伊沙姆哈尔
text.objectives: 把伊沙姆哈尔的牙齿交给陶拉祖营地的乔恩。
text.description: 伊沙姆哈尔是贫瘠之地最凶猛残忍的赤鳞龙，它狩猎并不是为了健身或是食物，而是因为狩猎是它最大的爱好，伊沙姆哈尔天生就是个杀手。$B$B$n，你会了解到它的天性的，因为你很快就要动身去追踪这条赤鳞龙了。$B$B开始这次猎杀行动吧。先去杀死一只它最喜欢捕猎的动物——斑马，然后把斑马肉挂在棘齿城西北边的枯树上。当伊沙姆哈尔闻到肉味的时候，它就会出现的。$B$B那时，你可要做好准备。
text.progress: $N，你战胜伊沙姆哈尔了吗?
text.completion: 这颗牙很小，不过它代表的东西可并不简单。$B$B你拥有了伊沙姆哈尔的力量，$N。愿你能适当地使用这种力量。它是你的重负，也是你的荣誉。
text.completed: Return to Jorn Skyseer at Camp Taurajo in The Barrens.

english.title: Ishamuhale
english.objectives: Bring Ishamuhale's Fang to Jorn at Camp Taurajo.
english.description: Ishamuhale, Speartooth, is the fiercest sunscale raptor of the Barrens.  He does not hunt for sport, nor for food.  He hunts because hunting is his passion.  He kills because it is his nature to kill.$B$BAnd you will learn of his nature, $n, for your path now follows the taloned tracks of Ishamuhale.$B$BBegin the hunt.  Slay his favorite prey, a zhevra, then bring its carcass to the dead tree northwest of Ratchet.  Ishamuhale will smell the carcass and be drawn to it.$B$BBe ready when he comes.
english.progress: $n, have you bested Ishamuhale?
english.completion: This fang is merely a token, but what it represents is profound. Ishamuhale's strength is in you, $n.  May you use it with temperance.  That is your burden. That is your honor.
english.completed: Return to Jorn Skyseer at Camp Taurajo in The Barrens.

text.title: Lakota'mani
text.objectives: 把拉克塔曼尼的蹄子交给陶拉祖营地的乔恩。
text.description: 拉克塔曼尼的蹄子是科多兽力量的象征。
text.progress: $N，从你的步伐中我看到了一种新的力量。告诉我，你的灵魂有没有与伟大的拉克塔曼尼进行碰撞?
text.completion: 拉克塔曼尼在我们的语言里被称为“震地者”，它的步伐就像雷声一样铿锵有力。现在，它与你合二为一，它的勇气和稳健将与你同在。现在没什么你应付不了的局面了。$B$B大胆地向前走吧，$N。大胆地向前走吧，震地者。

english.title: Lakota'mani
english.objectives: Bring the Hoof of Lakota'mani to Jorn at Camp Taurajo.
english.description: The Hoof of Lakota'mani is a symbol of the strength of the great kodo.
english.progress: $n, when you approached I saw a new power in your stride.  Tell me -- has your spirit met with the great Lakota'mani?
english.completion: Lakota'mani is called "Earthshaker" in our language, and his steps are like gathered thunder.  He is with you now, and his courage mingles with yours.  Together there is no conflict you cannot face. Walk tall, $n.  Walk tall, Earthshaker.

text.title: Owatanka
text.objectives: 把奥瓦坦卡的尾刺交给陶拉祖营地的乔恩。
text.description: 只要一被触及，奥瓦坦卡的尾刺就会闪烁起火花。
text.progress: $N，从你的目光中我看到了一种新的力量!你一定见过伟大的奥瓦坦卡了吧?
text.completion: 雷霆蜥蜴奥瓦坦卡被牛头人尊称为“蓝色霹雳”，因为它拥有令人惊讶的速度。据说很久以前，蓝色霹雳受到电击，天空的狂暴给予这头巨兽无限的力量。$B$B让它的能量流遍你的身体吧，$N。现在的你已经拥有足以匹敌奥瓦坦卡的力量了。

english.title: Owatanka
english.objectives: Bring Owatanka's Tailspike to Jorn at Camp Taurajo.
english.description: When touched, sparks fly from the tailspike of Owatanka.
english.progress: $n, there is a new power behind your eyes!  You have met with the mighty Owatanka, have you not?
english.completion: The thunder lizard Owatanka is called "Bluebolt" by the tauren, for within him resides a speed that belies his size.  It is said that lightning struck Bluebolt long ago and, fed from the sky's rage, the great beast's energy is without limit. May his energy flow through you, $n.  For you now keep pace with Owatanka.

text.title: Washte Pawne
text.objectives: 把瓦希塔帕恩的羽毛交给陶拉祖营地的乔恩·星眼。
text.description: 仅仅是轻轻触碰一下瓦希塔帕恩的羽毛，你都会感到相当刺痛。
text.progress: 你有一种新的决心，$N。一种来源于痛苦的决心……$B$B你承受着瓦希塔帕恩之死的痛苦吗?
text.completion: 雷鹰是贫瘠之地上的一种罕见动物，它的死预示着巨大的幸运或是不幸。$B$B不过，瓦希塔帕恩，也就是牛头人所说的灵魂之刺，要么什么都不会带来……要么什么都带来。$B$B你在猎杀灵魂之刺时所感受到的巨大痛苦，是每一个为了获取成功而付出了巨大代价的人都将感受到的。你感受到的刺痛是一种悔恨之痛，你要学会将这种悔恨转化为智慧，在痛苦中获取力量。$B$B通过这个任务，你应该学到了很多东西，$N。

english.title: Washte Pawne
english.objectives: Bring Washte Pawne's Feather to Jorn Skyseer at Camp Taurajo.
english.description: The feather of Washte Pawne is painful to the touch.
english.progress: There is new resolve within you, $n.  A resolve born from pain... Are you burdened with the death of Washte Pawne?
english.completion: The thunderhawk is a rare beast of the Barrens, and its death can portend great fortune, or great doom. But Washte Pawne, called "Spirit Biter" in Taurahe, can bring neither... or both. The pain you felt from hunting Spirit Biter is the pang all feel who make great gains at great costs.  The sting you felt is the pain of regret. But I can see you have conquered this.  You have learned that regret turns to wisdom, and that through pain one gains strength. You have learned much, $n.

text.title: 贫瘠之地的绿洲
text.objectives: 和十字路口的图加·符文图腾谈一谈。
text.description: 雷霆崖的德鲁伊们感到有一股奇怪的力量正在渗入莫高雷东边的贫瘠之地。$B$B图加·符文图腾已经被派去查找这股力量的来源了，但是我们担心他可能需要更多的帮助。$B$B到贫瘠之地去和图加谈谈吧，他应该就在十字路口。从血蹄村一直往东走就可以进入贫瘠之地，在路口向北转，然后继续往北走，很快就到十字路口了。$B$B记得一直在路上走，$n，贫瘠之地是一块非常危险的土地。
text.completion: 雷霆崖的兄弟们派你来真是太明智了，年轻的$C。以我一人之力是无法揭开贫瘠之地的这些秘密的。$B$B有了你的帮助，我们就有希望找到问题的答案了。

english.title: The Barrens Oases
english.objectives: Speak with Tonga Runetotem at the Crossroads.
english.description: The druids of Thunder Bluff sense a strange power leaking into the Barrens, east of Mulgore.$B$BTonga Runetotem was sent to discover the source of this power, but we fear he will need aid.$B$BTravel to the Barrens and speak with Tonga.  He will be at the Crossroads.  To reach there, take the road east out of Bloodhoof village.  Enter the Barrens, then turn north when the road forks.  Continue north and  you will find the Crossroads.$B$BAnd do not leave the road, $n, for the Barrens is a harsh land.
english.completion: My brethren in Thunder Bluff were wise to send you, young $c.  For the mystery of the Barrens is one that I alone cannot unravel. With your aid, let us hope we can find answers to our questions.

text.title: 南海海盗
text.objectives: 在勇士岛上杀死8个南海杀手或南海私掠者。
text.description: 加兹鲁维承诺我如果我能帮他解决棘齿城的海盗问题就升我的职。当下那些海盗已经占领了南部的勇士岛，他们不仅是想打我货物的主意，他们就想找麻烦！前几天晚上他们居然还敢袭击我们的战船。$B$B怎么对付他们我已经有安排了，但是加兹鲁维想要立竿见影的结果。拜托你了，去勇士岛给我弄死几个海盗，好吗？
text.progress: 我甚至不愿去核算我到底在历次的海贼袭击中损失了多少，现在他们居然敢在我的家门口扎营?形势有点失控，安德曼必须得采取一些行动了。
text.completion: 孩子，你干得不错。多一点像你那么能干的$r，我就可以少去一些烦恼。希望这些臭海盗能意识到他们该挪挪窝了。$B$B另外，我还得把他们偷走的货物给找回来!
text.completed: Return to Wharfmaster Dizzywig in Ratchet.

english.title: Southsea Freebooters
english.objectives: Kill 8 Southsea Cutthroats or Privateers on Fray Island.
english.description: Gazlowe promised me a promotion if I can help him with Ratchet's pirate issues. The problem is these new buccaneers that sailed in and took over Fray Island, south of here. They're not just after our goods - they've got grudges to settle! The other night they even went after one of our war galleons.$B$BI've got plans in the works to deal with the situation, but Gazlowe wants to see quick results. Head over to Fray Island and start lopping off some heads, will you?
english.progress: I don't even want to think about the profits I've lost from pirate raiding, and now they set up camp on my doorstep? It's getting out of hand, Undermine's got to do something about it.
english.completion: Superb! Gazlowe will reward me handsomely for this. And I'll reward you. Less handsomely, of course. A goblin's got to make a living, you know?
english.completed: Return to Wharfmaster Dizzywig in Ratchet.

text.title: [DEPRECATED] 被窃的货物
text.objectives: 帮棘齿城的加兹鲁维取回一箱靴子以及一块望远镜片。
text.description: 我希望取回所有丢失的货物，但我想那不太可能。不过，有些货物是我必须要取回的！$b$b正如你所见的，我的天文台马上就要建好了，现在只差两块镜片中较小的一块。第一块已由杜隆塔尔的商队运到，第二块运上了船，但现在还没有到。对了，我还没有收到藏宝海湾的崔斯里克给我发来的靴子！$b$b到海盗营地去一趟，看看能不能找到这些货物吧。
text.progress: 你找到我要的东西了吗?
text.completion: 能找回这些东西，对我来说好歹也是个安慰。$N，谢谢你的帮助。我愿意雇用你这样的$r来帮助我完成工作。如果你需要工作，那就回来找我吧，我是不会亏待你的!

english.title: [DEPRICATED]Stolen Booty
english.objectives: Retrieve the Shipment of Boots and Telescopic Lens for Gazlowe in Ratchet.
english.description: While I'd like to recover all my goods, I'm sure that's not possible. Still, there's a few things that I absolutely must have!$b$bAs you see, my observatory is ready to go, but it needs the smaller of the two lenses. The first arrived by caravan from Durotar, but the second was bound by ship, and never arrived. Also, I never got my boot shipment from Drizzlik in Booty Bay!$b$bHead down to the pirate camp and see if you can find them.
english.progress: Did you find my things, $n?
english.completion: It's a relief to get all this stuff back, so thanks for your help, $n. You know, I could use a $r like you to help out with my operation here. If you're ever looking for work, don't forget about how well Gazlowe pays for service!

text.title: 风之魂
text.progress: 给碎牙带10块血岩裂片回来，你就可以获得无人能敌的迅捷。你将像角斑马一样疾驰，就连风都会嫉妒你的速度。$B$B虽然这种效果的持续时间不会很长，但它也足以让你穿越广袤的贫瘠之地。
text.completion: 很好，很好。阿迦玛甘之魂会指引着你，$C。如果你想要更多阿迦玛甘的魔法，就会来找我吧。
text.completed: Return to Mangletooth in Mulgore.

english.title: Spirit of the Wind
english.progress: Bring Mangletooth 10 blood shards and I will bless you with great speed. You will run with zhevra and the wind will be jealous of you.$B$BIt will not last long, but it should be enough to help you travel throughout the Barrens.
english.completion: Good. Go with Agamaggan's spirit as your guide, $r. Return to me if you desire more of Agamaggan's magics.
english.completed: Return to Mangletooth in Mulgore.

text.title: [DEPRECATED]The Missing Shipment
text.objectives: 把加兹鲁维的账本交给棘齿城的码头管理员迪兹维格。
text.description: 我一直在等从藏宝海湾发来的最后一批货物！我确信是海盗偷走了它们，不过为了保险一点，我还是希望你能去一趟码头，帮我问问迪兹维格……问问我的货物是否已经入库。$B$B把我的帐本交给迪兹维格，让他赶紧把我的存货记录和他的出货单校对一下。
text.progress: $N，你有什么要托运的吗?
text.completion: 啊，是加兹鲁维派你来的?稍等一下，让我看看我的出货单，确定我有没有把加兹鲁维的货物发错地方。$B$B他一定正等着崔斯里克的靴子……

english.title: [DEPRECATED]The Missing Shipment
english.objectives: Bring Gazlowe's Ledger to Wharfmaster Dizzywig.
english.description: I've been waiting forever for my last shipment of goods from Booty Bay! I'm pretty sure that it must have been stolen by the Freebooters, but just to make sure, will you go down to the dockside and ask Dizzywig if my goods were already put into my warehouse without my knowledge?$b$bHere, take my ledger down to Dizzywig and have him double check my inventory records against his logs.
english.progress: Wares to send on the next ship, $n?
english.completion: Ah, Gazlowe sent you, did he? Just a moment, let me take a look here and check my own logs and make sure I didn't have Gazlowe's shipment sent to the wrong place.$B$BBet he's waiting for those boots from Drizzlek...

text.title: 船长的复仇
text.objectives: 从塞拉摩水兵和码头守卫那里收集10枚塞拉摩徽章。杀掉培里中尉和布克兰德中尉。
text.description: 那些狂热过头的塞拉摩人类，又让我的舰队损失一条船！$b$b他们新任的海军上将就停靠在海岸这儿，过往船只一旦不听他命令停靠，他要么把它们轰沉，要么就强行登船。$b$b沿着商旅海岸往南就是他的营地，到那里去把他们的水兵和摩码头守卫的徽章抢来给我。除掉他的左膀右臂——培里和布克兰德。把他们干掉，就像他们干掉我的舰队一样！
text.progress: 呀，也许我应该亲自去手刃那些该死的纳迦!显然，你是不会去做这个的。$B$B也许我该给你找些针线活，让你不至于太清闲。
text.completion: 干得漂亮，$N。那些混帐东西罪有应得。既然我的船和我的水手们已经不在了，那么就让这些纳迦的死给我带来一些安慰吧。
text.completed: Return to Captain Thalo'thas Brightsun at Ratchet in North Barrens.

english.title: A Captain's Vengeance
english.objectives: Collect 10 Theramore Medals from Theramore Marines and Deck Hands. Kill Lieutenants Pyre and Buckland.
english.description: Yet another ship from my fleet has been lost to those overzealous humans from Theramore!$b$bTheir new Rear Admiral has parked himself right off the coast here. He's boarding or sinking any vessel that doesn't heave-to at his whim.$b$bTravel south along the Merchant Coast to his camp. Bring me the medals of the marines and deck hands. Execute his top Lieutenants, Pyre and Buckland. Lay waste to them as they have laid waste to my fleet!
english.progress: Fill my hand with medals from their dead and I will know that vengeance has been given to my fallen privateers.
english.completion: I see you've made the righteous Rear Admiral suffer as I have. Perhaps this blow will weaken the resolve of Northwatch. His supply of fresh recruits seems inexhaustible, but the loss of his top Lieutenants will weaken him for some time.
english.completed: Return to Captain Thalo'thas Brightsun at Ratchet in North Barrens.

text.title: [DEPRECATED]The Missing Shipment
text.objectives: 把加兹鲁维的账本交还给棘齿城的加兹鲁维。
text.description: 我这边的出货记录似乎没什么问题，$N。回去告诉加兹鲁维，他似乎不太走运。不出意料的话，应该是有海盗偷走了他的货物。$B$B很遗憾我不能为他做些什么了。呃……不过你可以告诉他，我从安德麦弄了些东西给他，什么时候他有空的话就过来拿一下吧。
text.progress: 那么，迪兹维格怎么说?
text.completion: 真是走背运!我想一定是那些海盗……迪兹维格是个不错的家伙，我想他还不至于骗我。毕竟他是吃这碗饭的。$B$B看来我要必须要想办法拿回我的货物了，$N。你说呢?

english.title: [DEPRECATED]The Missing Shipment
english.objectives: Return Gazlowe's Ledger to Gazlowe in Ratchet.
english.description: Everything looks square from my records, $n. Go on back and tell Gazlowe he's out of luck. I wouldn't be surprised if it was the pirates that nabbed his goodies.$b$bNothing else I can do for him. Oh... though you could tell him that I've got some things from Undermine for him, when he has the time to come pick them up.
english.progress: So, what did Dizzywig have to say?
english.completion: No dice, eh? I guess it must have been the Freebooters then... Dizzywig's on the level, I'm sure he wouldn't cheat me like that. After all, he is on the payroll.$B$BLooks like I've got some goods to get back, $n. What do you say?

text.title: 野猪人的武器
text.objectives: 给陶拉祖营地的塔特纳克·钢炉带去一把钢鬃背刺匕首、一根烧焦的钢鬃魔杖和一面钢鬃大盾。
text.description: 在巨人旷野以南的地区，生活着大群的钢鬃野猪人。据我所知，他们曾是一群无能的铁匠，不过有人告诉我说，野猪人们现在已经逐渐开始改良他们的那些破烂武器了。我想要从他们那里弄些武器样品来进行研究。$B$B如果你能帮我带回来几件武器的话，部落会以你为荣的。帮我带回一把捕猎者用的匕首，一根先知用的魔杖，和一面战士用的盾牌。
text.progress: 我不相信落后的野猪人能发展出什么高超的锻造技术。不过，我会按大酋长的要求去做，向钢鬃部族学习任何可以学到的东西。$B$B我有很多需要劳力工作的工作经验，只要是对兽人有帮助的，我都非常乐意也很愿意。
text.completion: 精湛……真是精湛的武器。$B$B野猪人的技术比我想象中的要先进太多了。$B$B$C，拿着这个，然后请自便。我现在要赶快仔细研究研究这些武器。我们也许低估了这些敌人，那将是一个我们无法承担的致命错误。
text.completed: Return to Tatternack Steelforge at Camp Taurajo in The Barrens.

english.title: Weapons of Choice
english.objectives: Bring a Razormane Backstabber, a Charred Razormane Wand and a Razormane War Shield to Tatternack Steelforge at Camp Taurajo in the Barrens.
english.description: The Razormane quilboars to the south, beyond the Field of Giants, have no skilled blacksmiths from what I am told, but they've apparently started to develop sturdier weapons. I'd like to get my hands on a few different types to learn their techniques if possible.$B$BIf you wish to help bring honor to the Horde, then bring me examples of their weapons. Find me a dagger from their stalkers, a wand from their seers, and a shield from their warfrenzy. That should do nicely!
english.progress: I, too, have doubts that the pathetic quilboars could attain any level of skill in the area of smithing, but I do as the Warchief commands, and I shall learn what I can about the Razormane tribe. I have had more menial tasks, and I do so willingly if it aids the orc people.
english.completion: Excellent, excellent specimens indeed. The quilboar are further along than I had expected. Here, $c, take this and get out of my way. I'd better take a closer look at these weapons. We may have underestimated our enemy, and that's the kind of mistake we can't afford to make.
english.completed: Return to Tatternack Steelforge at Camp Taurajo in The Barrens.

text.title: 什么什么平衡器
text.objectives: 在风险投资公司研究基地里找到控制台。
text.description: 风险投资公司最近在西边设立了小型的研究设备，就在淤泥沼泽过去一点点。我对他们在做的东西并不了解，只知道他们正在试验一种名叫“主动式负载平衡器”的装备。$b$b那个主动式负载平衡器到底是什么东西呢？不管它是什么，我都想研究研究它，所以我需要找个人来帮我把它弄到手。$b$b我手里有控制系统操作手册的副本，你应该知道该怎么把那什么平衡器卸下来。
text.completion: 控制台的表面凌乱地布满了众多的按钮、控制杆和不断闪烁的指示灯。一部小型仪表显示这台设备正处于最佳的工作状态下，一至三号控制阀门已经打开。在控制面板的右下方有一个插钥匙的小孔。
text.completed: 在北贫瘠之地风险投资公司研究基地里找到控制台。

english.title: Samophlange
english.objectives: Access the control console at the Venture Company research site.
english.description: The Venture Company have a small research facility west of here, just past the Sludge Fen. I don't know very much about what they're doing, but did manage to discover that they're experimenting with something called a "samophlange".$b$bNow what the heck is a samophlange? Well, whatever it is, I want to examine it, so I need someone to go get it.$b$bI obtained a copy of their control system operating manual, you should be able to figure out how to disengage the samophlange from it.
english.completion: A variety of buttons, levers, and blinking lights are somewhat erratically arrayed on the face of the control console. A small gauge indicates that the apparatus is currently operating within optimal levels, and indicates that control valves one through three are currently open. There is a small keyhole set into the lower right side of the control panel.
english.completed: Access the control console at the Venture Company research site in Northern Barrens.

text.title: 通缉：嘉维伊船长
text.objectives: 把嘉维伊船长的徽记带给棘齿城的加兹鲁维。
text.description: 通缉！$b$b女武士之匕号的$b“船长”J·嘉维伊$b$b他犯有在公海进行海盗活动、绑架、勒索、纵火、非法奴役等罪行。近日有目击称，嘉维伊来到这片海域，带领一伙南海海盗袭击了勇士岛。把他的可辨识的死亡证明带来！$b$b- 加兹鲁维
text.progress: 有什么事吗?我能帮你什么吗?有需要托运的货物吗?
text.completion: 啊，原来是这件事。你知道，我曾经在公海上看见过破浪号。那是一艘可怕的船，或者说是小艇……那些水手太特别了!$B$B不管怎么说，她划过水面的景象真是漂亮。我很高兴得知她那声名狼藉的船长不会再骚扰我的船只了。
text.completed: Bring Garvey's head to Gazlowe at Ratchet in Northern Barrens.

english.title: WANTED: Cap'n Garvey
english.objectives: Bring the head of Cap'n Garvey to Gazlowe in Ratchet.
english.description: WANTED!$b$b    "Cap'n" J. Garvey of$b     the Maiden's Dagger$b$bCharged with piracy on the open seas, kidnapping, extortion, arson, slavery, et al. Garvey recently arrived in these waters leading a crew of Southsea Freebooters and was last seen assaulting Fray Island. Bring proof of death in an identifiable condition!$b$b-- Gazlowe
english.progress: What's happening? Something I can help you with? Goods to ship, perhaps an engineering job?
english.completion: Ahhhh! That sort of business. You know, these pirates are always looking out for their own. No sooner is Baron Longshore in a stockade than this Garvey fellow comes looking for vengeance... You don't suppose anyone will come looking to avenge Garvey, do you? Maybe I should put you on retainer.
english.completed: Bring Garvey's head to Gazlowe at Ratchet in Northern Barrens.

text.title: 矿工的宝贝
text.objectives: 从风险投资公司的某个监督或者执行者那里夺取猫眼翡翠，然后把它交给棘齿城的码头管理员迪兹维格。
text.description: 作为像棘齿城这么繁忙的码头的管理者，我始终关注着每一条有利可图的消息。我知道这里与藏宝海湾的所有物品和货币的交易情况。$B$B最近我听到了一些消息，是关于风险投资公司在淤泥沼泽东北的石矿洞的。有个矿工挖出了一枚足有拳头大小的翡翠石。我知道有一些买主肯掏钱买那么大的一块宝石，如果你帮我搞到那块宝石的话，那么我愿意和你五五分成，你看怎么样？
text.progress: 只要我们知道是哪个矿工找到了翡翠，那么得到它就是轻而易举的事情了……
text.completion: $N，看看这块大宝石!我们就要成富翁了!根据我对幽坑城的各种宝石的估价，我来算算你应该分到多少，怎么样?$B$B让我想想……我觉得这个价格应该没什么问题。$N，很高兴与你做生意。
text.completed: Bring the Emerald to Brak Blusterpipe in Nozzlepot's Outpost in Northern Barrens.

english.title: Miner's Fortune
english.objectives: Retrieve the Cats Eye Emerald from one of the Venture Co. Overseers or Enforcers.
english.description: Hey $r, you interested in treasure? I knew that would get your attention.$b$bWord from the river dock here is that one of the miners in the Venture Company's Boulder Lode mine just northeast of here discovered an emerald the size of your fist.$B$BI know a few buyers who'd be interested in getting their hands on something like that, and I'd be willing to go half and half on its sale. You in?
english.progress: If only we knew which one of the miners had found the emerald, it'd be a walk in the park...
english.completion: Look at the size of that thing! We're going to be rich! Let's see, according to the rates I've seen on gems going into Undermine, I should be able to figure out your cut - fifty percent, don't worry! Now let's see... I think this should do about right. Pleasure doing business with you, $n.
english.completed: Bring the Emerald to Brak Blusterpipe in Nozzlepot's Outpost in Northern Barrens.

text.title: 收割者
text.objectives: 把收割者的头颅交给乔恩·星眼。
text.description: 这种奇特的昆虫状生物看起来仿佛不是贫瘠之地的生物，而更像是个天外来物。
text.progress: 你看起来好像有什么麻烦，$N。你在贫瘠之地的修行进行得如何了?有什么事情在困扰着你吗?
text.completion: 我无法判断这是什么生物，因为它的灵魂已经消散。不过，正如你猜测的那样，它并不属于贫瘠之地。我担心它可能会为我们的同胞带来灾难……$B$B现在，做好准备，让我们一起期待揭开这种生物的谜团的那一天吧。

english.title: The Harvester
english.objectives: Bring the Harvester's Head to Jorn Skyseer.
english.description: This strange, insect-like creature looks outside of the natural order, as though it does not belong in the Barrens.
english.progress: You seemed troubled, $n.  How go your lessons in the Barrens?  Did you find something that disturbs you?
english.completion: I can tell nothing of the nature of this beast, for its spirit has fled.  But as you guessed, it does not belong in the Barrens.  I fear it may herald a grim future for our people... But for now, prepare yourself, and let us hope that time unravels the mystery of this creature.

text.title: 逃离监牢
text.objectives: 护送基尔萨瑞斯·火枝安全地返回棘齿城的沙罗萨斯船长那里。
text.description: 终于有人来救我了！$B$B你居然能躲过那些守卫，这简直是太不可思议了。这帮塞拉摩的狂热分子已经毫无理智可言了。他们击沉了我们的船只，俘虏了我这个唯一的幸存者，还称我为联盟的敌人和威胁。$B$B你看我像是要威胁谁的样子吗？我不过是在棘齿城和藏宝海湾之间来回奔波的下等水手而已。$B$B一下子说了这么多，你愿意帮我返回棘齿城吗？等你准备好了，我们就马上越狱。
text.progress: 嗯?
text.completion: 嗯，我们以为火枝早就死了!$B$B你的英雄事迹为你赢得了萨罗丹船队的尊重，$N。
text.end: 护送基尔萨瑞斯?火枝安全地返回棘齿城。
text.completed: Return to Captain Thalo'thas Brightsun in The Barrens.

english.title: Free From the Hold
english.objectives: Safely escort Gilthares Firebough back to Captain Brightsun in Ratchet.
english.description: Finally! Someone to rescue me!$b$bI can't believe you got past the guards. These zealots from Theramore are out of their minds. They sank our ship and imprisoned me, the only survivor. I was called an enemy and threat to the Alliance.$b$bMe! A threat to their great sham of an Alliance? I was a deckhand on a moonshine transport between Ratchet and Booty Bay.$b$bEnough talk. Help me get back to Ratchet will you? Let me know when you're ready and we'll make our break.
english.progress: Yes?
english.completion: And to think, we thought Firebough was long dead! Your heroics have earned you a place of honor with the Thalo'dan Privateers, $n.
english.end: Escort Gilthares Firebough back to Ratchet
english.completed: Return to Captain Thalo'thas Brightsun in The Barrens.

text.title: 复仇的怒火
text.objectives: 收集30根刺背野猪人的獠牙。
text.description: 他们杀了我的妻子，烧毁了我的家园。自从那个可怕的夜晚之后，我在这片土地上游荡，从日出到日落，寻找这些罪无可赦的恶魔。我见一个野猪人就杀一个。但这依然远远无法平息我复仇的欲望。$B$B我想你这个$c能够帮助我。$B$B去杀掉那些野猪人，能杀多少就杀多少。带回它们的獠牙，让我们一起为它们的死亡而庆贺吧。
text.progress: 我又想起了家人的残肢断臂，想起了那熊熊燃烧的家园……我的家园。$B$B我要让那些野猪人血债血还!
text.completion: $C，感谢你帮我杀了这些该死的东西。$B$B尽管复仇的火焰仍在心中燃烧，但是看到野猪人遭受这么大的痛苦还是让我感到了些许安慰。
text.completed: Bring the Tusks to Mankrik at the Grol'dom Farm in Northern Barrens.

english.title: Consumed by Hatred
english.objectives: Collect 30 Quilboar Tusks.
english.description: They murdered my wife. They burned my homestead. Since that awful night I have traveled these lands, from the sun's rising till its decline, scouring the horizon for more of those monsters. I've killed every pig man I've come across since, but my thirst for their blood is far from quenched.$B$BYou, $c - you could help me.$B$BKill them. Kill as many as you can. Bring me their tusks, and we will celebrate their deaths together.
english.progress: The quilboar will pay for this, $n. I swear it.
english.completion: $c, you take my task seriously, and for that I thank you. Although my desire for revenge remains, I can at least smile seeing that the quilboars have felt pain themselves.
english.completed: Bring the Tusks to Mankrik at the Grol'dom Farm in Northern Barrens.

text.title: 主动式负载平衡器
text.objectives: 关闭燃油控制阀、调节阀和主控制阀，然后再使用控制台。
text.description: 三个控制阀门都处于打开状态。根据控制面板上的指示说明，在拆卸零件之前必须要把这三个阀门关闭。
text.progress: 控制台上闪烁的指示灯显示，主控制阀还没有关闭。
text.completion: 关闭了三个控制阀之后，绿色指示灯慢慢变为黄色，阀门已经关闭，现在你可以使用这套设备的控制开关了。
text.completed: Return to the Control Console at the Venture Company Research Outpost in Northern Barrens.

english.title: Samophlange
english.objectives: Close off the Fuel Control Valve, the Regulator Valve and the Main Control Valve then use the control console again.
english.description: The three control valves are currently opened. The various readings on the control panel lead you to presume that they must be shut off before the apparatus can be shut off.
english.progress: Blinking lights on the control console indicate that the main control valves have not been closed off.
english.completion: The lights indicating the three control valves dim as they are shut off. Green lights slowly fade into yellow, and the switch controlling the apparatus is now moveable, with the valves closed, it can be turned off.
english.completed: Return to the Control Console at the Venture Company Research Outpost in Northern Barrens.

text.title: 什么什么平衡器
text.objectives: 从工匠斯尼格斯那里拿到控制台的钥匙。
text.description: 关闭设备后就可以开启控制面板，从控制台中移出主动式负载平衡器。一切准备就绪，现在你需要做的就是取得可以打开控制台的钥匙。
text.progress: 控制灯熄灭了，各种仪表都指向了零刻度，整台设备顿时停了下来。
text.completion: 你把钥匙插入锁中，打开了控制台。控制台上方的红灯熄灭了，终端的所有能源全都被切断了。
text.completed: Return to the Control Console at the Venture Company Research Post in Northern Barrens.

english.title: Samophlange
english.objectives: Get the Console Key from Tinkerer Sniggles.
english.description: With the apparatus deactivated, the control panel can be opened up and the samophlange removed from the console. With everything else in place, all that is left is to acquire the key to unlock the console.
english.progress: The console lights are dimmed and the gauges and dials all read at their zero positions, everything idling.
english.completion: Turning the key in the lock, the control console unlocks. A red light at the top of the console turns off and all power drains from the terminal.
english.completed: Return to the Control Console at the Venture Company Research Post in Northern Barrens.

text.title: 主动式负载平衡器
text.objectives: 把主动式负载平衡器交给棘齿城的斯布特瓦夫。
